        end
    end
    for index = #self._connections, 1, -1 do
        local connection = self._connections[index]
        if connection.Connected then
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        self._connections[index] = nil
    end
    self.Tab._sectionByName[self.Name] = nil
    for index, section in ipairs(self.Tab.Sections) do
        if section == self then
            table.remove(self.Tab.Sections, index)
            break
        end
    end
    self._container:Destroy()
    if not self.Tab._destroyed then
        task.defer(self.Tab._updateCanvas)
    end
end

ApiImpl[90] = function(self, config)
    assertObject(self, "Tab")
    local sectionConfig = normalizeConfig(config, "Section")
    assert(
        not self._sectionByName[sectionConfig.Name],
        ("Section '%s' da ton tai trong Tab '%s'")
            :format(sectionConfig.Name, self.Name)
    )

    local initiallyExpanded = sectionConfig.Expanded
    if initiallyExpanded == nil then
        initiallyExpanded = self.SectionsExpanded
    end

    self._nextSectionOrder = self._nextSectionOrder + 1

    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
    container.Name = sectionConfig.Name .. "Section"
    container.Active = false
    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    container.BorderSizePixel = 0
    container.ClipsDescendants = false
    container.LayoutOrder = self._nextSectionOrder
    container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    container.ZIndex = 3
    container.Parent = self.Page

    local sectionLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    sectionLayout.Name = "SectionLayout"
    sectionLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    sectionLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    sectionLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
    sectionLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    sectionLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    sectionLayout.Parent = container

    local sectionDisplayName = tostring(
        sectionConfig.DisplayName or sectionConfig.Name
    )
    local header, arrow, headerButton = createSectionHeader(
        sectionDisplayName,
        1,
        self.Page
    )
    header.Parent = container

    local lastHeaderWidth = -1
    local function updateHeaderHeight(force)
        if not force and (Runtime.windowAnimating or not self.Page.Visible) then
            return
        end
        local availableWidth = container.AbsoluteSize.X
        if availableWidth <= 0 then
            availableWidth = self.Page.AbsoluteSize.X
        end
        if availableWidth <= 0 then
            return
        end
        local scale = ContentScale.X
        local referenceWidth = availableWidth / scale
        if math.abs(referenceWidth - lastHeaderWidth) < 0.5 then
            return
        end
        lastHeaderWidth = referenceWidth
        local headerHeight = math.max(
            1,
            math.floor(
                referenceWidth * 0.97 / SECTION_HEADER_ASPECT + 0.5
            )
        )
        local headerWidthScale = 0.97
        if RESIZE_KEEPS_OPTION_WIDTH then
            headerWidthScale = 0.97 / scale
        end
        header.Size = UDim2.new(headerWidthScale, 0, 0, headerHeight)
    end

    ContentScale.OnChanged(function()
        if container.Parent == nil then
            return false
        end
        updateHeaderHeight()
    end)

    local group = Instance.new("Frame")
    group.Name = "CollapsibleContent"
    group.Active = false
    group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    group.BorderSizePixel = 0
    group.ClipsDescendants = true
    group.LayoutOrder = 2
    group.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    group.ZIndex = 3
    group.Parent = container

    local content = Instance.new("Frame")
    content.Name = "Content"
    content.Active = false
    content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    content.BorderSizePixel = 0
    content.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
    content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
    content.ZIndex = 3
    content.Parent = group

    local contentLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    contentLayout.Name = "OptionLayout"
    contentLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
    contentLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    contentLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
    contentLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)
    contentLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    contentLayout.Parent = content

    local section = setmetatable({
        _kind = "Section",
        _destroyed = false,
        _container = container,
        _header = header,
        _arrow = arrow,
        _group = group,
        _content = content,
        _connections = {},
        _layout = contentLayout,
        _optionByName = {},
        _sectionLayout = sectionLayout,
        _expandedHeight = 0,
        _nextOptionOrder = 0,
        _animationSerial = 0,
        DisplayName = sectionDisplayName,
        Expanded = initiallyExpanded ~= false,
        Name = sectionConfig.Name,
        Options = {},
        Tab = self,
    }, SectionMethods)

    local containerRefreshQueued = false
    section._refreshContainer = function()
        if containerRefreshQueued or section._destroyed then
            return
        end
        containerRefreshQueued = true
        task.defer(function()
            containerRefreshQueued = false
            if section._destroyed then
                return
            end
            local measuredHeight = math.max(
                0,
                math.ceil(sectionLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
            )
            local summedHeight = 0
            local visibleCount = 0
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
                    visibleCount = visibleCount + 1
                    summedHeight = summedHeight + math.max(
                        0,
                        child.AbsoluteSize.Y
                    )
                end
            end
            if visibleCount > 1 then
                summedHeight = summedHeight
                    + (visibleCount - 1)
                        * (
                            sectionLayout.Padding.Offset
                            + sectionLayout.Padding.Scale
                                * container.AbsoluteSize.Y
                        )
            end
            local sectionHeight = math.max(
                measuredHeight,
                math.ceil(summedHeight)
            )
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, sectionHeight)
            self._updateCanvas()
        end)
    end

    
    
    
    local heightRefreshQueued = false
    local heightRefreshAgain = false
    section._measureExpandedHeight = function()
        local measuredHeight = math.max(
            0,
            math.ceil(contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
        )
        local summedHeight = 0
        local visibleCount = 0
        for _, child in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
                visibleCount = visibleCount + 1
                local childHeight = child.AbsoluteSize.Y
                if childHeight <= 0 then
                    childHeight = math.max(0, child.Size.Y.Offset)
                end
                summedHeight = summedHeight + childHeight
            end
        end
        if visibleCount > 1 then
            summedHeight = summedHeight
                + (visibleCount - 1)
                    * (
                        contentLayout.Padding.Offset
                        + contentLayout.Padding.Scale
                            * content.AbsoluteSize.Y
                    )
        end
        section._expandedHeight = math.max(
            measuredHeight,
            math.ceil(summedHeight)
        )
        return section._expandedHeight
    end

    local function applyMeasuredHeight()
        section._measureExpandedHeight()
        content.Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            0,
            0,
            math.max(section._expandedHeight, 1)
        )
        if not section._heightTween then
            group.Size = UDim2.new(
                1,
                0,
                0,
                section.Expanded and section._expandedHeight or 0
            )
            group.Visible = section.Expanded
            group.ClipsDescendants = not section.Expanded
        end
        section._refreshContainer()
    end

    section._refreshHeight = function()
        if section._destroyed then
            return
        end
        if heightRefreshQueued then
            heightRefreshAgain = true
            return
        end
        heightRefreshQueued = true
        task.defer(function()
            if section._destroyed then
                heightRefreshQueued = false
                return
            end
            
            
            
            
            if Runtime.windowAnimating then
                heightRefreshQueued = false
                task.delay(0.12, section._refreshHeight)
                return
            end
            
            
            if not section.Tab.Page.Visible then
                heightRefreshQueued = false
                return
            end
            applyMeasuredHeight()
            heightRefreshQueued = false
            if heightRefreshAgain then
                heightRefreshAgain = false
                section._refreshHeight()
            end
        end)
    end

    
    section._refreshLayout = function()
        if section._destroyed then
            return
        end
        updateHeaderHeight(true)
        for _, updater in ipairs(section._rowUpdaters or {}) do
            updater(true)
        end
        applyMeasuredHeight()
        section._refreshContainer()
    end

    local stabilizationSerial = 0
    local stabilizationRunning = false
    section._stabilizeLayout = function()
        stabilizationSerial = stabilizationSerial + 1
        if stabilizationRunning then
            return
        end
        stabilizationRunning = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local observedSerial = -1
            local quietFrames = 0
            while quietFrames < 2 and not section._destroyed do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                applyMeasuredHeight()
                if observedSerial == stabilizationSerial then
                    quietFrames = quietFrames + 1
                else
                    observedSerial = stabilizationSerial
                    quietFrames = 0
                end
            end
            stabilizationRunning = false
            if not section._destroyed
                and observedSerial ~= stabilizationSerial
            then
                section._stabilizeLayout()
            end
        end)
    end

    table.insert(section._connections, contentLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(
        section._refreshHeight
    ))
    table.insert(section._connections, self.Page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(
        section._refreshHeight
    ))
    table.insert(section._connections, self.Page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(
        updateHeaderHeight
    ))
    table.insert(section._connections, container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(
        updateHeaderHeight
    ))
    table.insert(section._connections, sectionLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(
        section._refreshContainer
    ))
    table.insert(section._connections, header:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(
        section._refreshContainer
    ))
    table.insert(section._connections, connectSafeActivation(headerButton, function()
        ApiImpl[88](section)
    end))

    table.insert(self.Sections, section)
    self._sectionByName[section.Name] = section
    updateHeaderHeight()
    ApiImpl[87](section, section.Expanded, false)
    task.defer(updateHeaderHeight)
    task.defer(section._refreshHeight)
    task.defer(section._refreshContainer)
    return section
end

ApiImpl[93] = function(self)
    assertObject(self, "Window")
    local count = #self.Tabs
    if count == 0 then
        return
    end
    
    
    local scale = ContentScale.Y
    
    for _, column in pairs(TabColumns) do
        local columnTabs = {}
        for _, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
            if tab.Column == column then
                table.insert(columnTabs, tab)
            end
        end
        local columnCount = #columnTabs
        if columnCount > 0 then
            local gapRatio = column.GapRatio or TAB_LAYOUT.GapRatio
            local fittedHeight = TAB_LAYOUT.Span
                * scale
                / (
                    columnCount
                    + math.max(columnCount - 1, 0) * gapRatio
                )
            local tabHeight = math.min(
                TAB_LAYOUT.NormalHeight,
                fittedHeight
            ) / scale
            column.Layout.Padding = UDim.new(
                tabHeight * gapRatio,
                0
            )
            for index, tab in ipairs(columnTabs) do
                tab.Button.LayoutOrder = index
                tab.Button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, tabHeight, 0)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function setTabSelected(tab, selected)
    tab.Page.Visible = selected
    local base = tab.Button:FindFirstChild("Main")
    if base then
        TweenService:Create(
            base,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.14,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                BackgroundColor3 = selected
                        and Color3.fromRGB(255, 54, 54)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(175, 0, 0),
            }
        ):Play()
    end
end

    closeActiveDropdown()

local ChilliLibrary = {
    NoStateChange = STATE_NO_CHANGE,
    Version = "3.22.0",
    SplitDefaultsApi = "manual-defaults-v1",
}

ChilliLibrary.Rich = {
    Bullet = utf8.char(0x2022),
}

function ChilliLibrary.Rich.Escape(text)
    return (string.gsub(tostring(text), "[<>&]", {
        ["<"] = "&lt;",
        [">"] = "&gt;",
        ["&"] = "&amp;",
    }))
end

function ChilliLibrary.Rich.Color(color, text)
    local hex = typeof(color) == "Color3" and ("#" .. color:ToHex()) or tostring(color)
    return string.format('<font color="%s">%s</font>', hex, tostring(text))
end

function ChilliLibrary.Rich.Bold(text)
    return "<b>" .. tostring(text) .. "</b>"
end

function ChilliLibrary.Rich.Italic(text)
    return "<i>" .. tostring(text) .. "</i>"
end

function ChilliLibrary.Rich.Muted(text)
    return ChilliLibrary.Rich.Color("#AAAAAA", text)
end

function ChilliLibrary.Rich.Rule(count)
    return ChilliLibrary.Rich.Color("#444455", string.rep(utf8.char(0x2500), tonumber(count) or 38))
end

function ChilliLibrary.Rich.Join(lines)
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- Luau: voidexternal presentation layer, Roblox client.
-- Existing state and callback APIs stay attached to their original controls.
do local install_voidexternal = function()
    local purple = Color3.fromRGB(117, 39, 168)
    local panel = Color3.fromRGB(22, 12, 34)
    local row_color = Color3.fromRGB(47, 25, 65)
    local text_color = Color3.fromRGB(228, 218, 237)
    local function make(class, parent_object, properties)
        local object = Instance.new(class)
        for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end
        object.Parent = parent_object
        return object
    end
    local function round(object, radius)
        local corner = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
        corner.Parent = object
    end
    rootGui.Name = "voidexternal"
    local shell = make("Frame", rootGui, {
        Name = "VoidexternalWindow", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(744, 565),
        BackgroundColor3 = panel, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true,
    })
    round(shell, 10)
    make("UIStroke", shell, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(88, 32, 119), Thickness = 1})
    local scale = make("UIScale", shell, {Scale = 1})
    local function resize()
        local camera_now = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if camera_now then
            scale.Scale = math.min(1, (camera_now.ViewportSize.X - 24) / 744, (camera_now.ViewportSize.Y - 24) / 565)
        end
    end
    resize()
    if workspace.CurrentCamera then
        trackRootConnection(workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(resize))
    end
    local title = make("TextLabel", shell, {
        Name = "Title", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(17, 7), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(620, 27),
        Text = "VOIDEXTERNAL | STEAL AN EGG", TextSize = 20, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextColor3 = text_color, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    })
    make("TextLabel", shell, {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 36), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 19),
        Text = "discord.gg/voidexternal", Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 13,
        TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(151, 125, 171), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    })
    local sidebar = make("ScrollingFrame", shell, {
        Name = "Navigation", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 65), Size = UDim2.new(0, 168, 1, -78),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 0,
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
    })
    make("UIListLayout", sidebar, {Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
    local pages = make("Frame", shell, {
        Name = "Pages", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(194, 65), Size = UDim2.new(1, -205, 1, -72),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true,
    })
    local buckets, order = {}, {"Farm", "Eggs", "Server Hop", "Visuals", "Movement", "Teleports", "Config"}
    local selected = "Farm"
    local function choose(name)
        selected = name
        closeActiveDropdown()
        for key, bucket in pairs(buckets) do
            bucket.Page.Visible = key == name
            bucket.Button.BackgroundColor3 = key == name and purple or row_color
        end
    end
    for index, name in ipairs(order) do
        local button = make("TextButton", sidebar, {
            Name = name, LayoutOrder = index, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
            BackgroundColor3 = row_color, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false,
            Text = name, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = text_color, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        })
        round(button, 9)
        local page = make("ScrollingFrame", pages, {
            Name = name, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 4, ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 135, 177),
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), Visible = false,
        })
        make("UIListLayout", page, {Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})
        make("UIPadding", page, {PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)})
        buckets[name] = {Button = button, Page = page, Count = 0}
        trackRootConnection(button.Activated:Connect(function() choose(name) end))
    end
    local function route(tab, section)
        local name = string.lower(section.Name)
        local tab_name = string.lower(tab.Name)
        if tab_name == "settings" or tab_name == "config" or tab_name == "discord" then return "Config" end
        if string.find(name, "teleport") then return "Teleports" end
        if string.find(name, "esp") or string.find(name, "visual") or tab_name == "predictor" then return "Visuals" end
        if string.find(name, "movement") or string.find(name, "speed") or tab_name == "player" then return "Movement" end
        if string.find(tab_name, "hop") or tab_name == "server" then return "Server Hop" end
        if string.find(name, "hatch") or string.find(name, "place egg") or string.find(name, "favorite") or string.find(name, "sell") or string.find(name, "fuse") then return "Eggs" end
        if tab_name == "misc" then return "Config" end
        return "Farm"
    end
    local function style(object)
        if object:IsA("UIGradient") then
            if object.Name ~= "ON" and object.Name ~= "OFF" then object.Enabled = false end
        elseif object:IsA("UIStroke") then
            object.Transparency = 1
        elseif object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
            object.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            object.TextColor3 = text_color
            object.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            if object.Name == "Label" then object.TextScaled = false; object.TextSize = 15 end
            if object.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then object.BackgroundColor3 = row_color end
        elseif object:IsA("Frame") and object.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
            if object.Name ~= "Switch" and object.Name ~= "Hold" then
                object.BackgroundColor3 = row_color
                object.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                round(object, 8)
            end
        end
    end
    local attached = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function attach(tab, section)
        if attached[section] then return end
        attached[section] = true
        local bucket = buckets[route(tab, section)]
        bucket.Count += 1
        local container = section._container
        container.Parent = bucket.Page
        container.LayoutOrder = bucket.Count
        section._header.Visible = false
        section.Expanded = true
        section._group.ClipsDescendants = false
        local function measure()
            if section._destroyed or not container.Parent then return end
            local height = section._layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y
            section._content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
            section._group.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
            container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
        end
        section._layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
        section._refreshHeight = measure
        section._refreshContainer = measure
        section._refreshLayout = measure
        for _, object in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do style(object) end
        trackRootConnection(container.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object) task.defer(style, object) end))
        trackRootConnection(section._layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(measure))
        measure()
    end
    local function migrate()
        local window = ChilliLibrary.Window
        if not window then return end
        for _, tab in ipairs(window.Tabs) do
            for _, section in ipairs(tab.Sections) do attach(tab, section) end
        end
        choose(selected)
    end
    local old_finalize = ChilliLibrary.Finalize
    ChilliLibrary.Finalize = function(self, ...)
        local results = table.pack(old_finalize(self, ...))
        migrate()
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    local old_section = ApiImpl[90]
    ApiImpl[90] = function(self, ...)
        local section = old_section(self, ...)
        task.defer(attach, self, section)
        return section
    end
    mainFrame.Visible = false
    trackRootConnection(mainFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
        if mainFrame.Visible then mainFrame.Visible = false end
    end))
    launcherGui.Enabled = false
    trackRootConnection(launcherGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if launcherGui.Enabled then launcherGui.Enabled = false end
    end))
    local minimized = false
    local function minimize()
        minimized = not minimized
        sidebar.Visible = not minimized
        pages.Visible = not minimized
        shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(744, minimized and 58 or 565)
    end
    for index, glyph in ipairs({"−", "×"}) do
        local button = make("TextButton", shell, {
            Name = index == 1 and "Minimize" or "Close", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(650 + (index - 1) * 47, 7),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(41, 38), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(78, 30, 105),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = glyph, TextSize = 22, TextColor3 = text_color, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        })
        round(button, 9)
        trackRootConnection(button.Activated:Connect(function()
            if index == 1 then minimize(); return end
            local environment = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
            if type(environment.ChilliHubSaeCleanup) == "function" then pcall(environment.ChilliHubSaeCleanup) end
            if ChilliLibrary.Window then ApiImpl[105](ChilliLibrary.Window) else rootGui:Destroy() end
        end))
    end
    local drag_start, position_start, dragging
    trackRootConnection(title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, drag_start, position_start = input, input.Position, shell.Position
        end
    end))
    title.Active = true
    trackRootConnection(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input == dragging) then
            local delta = input.Position - drag_start
            shell.Position = position_start + UDim2.fromOffset(delta.X, delta.Y)
        end
    end))
    trackRootConnection(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragging then dragging = nil end
    end))
    trackRootConnection(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then minimize() end
    end))
    choose("Farm")
end; install_voidexternal(); end

return ChilliLibrary
end

		local function fn11(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
			local n3 = tonumber(arg2) or 6
			local n4 = tonumber(arg3) or 10
			local n5 = 0
			local flag = nil
			local n6 = 0
			local n7 = 0

			while n5 < n4 do
				if type(arg4) == "function" and arg4() then
					tbl4.StopWalking()
					return false
				end
				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				character = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not humanoidRootPart or not character or character.Health <= 0 then
					return false
				end

				if (humanoidRootPart.Position - arg).Magnitude <= n3 then
					tbl4.StopWalking()
					return true
				end
				flag = flag and (humanoidRootPart.Position - flag).Magnitude < 1

				if flag then
					n6 += 0.2
				else
					n6 = 0
				end

				flag = humanoidRootPart.Position
				n7 = math.max(0, n7 - 0.2)

				if n6 >= 0.8 and n7 <= 0 then
					tbl4.LeaveBelt()

					pcall(function()
						character.Jump = true
					end)

					n6 = 0
					n7 = 1.5
				end

				character:MoveTo(arg)
				n5 += task.wait(0.2)
			end

			tbl4.StopWalking()
			return tbl4.DistanceTo(arg) <= n3
		end

				end

				if t then
					for r, r in ipairs(t:GetChildren()) do
						if tbl4.IsBatTool(r) then
							return r
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			tbl4.IsNight = function()
				local t = tbl.AreaEggCycle
				if type(t) ~= "table" or type(t.IsNightPhase) ~= "function" then
					return false
				end
				local r, l = pcall(t.IsNightPhase, workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
				return r and l == true
			end

			tbl4.WallSealed = function()

				local r, l = pcall(t.IsSealed)
				return r and l == true

			tbl4.WallOpenDelay = function()
				local t = tbl.AreaEggResetCycle
				if type(t) ~= "table" then
					return 5
				end
				return (tonumber(t.WallCountdownDelayAfterDayStartsSeconds) or 2) + (tonumber(t.WallCountdownSeconds) or 3)
			end

			local t = Vector3.new(-15035, -474, 4853)

			local function r(l, n)
				return Vector2.new(l.X - n.X, l.Z - n.Z).Magnitude < 900 and math.abs(l.Y - n.Y) < 400
			end

			tbl4.InMechArena = function()
				local n = localPlayer.Character
				local m = n and (n:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))

				if m then
					local u = m.Position
					local m = r(u, t)

					if not m then
						local t = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleArena")

						if t and (t:IsA("Model")) then
							local x, O = pcall(t.GetPivot, t)
							m = x and typeof(O) == "CFrame" and (r(u, O.Position))
						end
					end

					if m then
						l = nil
						tbl4.MechSeenAt = os.clock()
						tbl4.MechFreshCharacter = nil
						return true
					end
				end

				if localPlayer:GetAttribute("InScrambleArena") == true and not (n ~= nil and n == tbl4.MechFreshCharacter) then
					l = l or (os.clock())
					if os.clock() - l < 6 then
						tbl4.MechSeenAt = os.clock()
						return true
					end
					return false
				end

				l = nil
				return false
			end

			tbl4.ClaimMovement = function(t)
				local r = tbl4.Movement
				if t ~= "mech" and (tbl4.InMechArena()) then
					return false
				end

				if r.Owner == nil or r.Owner == t or r.Owner == "treadmill" and t ~= "treadmill" or r.Owner == "scramble" and t == "steal" then
					r.Owner = t
					return true
				end
				return false
			end

			tbl4.ReleaseMovement = function(t)
				if tbl4.Movement.Owner == t then
					tbl4.Movement.Owner = nil
				end
			end

			local t = { "Humanoid Swap", "Disable Monitor" }
			tbl4.ShieldMethods = t
			local r, l, n, m = t[1], {}, {}
			local u, x, O = 0, { Original = nil, Clone = nil, Links = {} }
			local K = {}

			local function j()
				for F, F in ipairs(K) do
					task.defer(function()
						pcall(F)
					end)
				end
			end

			tbl4.OnHumanoidChanged = function(F)
				table.insert(K, F)
				local v

				v = {
					Connected = true,
					Disconnect = function()
						v.Connected = false
						local H = table.find(K, F)

						if H then
							table.remove(K, H)
						end
					end,
				}

				return v
			end

			local function K(F)
				pcall(function()
					local v = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
					local H = v and (v:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule"))

					if H then
						v = require(H):GetControls()

						if type(v) == "table" then
							v.humanoid = F
						end
					end
				end)
			end

			local function F(v)
				local H = v and (v:FindFirstChild("Animate"))

				if H and (H:IsA("LocalScript")) then
					task.spawn(function()
						H.Enabled = false
						task.wait()
						H.Enabled = true
					end)
				end
			end

			local function v()
				for H, H in ipairs(x.Links) do
					pcall(function()
						H:Disconnect()
					end)
				end

				table.clear(x.Links)
			end

			tbl4.UndoSwap = function()
				v()
				local H, D, Q = localPlayer.Character, x.Original, x.Clone
				x.Original = nil
				x.Clone = nil

				if D and Q and H and D.Parent == nil and Q.Parent == H then
					D.Parent = H
					workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = D
					K(D)

					pcall(function()
						Q:Destroy()
					end)

					F(H)
					j()
				end
			end

			local H = {
				[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running] = true,
				[Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics] = true,
				[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed] = true,
			}

			tbl4.Grounded = function(D)
				if not D then
					local Q = localPlayer.Character
					D = Q and (Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
				end

				if not D or D.Health <= 0 or D.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
					return false
				end
				return H[D:GetState()] == true
			end

			tbl4.ShieldPaused = false

			tbl4.WalkSpeed = function()
				local H = localPlayer.Character
				local D = H and (H:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
				local Q, p = D and D.WalkSpeed or 16, x.Original
				Q = (if p and p.Health > 0 then (math.min(Q, p.WalkSpeed)) else Q)

				H, D = pcall(function()
					local p = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
					local C = p and (p:FindFirstChild("Speed"))
					return C and (require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.TreadmillUtil).SpeedPowerToWalkSpeed(C.Value)) or nil
				end)

				return (if H and (tonumber(D)) and D > 0 then (math.min(Q, D)) else Q)
			end

			local function H()
				local D = localPlayer.Character
				local Q = D and (D:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
				if not Q or Q.Health <= 0 then
					return
				end

				if x.Clone and x.Clone.Parent == D then
					return
				end

				if not tbl4.Grounded(Q) then
					return
				end
				local p = Q:Clone()
				Q.Parent = nil
				p.Parent = D
				workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = p
				K(p)
				F(D)
				x.Original = Q
				x.Clone = p
				j()

				table.insert(x.Links, Q:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
					if p.Parent ~= nil then
						p.WalkSpeed = Q.WalkSpeed
					end
				end))

				local F, D = Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator"), p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

				if F and D then
					table.insert(x.Links, F.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(F)
						local C = F.Animation
						if not C or p.Parent == nil then
							return
						end

						local S, e = pcall(function()
							return D:LoadAnimation(C)
						end)

						if not S or not e then
							return
						end

						pcall(function()
							e.Priority = F.Priority
							e.Looped = F.Looped
							e:Play(0.05, math.max(F.WeightTarget, 0.01), F.Speed)
						end)

						local D

						D = F.Stopped:Connect(function()
							D:Disconnect()

							pcall(function()
								e:Stop(0.1)
							end)
						end)
					end))
				end

				table.insert(x.Links, p.Died:Connect(function()
					v()
					x.Original = nil
					x.Clone = nil
					local F = localPlayer.Character

					if F and Q.Parent == nil then
						Q.Parent = F
						workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = Q
						K(Q)
						j()
					end

					pcall(function()
						p:Destroy()
					end)

					Q.Health = 0
				end))
			end

			local function K()
				if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then
					return
				end
				local j = ipairs
				local F = { RunService.Heartbeat, RunService.PreSimulation, RunService.PostSimulation }

				for D, Q in j(F) do
					local j, F = pcall(getconnections, Q)

					if j and type(F) == "table" then
						for j, p in ipairs(F) do
							Q, j = pcall(function()
								return p.Function
							end)

							local F, C = false

							if Q and type(j) == "function" then
								F, C = pcall(debug.info, j, "s")
							end

							if F and (string.find(tostring(C), "UGI", 1, true)) then
								D, j = pcall(function()
									return p.Enabled
								end)

								if not D or j ~= false then
									if pcall(function()
										p:Disable()
									end) then
										table.insert(n, p)
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local function j()
				if m then
					m:Disconnect()
					m = nil
				end

				if O then
					O:Disconnect()
					O = nil
				end

				for F, F in ipairs(n) do
					pcall(function()
						F:Enable()
					end)
				end

				table.clear(n)
			end

			local function n()
				if tbl4.ShieldPaused then
					return
				end

				if r == t[1] then
					H()
				else
					K()
				end
			end

			local function K()
				n()
				u = 0

				m = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(F)
					u += F
					F = localPlayer.Character
					local H = r == t[1] and not (x.Clone and F and x.Clone.Parent == F)

					if u >= (H and 0.25 or 3) then
						u = 0
						n()
					end
				end)

				O = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(u)
					v()
					x.Original = nil
					x.Clone = nil
					if r ~= t[1] then
						return
					end

					task.spawn(function()
						u:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
						task.wait(1)

						if m and localPlayer.Character == u then
							n()
						end
					end)
				end)
			end

			tbl4.Toggle = function(t, r)
				if type(t) ~= "table" then
					return r == true
				end

				local l, n = pcall(function()
					local m = t._controller
					return type(m) == "table" and type(m.GetValue) == "function" and (m.GetValue())
				end)

				if l and type(n) == "boolean" then
					return n
				end
				n = { "Get", "GetValue" }

				for m, u in ipairs(n) do
					m, l = pcall(function()
						return t[u]
					end)

					if m and type(l) == "function" then
						local n, m = pcall(l, t)
						if n and type(m) == "boolean" then
							return m
						end
					end
				end

				return r == true
			end

			local function t()

			tbl4.Plot = function()
				local r = tbl4.OwnPlot()
				if r then
					return r
				end
				local l, n = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots"), t()
				if not l or not n then
					return nil
				end
				local t, m = math.huge

				for u, x in ipairs(l:GetChildren()) do
					local l, O, K = pcall(function()
						return x:GetBoundingBox()
					end)

					if l and O and K then
						u = O:PointToObjectSpace(n)
						if math.abs(u.X) <= K.X / 2 and math.abs(u.Z) <= K.Z / 2 then
							return x
						end
						r = (O.Position - n).Magnitude

						if r < t then
							t, m = r, x
						end
					end
				end

				if m and t <= 60 then
					return m
				end
				return nil
			end

					return r
				end
				r = workspace:FindFirstChild("__ClientTreadmillRenders")
				local l = r and (r:FindFirstChild("TreadmillRender_" .. t.Name))
				r = l and (l:FindFirstChild("BoundingBoxPart") or l:IsA("Model") and l.PrimaryPart or (l:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")))
				if r then
					return r
				end
				r = t:FindFirstChild("TreadmillUpgrade")
				return r and (r:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or nil
			end

			tbl4.DistanceTo = function(t)

			local function l()
				local n = tbl4.Plot()
				if not n then
					return {}
				end
				local m, u = {}, { "TreadmillBottom", "TreadmillUpgrade" }

				for x, O in ipairs(u) do
					x = n:FindFirstChild(O)

					if x then
						if x:IsA("BasePart") then
							table.insert(m, x)
						else
							for O, O in ipairs(x:GetDescendants()) do
								if O:IsA("BasePart") then
									table.insert(m, O)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				u = workspace:FindFirstChild("__ClientTreadmillRenders")
				local x = u and (u:FindFirstChild("TreadmillRender_" .. n.Name))

				if x then
					for n, n in ipairs(x:GetDescendants()) do
						if n:IsA("BasePart") then
							table.insert(m, n)
						end
					end
				end

				return m
			end

			local function n()
				for m, m in ipairs(l()) do
					if not t[m] then
						t[m] = {
							CFrame = m.CFrame,
							CanTouch = m.CanTouch,
							CanCollide = m.CanCollide,
							Transparency = m.Transparency,
						}

						pcall(function()
							m.CanTouch = false
							m.CanCollide = false
							m.Transparency = 1
							m.CFrame = m.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, 120, 0)
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			local function l()
				for m, u in pairs(t) do
					if m and m.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							m.CFrame = u.CFrame
							m.CanTouch = u.CanTouch
							m.CanCollide = u.CanCollide
							m.Transparency = u.Transparency
						end)
					end
				end

				table.clear(t)
			end

			local t, r, l = {
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,

			tbl4.GodMode = function(n)
				local m = localPlayer.Character
				local u = m and (m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
				if not m or not u then
					return
				end

				if n then
					l = true

					for n, n in ipairs(t) do
						pcall(function()
							u:SetStateEnabled(n, false)
						end)
					end

					pcall(function()
						u.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
					end)

					for n, n in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
						if n:IsA("BasePart") and r[n] == nil then
							r[n] = n.CanCollide

							pcall(function()
								n.CanCollide = false
							end)
						end
					end
				elseif l then
					l = false

					for l, l in ipairs(t) do
						pcall(function()
							u:SetStateEnabled(l, true)
						end)
					end

					for t, l in pairs(r) do
						if t and t.Parent then
							pcall(function()
								t.CanCollide = l
							end)
						end
					end

					table.clear(r)
				end
			end

			tbl4.GodTick = function()
				local t = localPlayer.Character
				local r = t and (t:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

				if r and r.Health < r.MaxHealth then
					pcall(function()
						r.Health = r.MaxHealth
					end)
				end
			end

			tbl4.StopWalking = function()
				local t = localPlayer.Character
				local r, l = t and (t:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")), t and (t:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

				if l and r then
					pcall(function()

						l:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
					end)
				end
			end

			local function t(r, l, n, m)
				local u, x, O, K = tonumber(l) or 6, tonumber(n) or 10, 0
				n, l = 0, 0

				while O < x do
					if type(m) == "function" and (m()) then
						tbl4.StopWalking()
						return false
					end
					local m = localPlayer.Character

						return true
					end

							j.Jump = true
						end)

						n, l = 0, 1.5
					end

					O += task.wait(0.2)
				end

				tbl4.StopWalking()
				return tbl4.DistanceTo(r) <= u
			end

				tbl4.Driving = math.max(0, tbl4.Driving - 1)
				return u and x == true

do
	local __startCurrentFeature = function()
			local t
			local r = "None"
			local l = "Idle"

			tbl4.StealStatusText = function()
				return l
			end

			tbl4.StealTargetText = function()
				return r
			end

			local n, m, u, x = false, 0, {}

			local function O(K)
				return K ~= m or not tbl4.Toggle(t, false)
			end

			local K = {}
			local j = nil

			j = function(F)
				if type(F) ~= "number" or K[F] then
					return
				end
				K[F] = true

				task.delay(math.max(0, F - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) + 0.05, function()
					K[F] = nil
					tbl3.Wake()
				end)
			end

			local K = 0
			local F = nil

			F = function()
				local v = tbl.AreaEggCycle
				if type(v) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end

				local H, D, Q, p, C = pcall(function()
					local S = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
					return S, v.IsNightPhase(S), v.NextNightTime(S), v.NextResetTime(S)
				end)

				if not H or type(C) ~= "number" then
					return nil
				end

				if Q == true then
					K = C + tbl4.WallOpenDelay()
					j(K)
					return K, "night", D
				end

				if tbl4.WallSealed() then
					j(D + 0.3)
					return math.max(K, D), "wall", D
				end

				if type(p) == "number" and p > D then
					j(p)
				end

				return nil
			end

			do
				local K = tbl.AreaEggResetWall
				local j = type(K) == "table" and K.Changed or nil

				if j and type(j.Connect) == "function" then
					local K, v = pcall(function()
						return j:Connect(function()
							tbl3.Wake()
						end)
					end)

					if K and v then
						fn4(function()
							pcall(function()
								v:Disconnect()
							end)
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			local K
			local j = 0

			local function v(H)
				local D = {}
				local Q, p = "FirstAreaEgg_" .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId), tbl.EggState

				if type(p) == "table" and type(p.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
					task.spawn(function()
						local C, S = pcall(p.ReadFieldEggs)

						if C and type(S) == "table" and type(S.Records) == "table" then
							for p, p in pairs(S.Records) do
								if type(p) == "table" and type(p.Uid) == "string" and not (H and string.sub(p.Uid, 1, #Q) == Q) then
									D[p.Uid] = true
								end
							end
						end
					end)
				end

				return D
			end

			local function H()
				if K == nil then
					return false
				end

				if tbl4.IsNight() then
					return true
				end
				local D, Q = j, math.huge

				if D == Q then
					j = os.clock() + 8
				end

				return false
			end

			local function D()
				if K and j == math.huge then
					return
				end
				K = v(true)
				j = math.huge
				table.clear(tbl14)
				table.clear(tbl16)
				table.clear(tbl15)
				table.clear(u)
				x = nil
			end

			local function Q()
				if not K then
					return false
				end

				if os.clock() >= j then
					K = nil
					return false
				end
				local p = v()
				if next(p) == nil then
					return true
				end
				local v, C = false, false

				for S in pairs(p) do
					if K[S] then
						v = true
					else
						C = true
					end
				end

				if not v then
					K = nil
					return false
				end
				return not C
			end

			local function v(p)
				local C = tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory
				local S = type(C) == "table" and C[tostring(p)] or nil
				p = type(S) == "table" and type(S.Rarity) == "table" and S.Rarity or nil

				return {
					RarityNumber = p and (tonumber(p.RarityNumber or p.Rank)) or 0,
					EarningRate = type(S) == "table" and (tonumber(S.EarningRate)) or 0,
				}
			end

			local function p(C)
				local S = tbl.Mutations

				if type(S) == "table" and type(S.EarningsFor) == "function" then
					local e, w = pcall(S.EarningsFor, type(C) == "table" and C or {})
					if e and type(w) == "number" then
						return w
					end
				end

				return 1
			end

			local function C(S, e)
				local w = tbl.EggRecords

				if type(w) == "table" and type(w.WeightKgForScale) == "function" then
					local Y, P = pcall(w.WeightKgForScale, S, e)
					if Y and type(P) == "number" then
						return P
					end
				end

				return 0
			end

			local function S(e, w)
				local Y
				local P = tbl.EggState

				if type(P) == "table" and type(P.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
					task.spawn(function()
						local W, R = pcall(P.ReadFieldEggs)
						local P = W and type(R) == "table" and type(R.Records) == "table" and next(R.Records) ~= nil

						if P then
							Y = R.Records
						end
					end)
				end

				if not Y then
					local P = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFieldEggSnapshot")
					if not P or not P:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
						return {}
					end
					local W, R = pcall(P.InvokeServer, P)
					Y = W and type(R) == "table" and R.Records or nil
				end

				if type(Y) ~= "table" then
					return {}
				end
				local P = {}
				local W = {}

				for R, V in pairs(Y) do
					R = type(V) == "table" and V.Uid or nil

					if R and V.State ~= "Claimed" then
						W[R] = true
					end

					local Y = tbl4.Steal.Carrying and R == tbl4.Steal.CarryUid
					local z = V.State == "Carried" and w == true and e ~= true and not Y
					z = R and (V.State == "Slot" or V.State == "Dropped" or z)
					local w = R and tbl14[R] or nil
					local i = R and tbl15[R] == true or false
					local A = e ~= true and tbl4.StealFilters.MissingIndex and R and tbl4.StealFilters.IndexMissing[tostring(V.AssetCategory)] or nil
					local h = e ~= true and tbl4.Steal.RiftPriority == true and R ~= nil and tbl4.Steal.RiftNeeds[tostring(V.AssetCategory)] == true
					local c, b, M = e == true or w ~= nil or i or h or A ~= nil or tbl4.StealFilters.Areas[tostring(V.AreaId)] == true, e ~= true and w == nil and tbl16[R] == true, K ~= nil and K[R] == true

					if z and typeof(V.BottomCFrame) == "CFrame" and (u[R] or 0) <= os.clock() and c and not b and not M then
						local z, c = v(V.AssetCategory), tostring(V.AssetCategory)
						local v = z.RarityNumber >= tbl4.StealFilters.MinRarity
						local b, M, Z = next(tbl4.StealFilters.Specific) == nil or tbl4.StealFilters.Specific[c] == true, tonumber(V.AssetScale) or 1, p(V.Mutations)
						local p = M > 5 and (M / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or M ^ 1.85
						Y = tbl4.StealFilters.MinValue <= 0 or z.EarningRate * p * Z >= tbl4.StealFilters.MinValue
						Y = v and b and Y
						b, v = h and not Y and not i and w == nil and A == nil, e ~= true and (tbl4.SafeCarry.Unsafe({ Uid = R, Category = c }))

						if v then
							tbl14[R] = nil
							tbl15[R] = nil
							tbl4.SafeCarry.LastSkip = v
						elseif e == true or w or i or h or A ~= nil or Y then
							table.insert(P, {
								Uid = R,
								Category = c,
								Scale = M,
								State = V.State,
								Rarity = z.RarityNumber,
								Weight = C(V.AssetCategory, M),
								Mutation = Z,
								Value = z.EarningRate * p * Z,
								CFrame = V.BottomCFrame,
								AreaId = tostring(V.AreaId),
								Rift = e ~= true and h,
								RiftOnly = e ~= true and b,
								RiftNow = e ~= true and b and tbl4.Steal.RiftCurrent[c] == true,
								Index = A,
								Forced = e ~= true and w and w.At or nil,
								Priority = e ~= true and i,
								Passed = Y and tbl4.StealFilters.Areas[tostring(V.AreaId)] == true,
							})
						end
					end
				end

				if next(W) ~= nil then
					for v in pairs(tbl14) do
						if not W[v] then
							tbl14[v] = nil
						end
					end

					for v in pairs(tbl15) do
						if not W[v] then
							tbl15[v] = nil
						end
					end

					for v in pairs(tbl16) do
						if not W[v] then
							tbl16[v] = nil
						end
					end
				end

				table.sort(P, function(v, p)
					if v.Forced ~= nil ~= (p.Forced ~= nil) then
						return v.Forced ~= nil
					end

					if v.Forced and p.Forced and v.Forced ~= p.Forced then
						return v.Forced < p.Forced
					end

					if v.Priority ~= p.Priority then
						return v.Priority == true
					end
					local C, e = tbl4.Priority.StealRank(v), tbl4.Priority.StealRank(p)
					if C ~= e then
						return C < e
					end

					if v.RiftOnly and p.RiftOnly and v.RiftNow ~= p.RiftNow then
						return v.RiftNow == true
					end

					if v.Index ~= nil ~= (p.Index ~= nil) then
						return v.Index ~= nil
					end

					if v.Index and p.Index and v.Index ~= p.Index then
						return v.Index > p.Index
					end

					if tbl4.StealSort == tbl11[2] and v.Weight ~= p.Weight then
						return v.Weight > p.Weight
					elseif tbl4.StealSort == tbl11[3] and v.Mutation ~= p.Mutation then
						return v.Mutation > p.Mutation
					elseif tbl4.StealSort == tbl11[4] and v.Value ~= p.Value then
						return v.Value > p.Value
					elseif tbl4.StealSort == tbl11[5] and v.Value ~= p.Value then
						return v.Value < p.Value
					end

					if v.Rarity ~= p.Rarity then
						return v.Rarity > p.Rarity
					end

					if v.Value ~= p.Value then
						return v.Value > p.Value
					end
					return tostring(v.Uid) < tostring(p.Uid)
				end)

				return P
			end

			local v, p

			local function C(e, w, Y, P, W)
				local R = w - e.Position
				local w, V, z = R.Magnitude, math.max(P, 0.004166666666666667), Vector3.zero

				if w > 0.01 then
					z = R.Unit * math.min(Y, w / V)
				end

				z += Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * V * 0.5, 0)

				if w > 2 then
					if not W.mark then
						W.mark = w
						W.clock = 0
					end

					W.clock = W.clock + P

					if W.clock >= 0.4 then
						if W.mark - w < Y * 0.1 then
							pcall(function()
								e.CFrame = e.CFrame + R.Unit * math.min(w, Y * V)
							end)
						end

						W.mark = w
						W.clock = 0
