					end
				end

				if not g and not V(b.Uid, N) then
					if q then
						q.Stop()
					end

					u[b.Uid] = os.clock() + 20
					l = "That egg would not come free"
					return false
				end

				if q then
					local z, Z = networking:FindFirstChild("RE/GuardPatrol/ForestStrike"), o(b) or (o({ AreaId = "Forest" }))
					local N = Z and (Z:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))

					if z and (z:IsA("RemoteEvent")) and N then
						l = "Calling the guard strike"

						pcall(function()
							z:FireServer({ EggUid = b.Uid, GuardCFrame = N.CFrame })
						end)
					end
				end

				tbl4.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
				return true, q
			end

			local z, b = math.huge, math.huge

			local function Z(N, q, T)
				local s, g, _ = q

				for k, L in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if L.Name == "SmartPromptPart" and (L:IsA("BasePart")) then
						k = L:FindFirstChild("CarryAreaEgg")

						if k and (k:IsA("ProximityPrompt")) then
							q = (L.Position - N).Magnitude

							if q < s then
								s, g, _ = q, k, L
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if g and _ and type(T) == "string" and not Y(_, T, N) then
					return nil
				end
				return g, _
			end

			local function Y(N)
				local q = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient")
				local T = workspace:FindFirstChild(N) or q and (q:FindFirstChild(N))
				if not T then
					return nil
				end

				q, N = pcall(function()
					return T:GetPivot().Position
				end)

				return q and N or nil
			end

			local function N(q)
				local T = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFieldEggSnapshot")
				if not T or not T:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
					return nil
				end
				local s, g = pcall(T.InvokeServer, T)
				T = s and type(g) == "table" and g.Records or nil
				if type(T) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end

				for s, s in pairs(T) do
					if type(s) == "table" and s.Uid == q and typeof(s.BottomCFrame) == "CFrame" then
						return s.BottomCFrame.Position, true
					end
				end

				return nil, true
			end

			local function q(T)
				local s = workspace:FindFirstChild(T)
				if not s then
					return false
				end

				for g, g in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do
					if g:IsA("JointInstance") or (g:IsA("WeldConstraint")) or (g:IsA("RigidConstraint")) then
						local _, k, L = pcall(function()
							return g.Part0, g.Part1
						end)

						if _ then
							T = { k, L }

							for g, _ in ipairs(T) do
								if typeof(_) == "Instance" and not _:IsDescendantOf(s) then
									g = _:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
									if g and g ~= localPlayer.Character and (Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(g)) then
										return true
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return false
			end

			local function T(s, g)
				local _ = g or tbl4.Steal.CarryUid
				if type(_) ~= "string" then
					return false
				end
				P()
				l = "Following the egg"
				local k
				local L = Vector3.zero

				local B, E, J, y, G, dm, tm = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(rm)
					local lm = tbl4.Root()
					if not lm or not k or tbl4.Steal.Carrying or (O(s)) then
						return
					end

					if W() then
						if not tbl4.SafeCarry.Enabled and (lm.Position - k).Magnitude > 2 then
							C(k)
						end

						return
					end

					local C = math.max(rm, 0.004166666666666667)
					local W, rm = L + (k - lm.Position) / math.max(0.08, C), tbl4.SafeCarry.Enabled and (tbl4.SafeCarry.Pace()) or 400 + L.Magnitude

					if W.Magnitude > rm then
						W = W.Unit * rm
					end

					W += Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * C * 0.5, 0)

					pcall(function()
						lm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = W
						lm.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end), 0, false, 0, math.huge

				local C, W = 0, math.huge

				while E < b do
					if O(s) then
						break
					end
					g = J

					if tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
						local b = tbl4.Steal.WrongEgg

						if b(_) then
							l = "Picked up the wrong egg, dropped it"
						else
							J = true
							break
						end
					end

					local b = tbl4.Root()
					if not b then
						J = g
						break
					end
					local s = Y(_)

					if s then
						y = 0
					elseif G >= 0.5 then
						G = 0
						local Y
						s, Y = N(_)

						if s then
							y = 0
						elseif Y then
							y += 1
							if y >= 4 then
								l, J = "The egg is gone", g
								break
							end
						end
					end

					if s then
						local Y = os.clock()

						if dm and tm and Y > tm then
							local g = (s - dm) / math.max(Y - tm, 0.004166666666666667)

							if g.Magnitude < 3000 then
								L = L:Lerp(g, 0.3)
							end
						end

						k, dm, tm = s + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), s, Y
					end

					if C >= 0.4 then
						l, C = (if q(_) then "Another player has the egg, following it until it drops" else "Egg dropped, taking it back"), 0
					end

					if k and (k - b.Position).Magnitude <= 20 and W >= 0.1 then
						local Y = Z(k - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 6, _)

						if Y then
							pcall(function()
								Y.HoldDuration = 0
							end)

							if typeof(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
								pcall(fireproximityprompt, Y)
							end

							W = 0
						else
							task.spawn(p, _)
							W = 0
						end
					end

					s = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					E += s
					W += s
					G, C = G + s, C + s
				end

				B:Disconnect()
				e()
				return J or tbl4.Steal.Carrying == true
			end

			local function C(e, Y)
				local W = typeof(e.CFrame) == "CFrame" and e.CFrame.Position or nil
				if not W then
					return false
				end

				if tbl4.InsideBase() and not tbl4.InsideBase(W) then
					local b = M()

					if b then
						l = "Leaving the base through the safe zone"
						if not A(b + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Y, nil, 400) then
							return false
						end
					end
				end

				l = "Flying to the egg"
				if not A(W + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Y, nil, 400) then
					return false
				end
				l = "Taking the egg"
				W = U(e, Y, 0.6, nil)
				if not ((if not W and not O(Y) then (R(e, Y)) else W)) and not V(e.Uid, Y) then
					u[e.Uid] = os.clock() + 20
					return false
				end
				tbl4.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
				return true
			end

			local e = { Uid = nil, Freed = nil, Token = nil }

			local function Y()
				local W = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or (workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS"))
				local V = W and (W:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
				local b, Z = V and (V:FindFirstChild("GuardAreas")), tbl4.Root()
				if not b or not Z then
					return nil
				end
				local V, q, s, g = tostring(localPlayer.UserId), tbl4.Steal.CarryAreaId and (o({ AreaId = tostring(tbl4.Steal.CarryAreaId) })) or nil, math.huge

				for _, k in ipairs(b:GetChildren()) do
					local b = k:FindFirstChild("Guard")

					if b then
						if tostring(b:GetAttribute("TargetPlayer")) == V or tostring(b:GetAttribute("WakeTargetPlayer")) == V then
							return b
						end

						k, W = pcall(function()
							return b:GetPivot().Position
						end)

						if k then
							_ = (W - Z.Position).Magnitude

							if _ < s then
								s, g = _, b
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return q or g
			end

			local function W(V, b, Z)
				local q = Y()
				if not q then
					return false
				end
				local Y, s = f(V, Z + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)), 0

				while not Y.Landed and s < 20 and not O(V) do
					local f, g = pcall(function()
						return q:GetPivot().Position
					end)

					Z = tbl4.Root()
					if not f or not Z then
						break
					end

					if (g - Z.Position).Magnitude > 8 then
						f = Vector3.new(Z.Position.X - g.X, 0, Z.Position.Z - g.Z)
						local Z = g + (f.Magnitude > 0.1 and f.Unit * 3 or Vector3.zero)

						A(Vector3.new(Z.X, g.Y + 3, Z.Z), V, nil, 400, true, function()
							if Y.Landed then
								return "hit"
							end
							return nil
						end)
					end

					s += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				Y.Stop()
				if not Y.Landed then
					return false
				end
				return T(V, b)
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.Dangers = {}
			tbl4.SafeCarry.DangerAt = 0

			tbl4.SafeCarry.RefreshDangers = function()
				local Y = tbl4.SafeCarry
				if os.clock() - Y.DangerAt < 1 then
					return Y.Dangers
				end
				Y.DangerAt = os.clock()
				local V = {}

				local function b(Z)
					local f, q, s = pcall(function()
						if Z:IsA("Model") then
							return Z:GetBoundingBox()
						end

						if Z:IsA("BasePart") then
							return Z.CFrame, Z.Size
						end
					end)

					if f and q and s then
						local f = Vector3.new(math.abs(s.X), 0, math.abs(s.Z)) * 0.5
						local s = (q - q.Position):VectorToWorldSpace(f)
						local g, _ = math.max(math.abs(s.X), f.X, f.Z), math.max(math.abs(s.Z), f.X, f.Z)

						table.insert(V, {
							MinX = q.Position.X - g,
							MaxX = q.Position.X + g,
							MinZ = q.Position.Z - _,
							MaxZ = q.Position.Z + _,
							Name = Z.Name,
						})
					end
				end

				local function Z(f)
					if f == "ScrambleLocalVisuals" or f == "DrScrambleEvent" then
						return false
					end
					local q = string.lower(f)
					return string.find(q, "portal", 1, true) or (string.find(q, "teleport", 1, true)) or (string.find(q, "mech", 1, true)) or (string.find(q, "arena", 1, true)) or (string.find(q, "scramble", 1, true))
				end

				for f, f in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if (f:IsA("Model") or (f:IsA("BasePart")) or (f:IsA("Folder"))) and (Z(f.Name)) then
						if f:IsA("Folder") then
							for q, q in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
								b(q)
							end
						else
							b(f)
						end
					end
				end

				local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("World")
				local q = f and (f:FindFirstChild("Build"))

				if q then
					for f, f in ipairs(q:GetChildren()) do
						if Z(f.Name) then
							for Z, Z in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
								b(Z)
							end
						end
					end
				end

				Y.Dangers = V
				return V
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.Avoid = function(Y, V)
				for b, Z in ipairs(tbl4.SafeCarry.RefreshDangers()) do
					local f, q, s, g, _, k, L = Z.MinX - 12, Z.MaxX + 12, Z.MinZ - 12, Z.MaxZ + 12, V.X - Y.X, V.Z - Y.Z, ipairs
					local B, E, J, y = { { Y.X, _, f, q }, { Y.Z, k, s, g } }, true, 0, 1

					for G, dm in L(B) do
						_, b, G, k = dm[1], dm[2], dm[3], dm[4]

						if math.abs(b) < 1e-06 then
							E = (if _ < G or _ > k then false else E)
						else
							local dm, tm = (G - _) / b, (k - _) / b

							if dm > tm then
								dm, tm = tm, dm
							end

							J, y = math.max(J, dm), math.min(y, tm)
							E = (if J > y then false else E)
						end
					end

					if E and not (Y.X >= f and Y.X <= q and Y.Z >= s and Y.Z <= g) then
						L, _ = s - 2, g + 2
						b = math.abs(Y.Z - L) <= math.abs(Y.Z - _) and L or _
						b = (if b < -440 or b > -290 then b == L and _ or L else b)
						k, B = math.abs(Y.X - f) <= math.abs(Y.X - q) and f or q, math.abs
						return Vector3.new((if B(Y.Z - b) < 3 then math.abs(V.X - f) <= math.abs(V.X - q) and f or q else k), V.Y, b), Z.Name
					end
				end

				return V, nil
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.NewHuman = function(Y)
				local V, b = tbl4.SafeCarry

				b = {
					Clock = 0,
					Factor = 1,
					Target = 1,
					NextShift = 0,
					Phase = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2,
					Period = 2 + math.random() * 2.5,
					PauseUntil = 0,
					Lane = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * V.LaneOffset,
					Step = function(Z, f, q)
						b.Clock = b.Clock + Z

						if b.Clock >= b.NextShift then
							b.NextShift = b.Clock + 0.5 + math.random()
							local s = math.max(V.SpeedJitter, 0)

							if Y then
								b.Target = 1 - math.random() * s
							else
								b.Target = 1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * s
							end
						end

						b.Factor = b.Factor + (b.Target - b.Factor) * math.min(Z * 3, 1)
						local s = math.sin(b.Clock * 2 * 3.141592653589793 / b.Period + b.Phase) * V.Wobble

						if q and f and V.JumpsPerMinute > 0 and math.random() < V.JumpsPerMinute / 60 * Z then
							pcall(function()
								f.Jump = true
							end)
						end

						q = false

						if not Y then
							local Y, f = b.Clock, b.PauseUntil

							if Y < f then
								q = true
							elseif V.PausesPerMinute > 0 and math.random() < V.PausesPerMinute / 60 * Z then
								b.PauseUntil = b.Clock + 0.3 + math.random() * 0.9
								q = true
							end
						end

						return b.Factor, b.Lane + s, q
					end,
				}

				return b
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.React = function(Y, V)
				local b, Z = math.max(0, math.min(Y, V)), math.max(Y, V, 0)
				return b + math.random() * (Z - b)
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.RunTo = function(Y, V)
				local b, Z = tbl4.SafeCarry, typeof(Y.CFrame) == "CFrame" and Y.CFrame.Position or nil
				if not Z then
					return false
				end
				P()
				local f = localPlayer.Character
				local q = f and (f:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

				if q then
					q.PlatformStand = false

					if f:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool") then
						pcall(function()
							q:UnequipTools()
						end)
					end
				end

				local s, g = b.NewHuman(false), workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or (workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS"))
				f = g and (g:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
				g = f and (f:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine"))
				local _, k, L, B = g and (g:IsA("BasePart")) and g.Position.X or 552, M(), tbl4.Root(), "field"
				g = L and L.Position.Z or Z.Z

				if L and k and L.Position.X < _ - 2 then
					g = k.Z

					if (Vector3.new(L.Position.X, 0, L.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(k.X, 0, k.Z)).Magnitude > 20 then
						B = "safe"
					end
				end

				local E, J = math.clamp(g + s.Lane, -425, -300), Z.Y + 3

				local function y(G)
					local dm, tm = tbl4.Root(), localPlayer.Character
					if not dm or not tm or math.abs(dm.Position.Y - G) < 1 or math.abs(dm.Position.Y - G) > b.SnapLimit then
						return false
					end

					pcall(function()
						tm:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(dm.Position.X, G, dm.Position.Z)) * dm.CFrame.Rotation)
						dm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(dm.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, dm.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
					end)

					return true
				end

				local function G()
					if b.RunHeight <= 0.5 then
						return
					end
					y(J + b.RunHeight)
				end

				if B == "field" then
					G()
				end

				g = os.clock()

				local function dm(tm, rm, lm, nm)
					local mm = Vector3.new(rm.X - tm.Position.X, 0, rm.Z - tm.Position.Z)
					local um = mm.Magnitude
					local xm = um > 0.01 and mm.Unit or Vector3.zero

					if b.RunHeight > 0.5 and B == "field" and not nm then
						mm = tbl4.WalkSpeed()
						local Om, Km, jm = math.max(mm * b.RunSpeed * lm, 8), math.clamp(b.ClimbShare, 0.1, 0.9), Vector3.new(Z.X - tm.Position.X, 0, Z.Z - tm.Position.Z).Magnitude

						if jm <= 3 then
							if y(J) then
								return
							end
						end

						rm = jm <= 3 and J or J + b.RunHeight
						if math.abs(rm - tm.Position.Y) > 2 and (y(rm)) then
							return
						end
						local y = math.clamp((rm - tm.Position.Y) / 0.12, -Om * Km, Om * Km)
						jm = math.sqrt(math.max(Om * Om - y * y, 0))
						local rm = xm * math.min(jm, um / 0.05)

						pcall(function()
							tm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(rm.X, y, rm.Z)
						end)

						return
					end

					pcall(function()
						if nm or um <= 0.01 then
							if q then
								if b.RunStyle == "Walk" then
									q:MoveTo(tm.Position)
								end

								q:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
							end

							if b.RunStyle ~= "Walk" then
								tm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, tm.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
							end
						elseif b.RunStyle == "Walk" then
							if q then
								q:MoveTo(tm.Position + xm * math.min(um, 30))
							end
						else
							local y = tbl4.WalkSpeed()
							local rm = math.max(y * b.RunSpeed * lm, 8)
							y = xm * math.min(rm, um / 0.05)
							tm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(y.X, tm.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, y.Z)

							if b.RunAnimate and q then
								q:Move(xm, false)
							end
						end
					end)
				end

				local y = (os.clock())
				local tm = (os.clock())
				local rm = L and L.Position or nil

				while os.clock() - g < 240 do
					if O(V) then
						return false
					end
					f = tbl4.Root()
					if not f then
						return false
					end
					_ = os.clock()
					local g, lm = math.max(_ - y, 0.004166666666666667), Vector3.new(Z.X - f.Position.X, 0, Z.Z - f.Position.Z)
					if B == "field" and lm.Magnitude <= 2.5 and (b.RunHeight <= 0.5 or f.Position.Y - J < 4) then
						y = _
						break
					end
					L = q and q.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
					local J, nm, mm = s.Step(g, q, L)
					mm = (if lm.Magnitude <= 15 then false else mm)
					g = Z

					if B == "safe" and k then
						if (Vector3.new(k.X, 0, k.Z) - Vector3.new(f.Position.X, 0, f.Position.Z)).Magnitude <= 6 then
							B = "field"
							G()
						end

						l, g = "Walking out to the safe zone", k
					else
						g, l = (if not b.StraightRun and b.RunHeight <= 0.5 and math.abs(Z.X - f.Position.X) > 25 then (Vector3.new(Z.X, Z.Y, math.clamp(E + nm, -425, -300))) else g), string.format("Running to the egg, %d studs left", math.floor(lm.Magnitude + 0.5))
					end

					nm, lm = b.Avoid(f.Position, g)

					if lm then
						l = "Walking around " .. tostring(lm)
					end

					dm(f, nm, J, mm)

					if _ - tm >= 1.5 then
						if not mm and rm and (f.Position - rm).Magnitude < 3 and q then
							pcall(function()
								q.Jump = true
							end)
						end

						tm, rm = _, f.Position
					end

					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					y = _
				end

				tm = tbl4.Root()

				if tm then
					dm(tm, tm.Position, 1, true)
				end

				local q

				if tm then
					_ = Vector3.new(tm.Position.X - Z.X, 0, tm.Position.Z - Z.Z)
					k = _.Magnitude > 0.1 and _.Unit * 2 or Vector3.zero
					q = Vector3.new(Z.X + k.X, tm.Position.Y, Z.Z + k.Z)
				end

				local Z = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					local g = tbl4.Root()
					if not g or not q or tbl4.Steal.Carrying or tbl4.AntiGuard.Busy then
						return
					end
					local k = Vector3.new(q.X - g.Position.X, 0, q.Z - g.Position.Z)

					pcall(function()
						if k.Magnitude > 1.5 then
							g.CFrame = CFrame.new(q.X, g.Position.Y, q.Z) * g.CFrame.Rotation
						end

						g.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.min(g.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
					end)
				end)

				local function q(g)
					Z:Disconnect()
					return g
				end

				E, y, f = o(Y), os.clock(), b.React(b.ReactMin, b.ReactMax)

				while true do
					if O(V) then
						return (q(false))
					end
					s, _, G = os.clock() - y, b.RunWait + f, not b.WaitGuard or not E or E:GetAttribute("GuardState") == "Sleeping"
					if s >= _ and (G or s >= _ + 15) then
						break
					end
					l = s < _ and (string.format("Waiting before the grab, %.1fs", _ - s)) or "Waiting for the guard to sleep"
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				l = "Taking the egg"
				rm = U(Y, V, 0.8, nil)
				rm = (if not rm and not O(V) then (R(Y, V)) else rm)
				q()
				if not rm then
					return false
				end
				tbl4.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
				return true
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.Pace = function()
				local Y = tonumber(tbl4.SafeCarry.RunSpeed) or 1
				return math.max(tbl4.WalkSpeed() * Y, 16)
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.Plan = function(Y, R, V)
				local b = tbl4.SafeCarry
				local Z = localPlayer.Character

				if Z then
					Z:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				end

				local f, U = tbl4.WalkSpeed(), V or b.Mult or 1
				V = f * b.CarryRatio * ((if b.SameSpeedBigEggs then (math.max(U, b.LightMult)) else U))
				Z, U = V * b.SpeedRatio, b.ExcessSeconds * V
				Z = (if R and R > U then (math.min(Z, V * R / (R - U))) else Z)
				f = tbl.Guards
				U = type(f) == "table" and type(f.Directory) == "table" and f.Directory[tostring(Y)] or nil
				Y = type(U) == "table" and (tonumber(U.WalkSpeed)) or 0
				if not b.BeatGuard then
					return math.max(math.min(V * b.EasyRatio, Z), V), true, V, Z, Y
				end
				U = math.max(Y + b.GuardMargin, V * b.MinRatio)
				f = math.max(U, Y * b.GuardRatio)

				if U > Z then
					local q, s = V * b.SpeedRatio, b.StretchSeconds * V
					q = (if R and R > s then (math.min(q, V * R / (R - s))) else q)
					s = Y + math.max(b.GuardMargin, 1)
					if s <= q then
						return s, true, V, q, Y
					end
				end

				return math.max(math.min(f, Z), V), U <= Z, V, Z, Y
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.Unsafe = function(Y)
				local R = tbl4.SafeCarry
				if not R.Enabled or type(Y) ~= "table" or not Y.Uid or not R.Blocked[Y.Uid] then
					return nil
				end
				return string.format("the guard caught you with this %s before, skipping it", tostring(Y.Category))
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.Settle = function(Y, R)
				local V = tbl4.SafeCarry
				local b = localPlayer.Character

				if b then
					b:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				end

				local Z, f = tbl4.WalkSpeed(), V.Seen[tostring(R.Category)] or V.GuessMult
				math.max(Z * V.CarryRatio * f * V.WaitRate, 1)
				Z, f = V.BaseWait, o(R)

				while true do
					if O(Y) then
						return false
					end
					b, R = os.clock() - (V.JumpAt or 0), not V.WaitGuard or not f or f:GetAttribute("GuardState") == "Sleeping"
					if b >= Z and (R or b >= Z + 15) then
						return true
					end
					l = (if b < Z then string.format("Letting the jump settle, %.1fs", Z - b) else "Waiting for the guard to sleep")
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
			end

			tbl4.MonitorAction = tbl4.MonitorAction or function(Y)
				local R, V = pcall(debug.getconstants, Y)
				if not R or type(V) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				for Y, Y in pairs(V) do
					if type(Y) == "string" and (Y == "Relocate" or Y == "SetWalkSpeed" or Y == "BeginRagdoll" or Y == "EndRagdoll" or Y == "BeginImpulse") then
						return true
					end
				end

				return false
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.LineDropHome = function(Y)
				local R, V = tbl4.SafeCarry, tbl4.Steal
				local b, Z, o = V.CarryUid, M(), tbl4.Root()
				if type(b) ~= "string" or not Z or not o then
					return false
				end
				local f = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or (workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS"))
				local U = f and (f:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
				f = U and (U:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine"))
				local q = f and (f:IsA("BasePart")) and f.Position.X or 552.2
				local s = f and (f:IsA("BasePart")) and f.Position.Y or 67.67
				local g = {}

				pcall(function()
					local _, k = ipairs, { RunService.Heartbeat, RunService.PreSimulation, RunService.PostSimulation }

					for L, B in _(k) do
						for _, k in ipairs(getconnections(B)) do
							_, L = pcall(function()
								return k.Function
							end)

							if _ and type(L) == "function" then
								local _, B = pcall(debug.info, L, "s")

								if _ and (string.find(tostring(B), "UGI", 1, true)) and not tbl4.MonitorAction(L) then
									local _, L = pcall(function()
										return k.Enabled
									end)

									if not _ or L ~= false then
										if pcall(function()
											k:Disable()
										end) then
											table.insert(g, k)
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)

				local _, k = false

				pcall(function()
					k = networking["RE/RigSync/Refresh"].OnClientEvent:Connect(function(L)
						local B = type(L) == "table" and L.Action == "Relocate"

						if B then
							_ = true
						end
					end)
				end)

				local L, B = workspace.CurrentCamera

				local function E()
					if not R.LockCamera or B or not L then
						return
					end
					B = { Type = L.CameraType, CFrame = L.CFrame }

					pcall(function()
						L.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
						L.CFrame = B.CFrame
					end)
				end

				local function J()
					if not B or not L then
						return
					end
					local y = B
					B = nil

					pcall(function()
						L.CameraType = y.Type
					end)
				end

				local function L()
					J()

					if k then
						k:Disconnect()
						k = nil
					end

					for k, k in ipairs(g) do
						pcall(function()
							k:Enable()
						end)
					end

					table.clear(g)
				end

				local g = os.clock()

				local function k(B)
					local y = tbl4.Root()
					if not y then
						return false
					end

					pcall(function()
						y.CFrame = CFrame.new(Z) * y.CFrame.Rotation
						y.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						y.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)

					local Z = 0

					while Z < 1 and not O(Y) do
						if B and (B()) then
							return true
						end
						Z += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					return false
				end

				P()
				local Z = math.clamp(o.Position.Z, -425, -300)
				local B, y = Vector3.new(q + (R.Hops and R.HopStop or R.LineGap), s + 3.35, Z), o.Position.X

				local function y()
					local G = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFieldEggSnapshot")

					local dm, tm = pcall(function()
						return G:InvokeServer()
					end)

					local G = dm and type(tm) == "table" and tm.Records or nil

					if type(G) == "table" then
						for dm, dm in pairs(G) do
							if type(dm) == "table" and dm.Uid == b then
								return dm
							end
						end
					end

					return nil
				end

				local function G()
					local dm, tm = pcall(function()
						return localPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
					end)

					tm = dm and (tonumber(tm)) or nil
					return tm and (math.clamp(tm, 0, 2)) or 0.2
				end

				local function dm(tm)
					local rm = G()

					if not tm then
						local G = 0

						while G < R.DropDelay + rm and V.Carrying and not O(Y) do
							G += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end

						if not V.Carrying then
							return false
						end
						G = tbl.EggState

						if type(G) == "table" and type(G.DropFieldEgg) == "function" then
							pcall(G.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
						end

						G = 0

						while V.Carrying and G < 1 + rm * 2 and not O(Y) do
							G += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end

						if V.Carrying then
							return true
						end
					end

					rm = os.clock()
					local G
					local lm, nm = _ == true, math.clamp(tbl4.WalkSpeed() * R.BackRunRatio, 1200, R.BackRunMax)
					_ = false
					local mm, um = 0, rm

					while not V.Carrying and not O(Y) do
						local xm, Om, Km, jm = os.clock(), workspace:FindFirstChild(b), false

						if Om and (Om:IsA("Model")) then
							Km, jm = pcall(Om.GetPivot, Om)
						end

						if Km and typeof(jm) == "CFrame" then
							G = jm.Position
						elseif xm - mm >= 1 then
							G, mm = N(b) or G, xm
						end

						if xm - rm >= 0.5 and xm - um >= 1 then
							Om = y()
							if Om and Om.State == "Slot" then
								l = "Line Drop: the egg went back to its nest"
								return false
							end

							if not Om and not G and xm - rm > 5 then
								l = "Line Drop: the egg is gone"
								return false
							end
							um = xm
						end

						if _ then
							_, lm = false, true
						end

						local rm = tbl4.Root()

						if rm and G then
							Km = Vector3.new(G.X - rm.Position.X, 0, G.Z - rm.Position.Z)
							tm = Km.Magnitude

							if tm > 6 then
								if lm then
									l = string.format("Line Drop: running back to the egg, %d studs", math.floor(tm + 0.5))
									local lm = Km.Unit * math.min(math.clamp(tm * 4, tbl4.WalkSpeed(), nm), tm / 0.05)

									pcall(function()
										rm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(lm.X, rm.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, lm.Z)
									end)
								else
									l = string.format("Line Drop: teleporting to the egg, %d studs", math.floor(tm + 0.5))

									pcall(function()
										rm.CFrame = CFrame.new(G + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
										rm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
										rm.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
									end)
								end
							else
								l = "Line Drop: grabbing the egg back"
							end
						end

						task.spawn(p, b)
						task.wait(0.05)
					end

					local G = tbl4.Root()

					if G then
						pcall(function()
							G.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, G.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
						end)
					end

					nm = V.Carrying and not V.WrongEgg(b)

					if nm then
						R.RegrabbedAt = os.clock()
					end

					return nm
				end

				f, U = Vector3.new(o.Position.X - q, 0, o.Position.Z - Z).Magnitude, math.max(tbl4.WalkSpeed() * R.CarryRatio * (tonumber(R.Mult) or R.LightMult), 1)
				s = math.max(0, (f - R.DirectBudget) / U) + R.DirectMargin
				s = (if R.CrossNow then R.DirectMargin else s)

				local function G()
					local tm = tbl4.Root()
					if not tm then
						return
					end

					pcall(function()
						tm.CFrame = CFrame.new(B) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
						tm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						tm.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end

				E()

				if R.Hops then
					o = tbl4.Root()

					if o then
						local tm, rm, lm = o.Position.Y + R.HopLift, o.Position.X, tbl4.WalkSpeed()
						U, f = math.max(lm * R.HopRatio, 40), {}

						for nm, nm in ipairs(R.MidDrops or {}) do
							table.insert(f, rm - (rm - B.X) * nm)
						end

						E = 1

						while rm - U > B.X and not O(Y) do
							if not V.Carrying then
								l = "Line Drop: the server dropped the egg, grabbing it back"
								if not dm(true) then
									break
								end
								lm = tbl4.Root()

								if lm then
									rm = lm.Position.X
								end

								if rm - U <= B.X then
									break
								end
							end

							rm -= U
							l = string.format("Line Drop: hopping home, X %d", math.floor(rm))

							if f[E] and rm <= f[E] then
								E += 1
								l = string.format("Line Drop: dropping and grabbing the egg again (%d/%d)", E - 1, #f + 1)
								local lm = tbl4.Root()

								if lm then
									pcall(function()
										lm.CFrame = CFrame.new(rm, B.Y, Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
										lm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
										lm.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
									end)
								end

								if V.Carrying then
									if not dm() then
										break
									end
									local lm = tbl4.Root()

									if lm then
										rm = lm.Position.X
									end

									lm = 0

									while lm < R.MidRest and not O(Y) do
										lm += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
									end
								end
							end

							local lm = 0

							while lm < R.HopGap do
								local nm = tbl4.Root()

								if nm then
									pcall(function()
										nm.CFrame = CFrame.new(rm, tm, Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
										nm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
										nm.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
									end)
								end

								lm += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if R.Hops and not V.Carrying and not O(Y) then
					l = "Line Drop: the server dropped the egg, grabbing it back"
					dm(true)
				end

				l = "Line Drop: landing next to the line"
				G()
				U = false

				if R.Hops and V.Carrying then
					l = "Line Drop: dropping the egg next to the line"
					E = os.clock()

					for tm = 1, 8, 1 do
						if not dm() or not V.Carrying or (O(Y)) then
							break
						end
						o = tbl4.Root()
						if o and math.abs(o.Position.X - B.X) <= 30 then
							U = (R.RegrabbedAt or 0) >= E
							break
						end
						l = "Line Drop: back to the line with the egg"
						G()
					end
				end

				J()

				if U and not O(Y) then
					l = "Line Drop: stepping over the line"

					k(function()
						return R.LastDelivered >= g or not V.Carrying
					end)

					E = 0

					while E < 2 and R.LastDelivered < g and V.Carrying and not O(Y) do
						E += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					if R.LastDelivered >= g then
						L()
						return true
					end
				end

				if R.ShakeTime > 0 then
					local J, tm, rm = Vector3.new(q - R.ShakeInside, B.Y, Z), false, 0

					while rm < R.ShakeTime and V.Carrying and not O(Y) do
						l = "Line Drop: shaking at the line"
						tm = not tm
						local Z = tbl4.Root()

						if Z then
							pcall(function()
								Z.CFrame = CFrame.new(tm and J or B) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
								Z.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							end)
						end

						rm += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					G()
				end

				o, dm, f = s < R.LineWait, 0, 1

				while V.Carrying and dm < R.LineWait and not (o and dm >= s) and not O(Y) do
					l = (if o then string.format("Line Drop: stepping over the line in %.1fs", math.max(s - dm, 0)) else string.format("Line Drop: crossing needs %.1fs, waiting for the guard, %.0fs left", s, R.LineWait - dm))

					if _ and R.ReJump and f < 40 and not i() then
						_ = false
						f += 1
						l = "Line Drop: pulled back, jumping to the line again"
						G()
					end

					dm += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				if V.Carrying and o and dm >= s and not O(Y) then
					l = "Line Drop: stepping over the line"

					k(function()
						return R.LastDelivered >= g or not V.Carrying
					end)

					U = 0

					while U < 1.5 and R.LastDelivered < g and V.Carrying and not O(Y) do
						U += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					if R.LastDelivered >= g then
						L()
						return true
					end
				end

				if V.Carrying then
					L()
					l = "Line Drop: the guard never came, dropping the egg"
					dm = tbl.EggState

					if type(dm) == "table" and type(dm.DropFieldEgg) == "function" then
						pcall(dm.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
					end

					return false
				end

				if R.GetUp then
					task.spawn(function()
						local Z = 0

						while Z < 1.5 do
							local _ = localPlayer.Character
							local B = _ and (_:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

							if B then
								pcall(function()
									B.PlatformStand = false
									local _ = B:GetState()

									if _ == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or _ == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or _ == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
										B:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
									end
								end)
							end

							Z += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end
					end)
				end

				f = 0

				while not R.SnapPickup and not R.GetUp and (i()) and f < 6 and not O(Y) do
					l = "Line Drop: egg is down at the line, getting up"
					f += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				U = 0

				while not O(Y) and U < 4 do
					U += 1
					local Z = N(b)

					if not Z then
						L()
						l = "Line Drop: the egg is gone"
						return false
					end

					o = y()

					if o and o.State == "Slot" then
						L()
						l = "Line Drop: the egg went back to its nest"
						return false
					end

					l = "Line Drop: picking the egg up at the line"
					E = 2.5

					if R.SnapPickup then
						local o = tbl4.Root()

						if o then
							pcall(function()
								o.CFrame = CFrame.new(Z + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
								o.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							end)
						end

						E = 5
					else
						s, dm, G = math.clamp(tbl4.WalkSpeed() * R.BackRunRatio, 1200, R.BackRunMax), 0, 0

						while not V.Carrying and dm < 10 and not O(Y) do
							local o = tbl4.Root()
							if not o then
								break
							end
							f = Vector3.new(Z.X - o.Position.X, 0, Z.Z - o.Position.Z)
							local N = f.Magnitude
							if N <= 4 then
								break
							end
							local _ = N > 30 and (math.clamp(N * 4, tbl4.WalkSpeed(), s)) or tbl4.WalkSpeed() * R.PickupRatio
							local s = f.Unit * math.min(_, N / 0.05)

							pcall(function()
								o.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(s.X, o.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, s.Z)
							end)

							if N > 30 then
								l = string.format("Line Drop: running back to the egg, %d studs", math.floor(N + 0.5))
							end

							if os.clock() - G >= 0.1 then
								G = os.clock()
								task.spawn(p, b)
							end

							dm += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end

						local o = tbl4.Root()

						if o then
							pcall(function()
								o.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, o.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
							end)
						end
					end

					local o = 0

					while not V.Carrying and o < E and not O(Y) do
						task.spawn(p, b)

						if R.SnapPickup then
							local p = tbl4.Root()

							if p and Vector3.new(p.Position.X - Z.X, 0, p.Position.Z - Z.Z).Magnitude > 6 then
								pcall(function()
									p.CFrame = CFrame.new(Z + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
								end)
							end
						end

						o += task.wait(0.1)
					end

					if V.Carrying and not V.WrongEgg(b) then
						break
					end
				end

				if not V.Carrying then
					L()
					l = "Line Drop: could not pick the egg up again"
					return false
				end

				dm = tbl4.Root()

				if dm and dm.Position.X - q > R.FarFromLine then
					L()
					l = "Line Drop: egg ended up far from the line, carrying it home safely"
					return tbl4.SafeCarry.Home(Y)
				end

				l = "Line Drop: stepping over the line"

				k(function()
					return R.LastDelivered >= g or not V.Carrying
				end)

				local p = tbl4.Root()

				if p then
					pcall(function()
						p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, p.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
					end)
				end

				U = 0

				while U < 2 and R.LastDelivered < g and V.Carrying and not O(Y) do
					U += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				L()
				return R.LastDelivered >= g
			end

			tbl4.SafeCarry.Home = function(p)
				local Y, R, V = tbl4.SafeCarry, M(), tbl4.Root()
				if not R or not V then
					return false
				end
				P()
				V = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or (workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS"))
				local P = V and (V:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
				V = P and (P:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine"))
				local b = (V and (V:IsA("BasePart")) and V.Position.X or 552) - 7
				P = localPlayer.Character
				local Z = P and (P:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

				if Z then
					Z.PlatformStand = false
				end

				local o, f = os.clock(), 0

				local function U()
					local N = tbl4.Root()
					if not N then
						return
					end
					local q = (Vector3.new(N.Position.X, 0, N.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(R.X, 0, R.Z)).Magnitude + math.max(0, Y.Height) * 2
					local N, s, g, _, k = Y.Plan(tbl4.Steal.CarryAreaId, q, Y.Mult)
					N *= Y.CarryScale
					f = N
					Y.PlanOk = s
					Y.FloorSpeed = Y.BeatGuard and (math.min(k + math.max(Y.GuardMargin, 1), _)) or 0
					l = string.format("Carrying home at %d (carry %d, guard %d, max %d)%s", math.floor(N + 0.5), math.floor(g + 0.5), math.floor(k + 0.5), math.floor(_ + 0.5), s and "" or ", guard is faster, going at your max safe speed")
				end

				local function N()
					local q, s, g = math.max(0, Y.Height), tbl4.Root(), localPlayer.Character
					if q <= 0.5 or not s or not g then
						return
					end
					local _ = R.Y + q
					if s.Position.Y >= _ - 2 then
						return
					end
					local q = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(s.Position.X, _, s.Position.Z)) * s.CFrame.Rotation

					pcall(function()
						g:PivotTo(q)
						s.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						s.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end

				U()
				V, P = Y.NewHuman(true), tbl4.Root()
				local q, s = math.clamp((P and P.Position.Z or R.Z) + V.Lane, -425, -300), os.clock()

				if Y.CarryReact > 0 then
					P = os.clock() + Y.React(0, Y.CarryReact)

					while os.clock() < P and not O(p) do
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end

				if Y.CarryStyle ~= "Walk" then
					N()
				end

				P = 0

				while not O(p) do
					local g = tbl4.Root()
					if not g then
						return false
					end

					if not tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
						if Y.LastDelivered >= o then
							return true
						end
						task.wait(0.1)
						if Y.LastDelivered >= o then
							return true
						end

						if Y.LastFailed >= o then
							l = "Delivery was rewound, too fast for your speed"
							return false
						end

						if not Y.PlanOk and tbl4.Steal.CarryUid then
							Y.Blocked[tbl4.Steal.CarryUid] = true
							l = string.format("The guard caught you with %s, it is faster than your max safe speed, skipping this egg", tostring(Y.Category))
							return false
						end

						P += 1
						if P > Y.RecoverTries then
							l = "The egg is gone"
							return false
						end
						l = "Egg dropped, taking it back"
						if not T(p) then
							l = "Could not take the egg back"
							return false
						end
						local _ = 0

						while i() and _ < 4 and not O(p) do
							_ += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end

						o = math.min(o, os.clock())
						U()

						if Y.CarryStyle ~= "Walk" then
							N()
						end

						g = tbl4.Root()
						if not g then
							return false
						end
					end

					local U = os.clock()
					local N, _ = math.max(U - s, 0.004166666666666667), Y.CarryStyle == "Walk"
					local k, L = _ and 0 or (math.max(0, Y.Height)), Z and Z.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
					local B, E = V.Step(N, k <= 0.5 and Z or nil, L)
					N = math.clamp(q + E, -425, -300)
					E = g.Position.X > b + 2 and (Vector3.new(b, g.Position.Y, N)) or R
					L, N = Y.Avoid(g.Position, E)
					E = (if N then L else E)
					local V = Vector3.new(E.X - g.Position.X, 0, E.Z - g.Position.Z)
					if V.Magnitude < 2 and E == R then
						s = U
						break
					end
					L = math.max(f * B, Y.FloorSpeed or 0)
					L = (if os.clock() < (Y.SlowUntil or 0) then L * Y.SlowFactor else L)

					if _ then
						pcall(function()
							if Z and V.Magnitude > 0.01 then
								Z:MoveTo(g.Position + V.Unit * math.min(V.Magnitude, 30))
							end
						end)
					elseif k > 0.5 then
						local f, q, _ = math.clamp(Y.ClimbShare, 0.1, 0.9), R.Y, math.max(0, g.Position.X - b)
						B, N = k * math.sqrt(1 - f * f) / f, q + k
						local J = math.clamp((((if E == R or _ <= B then q + k * math.clamp((E == R and 0 or _) / math.max(B, 1), 0, 1) else N)) - g.Position.Y) / 0.12, -L * f, L * f)
						q = math.sqrt(math.max(L * L - J * J, 0))
						local R = V.Magnitude > 0.01 and V.Unit * math.min(q, V.Magnitude / 0.05) or Vector3.zero

						pcall(function()
							g.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(R.X, J, R.Z)
						end)
					else
						local R = V.Magnitude > 0.01 and V.Unit * math.min(L, V.Magnitude / 0.05) or Vector3.zero

						pcall(function()
							g.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(R.X, g.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, R.Z)

							if Y.RunAnimate and Z and V.Magnitude > 0.01 then
								Z:Move(V.Unit, false)
							end
						end)
					end

					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					s = U
				end

				if Z then
					pcall(function()
						local R = tbl4.Root()

						if Y.CarryStyle == "Walk" and R then
							Z:MoveTo(R.Position)
						end

						Z:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
					end)
				end

				b = 0

				while b < 2 and not O(p) do
					if Y.LastDelivered >= o then
						return true
					end

					if Y.LastFailed >= o then
						l = "Delivery was rewound, too fast for your speed"
						return false
					end

					if not tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
						break
					end
					b += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				if tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
					task.wait(0.2)
					P = tbl.EggState

					if type(P) == "table" and type(P.DropFieldEgg) == "function" then
						pcall(P.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
					end
				end

				return Y.LastDelivered >= o
			end

			local function p(Y)
				local P = tbl4.AntiGuard
				local R = tbl4.SafeCarry.LineDrop

				if P.Enabled and not R and not tbl4.BossPortalUp() then
					local V = 0

					while not P.Busy and V < 1 and not O(Y) do
						l = "Waiting for Anti Guard to start"
						V += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					local b, Z = P.Busy, 0

					while P.Busy and Z < 30 and not O(Y) do
						l = "Anti Guard is slipping past the guard"
						Z += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					if b then
						Z, V = 0, 0

						while Z < 10 and not O(Y) do
							local b, o, f = i(), pcall(tbl4.Steal.HeldByMe)
							f = o and f == true
							o = not b
							if o and not f then
								break
							end

							if o and f and not P.Busy then
								V += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
								if V >= 0.3 then
									break
								end
							else
								l = b and "The guard hit you, waiting until you can move" or "Waiting for Anti Guard to finish"
								V, Z = 0, Z + RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							end
						end

						local V, i = pcall(tbl4.Steal.HeldByMe)

						if V and not i then
							tbl4.Steal.Carrying = false
						end

						V, i = tbl4.SafeCarry, M()
						local b, Z = i and V.Enabled and V.CarryStyle ~= "Walk" and V.Height > 0.5 and i.Y + V.Height or nil, 0

						while Z < 0.8 and tbl4.Steal.Carrying and not O(Y) do
							l = Z < 0.6 and "Anti Guard done, rising up" or "Anti Guard done, getting ready"
							local o = tbl4.Root()

							if o and b then
								V = b - o.Position.Y
								local b = Z < 0.6 and (math.clamp(V / math.max(0.6 - Z, 0.1), -120, 120)) or (math.clamp(V / 0.2, -30, 30))

								pcall(function()
									o.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, b, 0)
								end)
							end

							Z += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end

						V, i = pcall(tbl4.Steal.HeldByMe)

						if V and not i then
							tbl4.Steal.Carrying = false
						else
							tbl4.SafeCarry.SlowUntil = os.clock() + 2
						end
					end
				end

				R = 0

				while not tbl4.Steal.Carrying and R < 0.6 and not O(Y) do
					l = "Checking the egg in hand"
					R += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				if not tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
					l = "The egg is gone, staying to look for it"
					if not T(Y) then
						l = "The egg is gone"
						return false
					end
				end

				if tbl4.SafeCarry.LineDrop then
					return tbl4.SafeCarry.LineDropHome(Y)
				end

				if tbl4.SafeCarry.Enabled then
					return tbl4.SafeCarry.Home(Y)
				end
				P, R = M(), tbl4.Root()
				if not P or not R then
					return false
				end

				local function V()
					if e.Uid and e.Freed and tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
						return "priority"
					end
					return nil
				end

				local i, b, M = math.max(R.Position.Y, P.Y) + 27.4, true, 0

				while true do
					R = tbl4.Root()
					if not R then
						return false
					end
					l = "Flying home"
					local Z = R.Position
					local o = math.max(i, Z.Y)
					local f, U = A(Vector3.new(Z.X + (P.X - Z.X) * 0.25, Z.Y + (o - Z.Y) * 0.7, Z.Z + (P.Z - Z.Z) * 0.25), Y, b, nil, nil, V)

					if f then
						f, U = A(Vector3.new(P.X, o, P.Z), Y, b, nil, nil, V)
					end

					if f then
						f, U = A(P, Y, b, nil, nil, V)
					end

					if f then
						break
					end

					if U == "priority" then
						Z, f = e.Uid, e.Freed
						e.Uid = nil
						e.Freed = nil
						o = tbl4.Root()
						if not o or not Z or not f then
							return false
						end

						if (f - o.Position).Magnitude <= 1200 then
							l = "Best egg fell nearby, swapping eggs"
							local V = tbl.EggState

							if type(V) == "table" and type(V.DropFieldEgg) == "function" then
								pcall(V.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
							end

							V = 0

							while tbl4.Steal.Carrying and V < 1 do
								V += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							end

							if not T(Y, Z) then
								return false
							end
						else
							l = "Best egg fell far away, riding a guard hit to it"
							if not W(Y, Z, f) then
								return false
							end
						end

						local W = tbl4.Root()
						i, b, M = (if W then math.max(W.Position.Y, P.Y) + 27.4 else i), true, 0
					elseif U == "dropped" and M < z then
						M += 1
						if not T(Y) then
							return false
						end
					else
						return false
					end
				end

				R = localPlayer.Character
				M = R and (R:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

				if M then
					M.PlatformStand = false
				end

				task.wait(0.2)
				if not tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
					l = "Arrived without the egg"
					return false
				end
				i = tbl.EggState

				if type(i) == "table" and type(i.DropFieldEgg) == "function" then
					pcall(i.DropFieldEgg, "PlayerRequest")
				end

				return true
			end

			local function Y(P)
				local W = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
				P = tonumber(P) or 0
				local R = 1

				while math.abs(P) >= 1000 and R < #W do
					P, R = P / 1000, R + 1
				end

				return string.format(R == 1 and "%.0f%s" or "%.2f%s", P, W[R])
			end

			local function P(W)
				if not W then
					return "None"
				end
				local R = string.format("%s  %.2fx  |  value %s  |  %s", tostring(W.Category), tonumber(W.Scale) or 0, Y(W.Value), tostring(W.AreaId))
				return (if W.State == "Dropped" then R .. "  |  dropped" else (if W.State == "Carried" then R .. "  |  carried by a player" else R))
			end

			local Y, W, R = false, 0, 0

			local function V()
				local z = m
				tbl4.Steal.Active = true
				tbl4.Steal.Carrying = tbl4.Steal.Carrying == true

				if not tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
					tbl4.Steal.CarryUid = nil
				end

				local i, A, b

				for M, Z in ipairs((S(false, true))) do
					if Z.State == "Carried" then
						A = A or Z
					elseif not tbl4.StockWaits(Z) then
						M = tbl4.SafeCarry.Unsafe(Z)

						if M then
							b = b or M
						else
							i = Z
							break
						end
					end
				end

				local M = { i }
				x = i and i.Uid or nil
				tbl4.Steal.Wanted = i ~= nil
				tbl4.Steal.TargetRank = i and (tbl4.Priority.StealRank(i)) or nil
				tbl4.Steal.WantedRank = tbl4.Steal.TargetRank
				r = P(i)

				if A then
					r ..= "  |  watching " .. tostring(A.Category)
				end

				if not i then
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					b = b or tbl4.SafeCarry.LastSkip
					tbl4.SafeCarry.LastSkip = nil
					l = A and "Best egg is carried, waiting for it" or b and "Skipped: " .. b or "No egg matches"
					return false
				end

				if not tbl4.ClaimMovement("steal") then
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					l = tbl4.InMechArena() and "In the Mech arena, waiting to be back home" or "Waiting for Auto Place"
					return false
				end

				if tbl4.InMechArena() then
					l = "Leaving the Mech arena first"

					if not (type(tbl4.MechLeave) == "function" and (tbl4.MechLeave()) or false) or z ~= m then
						tbl4.Steal.Active = false
						l = "Stuck in the Mech arena, waiting"
						return false
					end

					l = "Back from the Mech arena, settling before the steal"
					A = os.clock() + 2

					while os.clock() < A do
						if z ~= m then
							tbl4.Steal.Active = false
							return false
						end
						local r = tbl4.Root()

						if r then
							pcall(function()
								r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							end)
						end

						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					table.clear(u)
				end

				if tbl4.Treadmill.Riding or (tbl4.OnBelt()) then
					tbl4.ExitBelt()
				end

				Y = true
				tbl4.HoldBelt()

				local function r(P)
					l = P
					local P, Z, o = C(i, z), false

					if P then
						if h(i.Uid, z) then
							Z = (p(z))
						else
							o = l
						end
					end

					v()
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					tbl4.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
					l = Z and "Delivered" or o or (P and "Run ended" or "That egg would not come free")
					return true
				end

				local C = tbl4.Root()
				local P = typeof(i.CFrame) == "CFrame" and i.CFrame.Position or nil

				if C and P then
					if (P - C.Position).Magnitude <= 20 or localPlayer:GetAttribute("AreaId") == i.AreaId then
						return (r("Target is right here, taking it"))
					end
				end

				if tbl4.SafeCarry.Enabled and tbl4.SafeCarry.Approach == "Run" then
					A, b, P = tbl4.SafeCarry.RunTo(i, z), false

					if A then
						if h(i.Uid, z) then
							b = (p(z))
						else
							P = l
						end
					else
						u[i.Uid] = os.clock() + 20
					end

					v()
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					tbl4.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
					l = b and "Delivered" or P or (A and "Run ended" or "That egg would not come free")
					return true
				end

				P, b, A = S(true), "FirstAreaEgg_" .. tostring(localPlayer.UserId), {}

				for Z, Z in ipairs(P) do
					if a(Z) or type(Z.Uid) == "string" and string.sub(Z.Uid, 1, #b) == b then
						table.insert(A, Z)
					end
				end

				A = (if #A == 0 then P else A)
				b, P = c(A)

				if not b then
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					l = "No egg matches"
					return false
				end

				if b.Uid == i.Uid then
					return (r("Target is the closest egg, taking it"))
				end
				local c, c = X(b)
				r = nil

				if c and C then
					local Z = math.huge
					r = b

					for o, a in ipairs(A) do
						o = typeof(a.CFrame) == "CFrame" and a.CFrame.Position or nil

						if a.Uid ~= i.Uid and a.AreaId == b.AreaId and o then
							local X = (o - C.Position).Magnitude
							X = (if (o - c).Magnitude > 90 then X + 90 else X)

							if X < Z then
								Z, r = X, a
							end
						end
					end
				else
					r = b
				end

				l = string.format("Sleeping guard egg %d studs away", math.floor(P + 0.5))

				if not r then
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					l = "No egg matches"
					return false
				end

				b, P = w(r, z, false, M[1])
				if not b then
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					return false
				end
				local Z
				C, r = 0, i.Uid

				while P and not O(z) do
					l = "Holding for the guard hit"

					if not I(z, P, function(O)
						if not Z and e.Uid and e.Freed then
							Z = e.Uid
							O.Destination = e.Freed + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
							e.Uid = nil
							e.Freed = nil
							l = "Best egg fell, jumping to it instead"
						end
					end) then
						break
					end

					C += 1
					A = r

					if Z then
						r = Z
						T(z, Z)
						break
					end

					c = M[C]
					b, P = w(c, z, true, M[C + 1])
					if not b then
						r = A
						break
					end
					r = (if c and type(c.Uid) == "string" then c.Uid else A)
				end

				if not h(r, z) then
					c = l
					v()
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					tbl4.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
					l = c
					return true
				end

				C = p(z)
				v()
				tbl4.Steal.Active = false
				tbl4.Steal.LastFinishedAt = os.clock()
				l = C and "Delivered" or "Run ended"
				return true
			end

			local r = tbl.EggState

			if type(r) == "table" then
				local O = { "FieldRefreshed", "FieldShifted", "FieldGone", "SnapshotRefreshed" }

				for p, C in ipairs(O) do
					p = r[C]

					if type(p) == "table" and type(p.Connect) == "function" then
						local r, O = pcall(p.Connect, p, function()
							tbl3.Wake()
						end)

						if r and O then
							fn4(function()
								pcall(function()
									O:Disconnect()
								end)
							end)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			tbl4.StealNightHold = function()
				if not tbl4.Toggle(t, false) or os.clock() >= (tbl4.Steal.NightHoldUntil or 0) then
					return false
				end
				local r = tbl4.Priority.Rank
				local O = r.Boss or 99
				return (r.StealFilter or 99) < O or (r.StealIndex or 99) < O or (r.StealLab or 99) < O
			end

			tbl3.Add(function()
				if not tbl4.Toggle(t, false) then
					return false
				end
				local r, O, p = F()

				if r then
					if O == "night" then
						D()
					end

					tbl4.Movement.StealFirst = true
					tbl4.Steal.Wanted = false

					if n then
						m += 1
						tbl4.Steal.Active = false
						v()
						tbl4.StopWalking()
					end

					tbl4.Steal.NightHoldUntil = os.clock() + 2
					local F = math.max(0, math.ceil(r - p))
					l = (if O == "wall" then string.format("Field wall up, %ds", F) else string.format("Night, going again in %ds", F))
					return false
				end

				p = K and j == math.huge

				if p then
					j = os.clock() + 8
				end

				if n and tbl4.Steal.Carrying ~= true and tbl4.Steal.BossOverride ~= true and (tbl4.Steal.TargetRank or 0) > (tbl4.Priority.Rank.Boss or 99) and type(tbl4.MechFirst) == "function" and (tbl4.MechFirst()) then
					m += 1
					tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					tbl4.Steal.Wanted = false
					v()
					tbl4.StopWalking()
					l = "Mech boss goes first, stealing after it"
					return true
				end

				if n then
					return true
				end

				if Q() then
					tbl4.Steal.NightHoldUntil = os.clock() + 2
					l = "Night over, waiting for the field to reset"
					tbl3.Wake()
					return false
				end

				if type(tbl4.MechFirst) == "function" and (tbl4.MechFirst()) then
					O = false

					if os.clock() >= W then
						W = os.clock() + 0.5
						p, r = pcall(S, false, false)

						if p and type(r) == "table" then
							for K, K in ipairs(r) do
								if K.State ~= "Carried" and tbl4.Priority.StealRank(K) < (tbl4.Priority.Rank.Boss or 99) and not tbl4.StockWaits(K) then
									tbl4.Steal.WantedRank = tbl4.Priority.StealRank(K)
									O = true
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end

					if O and os.clock() < (tbl4.Steal.OverrideBlockedUntil or 0) then
						tbl4.Steal.BossOverride = false
						tbl4.Steal.Wanted = false
						l = "That egg did not come free, back to the boss"
						return false
					end

					if O and type(tbl4.MechLeaveBlocked) == "function" and (tbl4.MechLeaveBlocked()) then
						tbl4.Steal.BossOverride = false
						tbl4.Steal.Wanted = false
						l = "Could not leave the arena, stealing after the boss"
						return false
					end

					if not O then
						tbl4.Steal.Wanted = false
						l = "Mech boss goes first, stealing after it"
						return false
					end

					tbl4.Steal.BossOverride = true
					tbl4.Steal.Wanted = true
					tbl4.Movement.StealFirst = true
					l = "Egg found, it goes before the boss"
					tbl3.Wake()
					return false
				end

				p, r = tbl4.Movement.StealFirst, tbl4.Movement.Owner

				if tbl4.Movement.PlaceWanted and not p or r ~= nil and r ~= "steal" and r ~= "treadmill" and r ~= "scramble" then
					if os.clock() >= W then
						W = os.clock() + 0.5
						local K, j = pcall(S, false, false)
						O = K and type(j) == "table" and j[1] ~= nil and not tbl4.StockWaits(j[1])
						tbl4.Steal.Wanted = O
						tbl4.Steal.WantedRank = O and (tbl4.Priority.StealRank(j[1])) or nil

						if O and tbl4.Priority.StealRank(j[1]) < (tbl4.Priority.Rank.Place or 99) then
							tbl4.Movement.StealFirst = true
						elseif O then
							tbl4.Movement.StealFirst = false
						else
							tbl4.Steal.BossOverride = false
						end
					end

					l = (if tbl4.Steal.Wanted then "Egg found, waiting for " .. tostring(r or "Auto Place") .. " to stop" else "Waiting for " .. tostring(r or "Auto Place"))
					return true
				end

				if type(tbl4.MechRespawning) == "function" and (tbl4.MechRespawning()) or tbl4.MechSeenAt and os.clock() - tbl4.MechSeenAt < 2 and not tbl4.InMechArena() then
					if tbl4.Steal.SettledFor ~= tbl4.MechSeenAt then
						tbl4.Steal.SettledFor = tbl4.MechSeenAt
						table.clear(u)
						R, W = 0, 0
					end

					local r = tbl4.Root()

					if r and tbl4.Movement.Owner == nil then
						pcall(function()
							r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						end)
					end

					l = "Back from the Mech arena, settling before the steal"
					tbl3.Wake()
					return false
				end

				if os.clock() < R then
					return true
				end
				tbl4.Movement.StealFirst = false
				n = true

				task.spawn(function()
					local r = pcall(V)

					if tbl4.Steal.BossOverride == true then
						if l == "Delivered" then
							tbl4.Steal.OverrideFails = 0
						else
							tbl4.Steal.OverrideFails = (tbl4.Steal.OverrideFails or 0) + 1
							tbl4.Steal.OverrideBlockedUntil = os.clock() + math.min(45 * tbl4.Steal.OverrideFails, 300)
						end
					end

					tbl4.Steal.BossOverride = false

					if Y then
						Y = false
						tbl4.ReleaseBelt()
					end

					if not r then
						v()
						tbl4.Steal.Active = false
					end

					r = x
					x = nil
					local O = r and tbl14[r]

					if O and O.Once then
						tbl14[r] = nil
					end

					e.Uid = nil
					e.Freed = nil
					e.Token = nil

					if l == "Delivered" and not tbl4.IsNight() and (tbl4.Steal.TargetRank or 0) < (tbl4.Priority.Rank.Place or 99) then
						tbl4.Movement.StealFirst = true
					end

					r = tbl4.Steal.Wanted

					if not r then
						R = os.clock() + 0.6
					end

					tbl4.ReleaseMovement("steal")
					n = false
					tbl3.Wake()
				end)

				return true
			end)

			t = v4

			fn12 = function()
				tbl4.Steal.BossOverride = false
				m += 1
				table.clear(u)
				tbl4.Steal.Active = false
				tbl4.Steal.Wanted = false
				local r = tbl4.Toggle(t, false)
				tbl4.Shield("steal", r)

				if not r then
					tbl4.Movement.StealFirst = false
					table.clear(tbl14)
					table.clear(tbl15)
					table.clear(tbl16)
				end

				v()
				tbl4.StopWalking()
				tbl3.Wake()
			end

			local function r()
				m += 1
				tbl4.Steal.Active = false
				v()
				tbl4.StopWalking()
			end

			local function l()
				if tbl4.Toggle(t, false) then
					return true
				end

				if t and type(t.Set) == "function" then
					pcall(t.Set, t, true)
				end

				return false
			end

			tbl4.CancelSteal = function(m)
				if type(m) ~= "string" then
					return
				end
				tbl14[m] = nil
				tbl15[m] = nil
				tbl16[m] = true

				if n and x == m then
					r()
				end

				tbl3.Wake()
			end

			tbl4.StealQueue = function()
				local m = {}

				for O in pairs(tbl14) do
					table.insert(m, O)
				end

				table.sort(m, function(O, K)
					local j, F = tbl14[O].At, tbl14[K].At
					if j ~= F then
						return j < F
					end
					return O < K
				end)

				return m
			end

			tbl4.PrioritizeSteal = function(m)
				if type(m) ~= "string" or (H()) then
					return
				end
				local O = 0

				for K, K in pairs(tbl14) do
					O = (if K.At < O then K.At else O)
				end

				tbl14[m] = { At = O - 1, Once = false }
				tbl16[m] = nil
				u[m] = nil

				if l() and n and not tbl4.Steal.Carrying and x ~= m then
					r()
				end

				tbl3.Wake()
			end

			tbl4.MoveInPlan = function(m, O)
				if type(m) ~= "string" or O ~= -1 and O ~= 1 or (H()) then
					return
				end
				local K = tbl4.StealPlan()
				local j = table.find(K, m)
				local F = j and j + O
				if not F or F < 1 or F > #K then
					return
				end
				table.remove(K, j)
				table.insert(K, F, m)
				O = math.max(j, F)

				for j, F in ipairs(K) do
					if j <= O or tbl14[F] then
						m = tbl14[F]

						if m then
							m.At = j
						else
							tbl14[F] = { At = j, Once = false }
						end

						tbl16[F] = nil
					end
				end

				if n and not tbl4.Steal.Carrying and x and K[1] ~= x then
					r()
				end

				tbl3.Wake()
			end

			tbl4.StealPlan = function()
				if not tbl4.Toggle(t, false) or (tbl4.IsNight()) then
					return {}, nil
				end
				local t = {}

				if x then
					table.insert(t, x)
				end

				local m, O = pcall(S, false, true)

				if m and type(O) == "table" then
					for m, m in ipairs(O) do
						if m.Uid ~= x then
							table.insert(t, m.Uid)
						end
					end
				end

				return t, x
			end

			tbl4.SetPriority = function(t, m)
				if m then
					tbl4.PrioritizeSteal(t)
				else
					tbl4.CancelSteal(t)
				end
			end

			tbl4.ResortSteal = function()
				if n and not tbl4.Steal.Carrying and x and not tbl14[x] then
					local t, m = pcall(S, false, true)

					if t and type(m) == "table" then
						local t

						for O, O in ipairs(m) do
							if O.State ~= "Carried" then
								t = O
								break
							end
						end

						if not t or t.Uid ~= x then
							r()
						end
					end
				end

				tbl3.Wake()
			end

			tbl4.StealNow = function(t, m)
				if type(t) ~= "string" or (H()) then
					return
				end

				if not tbl14[t] then
					local O = 0

					for K, K in pairs(tbl14) do
						O = (if K.At > O then K.At else O)
					end

					tbl14[t] = { At = O + 1, Once = m == true }
				end

				tbl16[t] = nil
				u[t] = nil

				if l() and n and not tbl4.Steal.Carrying and x ~= t and not (x and tbl14[x]) then
					r()
				end

				tbl3.Wake()
			end

			fn4(function()
				tbl4.GodMode(false)
				tbl4.ReleaseMovement("steal")
				v()
			end)
		end
	__startCurrentFeature()
end

	local __startCurrentFeature = function()

			local O, j, F, v
			local H, D = t[2]
			local Q, p, C, S, e, w, Y = false, {}, 0, {}, false, 0, {}

			local function P()
				local W = tbl.Save
				if type(W) ~= "table" or type(W.Get) ~= "function" then
					return nil

			local function W(R)
				local V = tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory
				return type(V) == "table" and V[tostring(R)] or nil
			end

			local function R(V)
				local z = W(V)
				V = type(z) == "table" and z.Rarity or nil
				return type(V) == "table" and (tonumber(V.RarityNumber or V.Rank)) or 0
			end

			local function V(z)
				local i = W(z.Category)
				local W, A = type(i) == "table" and (tonumber(i.EarningRate)) or 0, tonumber(z.Scale) or 0
				if W <= 0 or A <= 0 then
					return 0
				end
				local h, c, b = A > 5 and (A / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or A ^ 1.85, 1, tbl.Mutations

				if type(b) == "table" and type(b.EarningsFor) == "function" then
					i, A = pcall(b.EarningsFor, type(z.Mutations) == "table" and z.Mutations or {})
					c = (if i and type(A) == "number" then A else c)
				end

				return W * h * c
			end

			local function W(z)
				local i = {}

				if type(z.Mutations) == "table" then
					for A, h in pairs(z.Mutations) do
						if type(h) == "string" then
							i[h] = true
						elseif h == true and type(A) == "string" then
							i[A] = true
						end
					end
				end

				if type(z.BaseMutation) == "string" and z.BaseMutation ~= "" then
					i[z.BaseMutation] = true
				end

				return i
			end

			local function z(i)
				if S[tostring(i.Category)] then
					return true
				end
				local A, h = 0, 0

				if D then

				end

				if Q or next(p) ~= nil then
					A += 1
					local R, c = W(i), false
					local W = Q and next(R) ~= nil

					if W then
						h += 1
					else
						for W in pairs(R) do
							if p[W] then
								c = true
								break
							end
						end

						h = (if c then h + 1 else h)
					end
				end

				if C > 0 then
					A, h = A + 1, (if V(i) >= C then h + 1 else h)
				end

				if A == 0 then
					return false
				end

				if H == t[2] then
					return h == A
				end
				return h > 0
			end

					end

			end

					if type(M) == "table" and not W(Z) then

							end
						elseif M.IsFavorite == true and not (h and (z(M))) then

				return c
			end

				end

						if not arg or not arg:IsA("Tool") then
