				y[#y + 1] = G.Label
			end

			local G, dm, tm, rm, lm = { ScrapDrone = true, ReactorDrone = true, AugmentedDrone = true }, ({ "Nearest", "Rare First", "Most HP First" })[1], ({ "Tween", "Teleport" })[1], 0, -math.huge

			local function nm(mm)
				local um = type(mm) == "table" and (tonumber(mm.OwnerUserId)) or nil
				return um == nil or um == E
			end

			local function E(mm)
				if typeof(mm) == "CFrame" then
					return mm.Position
				elseif typeof(mm) == "Vector3" then
					return mm
				end

				return nil
			end

			local function mm(um, xm)
				local Om = networking:FindFirstChild(um)
				if not Om or not Om:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
					return
				end

				local um = Om.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
					pcall(xm, ...)
				end)

				fn4(function()
					pcall(function()
						um:Disconnect()
					end)
				end)
			end

			mm("RE/Scramble/Drones", function(um)
				if type(um) ~= "table" then
					return
				end

				for xm, Om in pairs(type(um.Upserts) == "table" and um.Upserts or {}) do
					if type(Om) == "table" and Om.Id ~= nil and (nm(Om)) then
						local Km, jm = tostring(Om.Id), type(Om.Attributes) == "table" and Om.Attributes or {}
						xm = u[Km] or {}
						xm.Id = Km
						xm.Position = E(Om.CFrame) or xm.Position
						xm.Health = tonumber(Om.Health) or xm.Health or 1
						xm.Tier = tostring(jm.ScrambleTier or xm.Tier or "")
						xm.Area = tostring(jm.ScrambleArea or xm.Area or "")
						xm.Seen = os.clock()
						u[Km] = xm
					end
				end

				for xm, Om in pairs(type(um.Removed) == "table" and um.Removed or {}) do
					u[tostring(type(Om) == "string" and Om or xm)] = nil
				end
			end)

			mm("RE/Scramble/Effect", function(um, xm, Om)
				if um ~= "Hit" or type(Om) ~= "table" or Om.DroneId == nil then
					return
				end
				um = u[tostring(Om.DroneId)]
				if not um then
					return
				end
				um.Position = E(xm) or um.Position
				um.Health = (tonumber(um.Health) or 1) - (tonumber(Om.Amount) or 1)

				if type(Om.Motion) == "string" and (string.find(Om.Motion, "\"Death\"", 1, true)) then
					um.Health = 0
				end

				if um.Health <= 0 then
					u[um.Id] = nil
				end
			end)

			mm("RE/Scramble/Drops", function(um)
				for xm, Om in pairs(type(um) == "table" and um or {}) do
					if type(Om) == "table" and Om.Id ~= nil and (nm(Om)) then
						xm = E(Om.Position) or (E(Om.Origin))

						if xm then
							x[tostring(Om.Id)] = {
								Position = xm,
								Radius = tonumber(Om.Radius) or 6,
								ExpiresAt = tonumber(Om.ExpiresAt),
								Kind = Om.Kind,
							}
						end
					end
				end
			end)

			mm("RE/Scramble/State", function(um)
				if type(um) ~= "table" then
					return
				end

				if um.Patch == true and type(K) == "table" then
					for xm, Om in pairs(um) do
						if xm ~= "Patch" then
							K[xm] = Om
						end
					end
				else
					local xm = type(um.State)

					if xm == "table" then
						K = um
					end
				end

				j = os.clock()
			end)

			mm("RE/Scramble/RemoveDrops", function(mm)
				for um, xm in pairs(type(mm) == "table" and mm or {}) do
					x[tostring(type(xm) == "string" and xm or um)] = nil
				end
			end)

			local function mm(um)
				local xm = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleLocalVisuals")
				return xm and (xm:FindFirstChild("PersonalDrone_" .. um)) or nil
			end

			local um
			local xm = 0

			local function Om()
				if um and next(um) ~= nil then
					return um
				end
				um = nil
				if os.clock() < xm or type(getgc) ~= "function" or not h() then
					return nil
				end
				xm = os.clock() + 15

				for xm, Km in ipairs(getgc(false)) do
					if type(Km) == "function" and (islclosure(Km)) then
						local jm, Fm = pcall(debug.info, Km, "s")

						if jm and type(Fm) == "string" and (string.find(Fm, "PersonalDrones", 1, true)) then
							local jm, Fm = pcall(debug.getupvalues, Km)

							if jm and type(Fm) == "table" then
								for Km, jm in pairs(Fm) do
									if type(jm) == "table" then
										Km, xm = next(jm)
										if type(xm) == "table" and xm.OwnerUserId ~= nil and xm.CFrame ~= nil then
											um = jm
											return jm
										end
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			local function um()
				local xm = Om()
				if not xm then
					return
				end

				for Om, Km in pairs(xm) do
					if type(Km) == "table" and (nm(Km)) then
						local nm, jm = tostring(Km.Id or Om), type(Km.Attributes) == "table" and Km.Attributes or {}
						local Om, Fm = u[nm], tonumber(Km.Health)

						if not Om then
							Om = { Id = nm, Health = Fm or 1 }
							u[nm] = Om
						elseif Fm then
							Om.Health = math.min(Fm, tonumber(Om.Health) or Fm)
						end

						Om.Position = E(Km.CFrame) or Om.Position
						Om.Tier = tostring(jm.ScrambleTier or Om.Tier or "")
						Om.Area = tostring(jm.ScrambleArea or Om.Area or "")

						if jm.DroneState == "Death" then
							Om.Health = 0
						end
					end
				end

				for E in pairs(u) do
					if xm[E] == nil then
						u[E] = nil
					end
				end
			end

			local function E()
				pcall(um)
				local nm = workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleLocalVisuals")
				if not nm then
					return
				end

				for um, xm in ipairs(nm:GetChildren()) do
					um = xm:GetAttribute("ScrambleDroneId")

					if xm:IsA("Model") and um ~= nil and string.sub(xm.Name, 1, 14) == "PersonalDrone_" then
						um = tostring(um)

						if xm:GetAttribute("DroneState") == "Death" then
							u[um] = nil
						elseif not u[um] then
							local nm, Om = pcall(xm.GetPivot, xm)

							u[um] = {
								Id = um,
								Position = nm and Om.Position or nil,
								Health = tonumber(xm:GetAttribute("Health")) or 1,
								Tier = tostring(xm:GetAttribute("ScrambleTier") or ""),
								Area = tostring(xm:GetAttribute("ScrambleArea") or ""),
								Seen = os.clock(),
							}
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local function nm(um)
				local xm = mm(um.Id)
				local Om = xm and (xm:FindFirstChild("Hitbox"))
				if Om and (Om:IsA("BasePart")) then
					return Om.Position
				end

				if xm and xm.PrimaryPart then
					return xm.PrimaryPart.Position
				end
				return um.Position
			end

			local function um()
				local xm, Om = {}, os.clock()

				for Km, jm in pairs(u) do
					if (jm.Tier == nil or jm.Tier == "" or G[jm.Tier] == true) and (tonumber(jm.Health) or 0) > 0 and jm.Position and (L[Km] or 0) <= Om then
						xm[#xm + 1] = jm
					end
				end

				return xm
			end

			local function G()
				local xm = M()
				if not xm then
					return nil
				end
				local Om, Km = math.huge

				for jm, Fm in ipairs(um()) do
					jm = ((nm(Fm) or Fm.Position) - xm.Position).Magnitude
					jm = (if dm == "Rare First" then (if Fm.Tier == "AugmentedDrone" then jm - 200000 else (if Fm.Tier == "ReactorDrone" then jm - 100000 else jm)) else (if dm == "Most HP First" then jm - (tonumber(Fm.Health) or 0) * 100000 else jm))

					if jm < Om then
						Om, Km = jm, Fm
					end
				end

				return Km
			end

			local function dm()
				local xm = M()
				if not xm then
					return nil, nil
				end
				local Om, Km, jm, Fm = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), math.huge

				for vm, Hm in pairs(x) do
					if Hm.ExpiresAt and Hm.ExpiresAt < Om then
						x[vm] = nil
					else
						local Om = (Hm.Position - xm.Position).Magnitude
						Om = (if Hm.Kind == "Part" then Om - 100000 else Om)

						if Om < Km then
							Km, jm, Fm = Om, vm, Hm
						end
					end
				end

				return jm, Fm
			end

			local function xm()
				if not B.Link then
					if B.SwapWait then
						B.SwapWait = nil
						tbl4.Shield("scramble", false)
					end

					return
				end

				B.Link:Disconnect()
				B.Link = nil
				B.Goal = nil
				B.Look = nil
				B.Character = nil
				B.Track = nil
				B.Dir = nil
				B.Last = nil
				B.LastAt = nil
				B.Vel = nil
				tbl4.Driving = math.max(0, tbl4.Driving - 1)
				tbl4.Shield("scramble", false)
			end

			fn4(xm)

			local function Om(Km, jm, Fm)
				if Fm ~= B.Track then
					B.Last = nil
					B.LastAt = nil
					B.Vel = nil
				end

				B.Goal = Km
				B.Look = jm
				B.Track = Fm
				local vm = localPlayer.Character

				if B.Link and B.Character ~= vm then
					xm()
					B.Goal = Km
					B.Look = jm
					B.Track = Fm
				end

				if B.Link or not vm then
					return
				end

				if not tbl4.Swapped() then
					tbl4.Shield("scramble", true)
					B.SwapWait = B.SwapWait or os.clock() + 6
					if os.clock() < B.SwapWait then
						D = "Waiting for the character to settle"
						return
					end
				end

				if B.SwapWait then
					B.SwapWait = nil
				else
					tbl4.Shield("scramble", true)
				end

				B.Character = vm
				tbl4.Driving = tbl4.Driving + 1

				B.Link = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(Km)
					local jm, Fm = tbl4.Root(), B.Goal
					if not jm or not Fm or jm.Parent ~= B.Character or tbl4.AntiGuard.Busy or tbl4.Movement.Owner ~= "scramble" then
						return
					end
					local vm = jm.Position

					if B.Track then
						local Hm, Dm = pcall(B.Track)

						if Hm and typeof(Dm) == "Vector3" then
							local Hm = os.clock()

							if not B.Last or not B.LastAt then
								B.Last = Dm
								B.LastAt = Hm
							elseif (Dm - B.Last).Magnitude > 0.01 then
								local Qm = math.max(Hm - B.LastAt, 0.004166666666666667)
								local pm = (Dm - B.Last) / Qm

								if pm.Magnitude < 400 then
									local Cm = math.clamp(Qm * 12, 0.2, 0.8)
									B.Vel = B.Vel and (B.Vel:Lerp(pm, Cm)) or pm
								end

								B.Last = Dm
								B.LastAt = Hm
							elseif Hm - B.LastAt > 0.25 and B.Vel then
								B.Vel = B.Vel:Lerp(Vector3.zero, math.clamp(Km * 6, 0, 1))
							end

							local Dm, Qm = B.Vel or Vector3.zero, math.clamp(Hm - B.LastAt, 0, 0.25)
							Hm = B.Last + Dm * (Qm + 0.1)
							Qm = Vector3.new(vm.X - Hm.X, 0, vm.Z - Hm.Z)

							if Qm.Magnitude > 0.5 then
								local pm, Cm = Qm.Unit, math.clamp(Km * 5, 0, 1)
								local Sm = B.Dir and (B.Dir:Lerp(pm, Cm)) or pm
								B.Dir = Sm.Magnitude > 0.01 and Sm.Unit or pm
							end

							Fm = Hm + (B.Dir or (Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))) * 16 + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
							B.Goal = Fm
							B.Look = Hm

							if (Fm - vm).Magnitude <= 40 then
								Qm = math.max(Km, 0.004166666666666667)
								local pm, Cm = Dm + (Fm - vm) / math.max(0.1, Qm), math.max(400, Dm.Magnitude + 80)

								if pm.Magnitude > Cm then
									pm = pm.Unit * Cm
								end

								pm += Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * Qm * 0.5, 0)
								local Dm = Vector3.new(Hm.X - vm.X, 0, Hm.Z - vm.Z)

								pcall(function()
									if Dm.Magnitude > 0.05 then
										jm.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(vm, vm + Dm.Unit)
									end

									jm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = pm
									jm.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
								end)

								return
							end
						end
					end

					local Hm

					if Vector3.new(Fm.X - vm.X, 0, Fm.Z - vm.Z).Magnitude > 250 then
						local Dm = math.max(98, Fm.Y)
						Hm = vm.Y < Dm - 2 and (Vector3.new(vm.X, Dm, vm.Z)) or (Vector3.new(Fm.X, Dm, Fm.Z))
					else
						Hm = Fm
					end

					local Dm, Qm = Hm - vm, 400 * Km
					local Km, pm = Dm.Magnitude <= Qm and Hm or vm + Dm.Unit * Qm, B.Look or Fm
					Qm = Vector3.new(pm.X - Km.X, 0, pm.Z - Km.Z)
					local B = Qm.Magnitude > 0.05 and (CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Qm.Unit)) or jm.CFrame.Rotation

					pcall(function()
						jm.CFrame = CFrame.new(Km) * B
						jm.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						jm.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end)
			end

			local B = nil

			B = function(Km)
				if typeof(Km) ~= "Instance" or not Km:IsA("Tool") then
					return false
				end
				local jm, Fm = Km:GetAttribute("GearName"), tbl.Gears
				Km = type(Fm) == "table" and Fm.Directory or nil
				Fm = type(jm) == "string" and type(Km) == "table" and Km[jm] or nil
				return type(Fm) == "table" and (Fm.ToolController == "Slap" or Fm.SlapPower ~= nil)
			end

			local function Km(jm)
				if typeof(jm) ~= "Instance" or not jm:IsA("Tool") then
					return false
				end

				if tostring(jm:GetAttribute("ItemType")) ~= "Gear" then
					return false
				end
				local Fm = tostring(jm:GetAttribute("GearName") or "")
				if Fm == "" then
					return false
				end
				return string.find(string.lower(Fm), "scrambler", 1, true) ~= nil
			end

			local function jm()
				return localPlayer.Character, localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			end

			local function Fm()
				local vm = tbl4.FindBat()
				if vm then
					return vm
				end
				local Hm, Dm = jm()
				vm = { Hm, Dm }

				for Hm, Hm in ipairs(vm) do
					if Hm then
						for vm, vm in ipairs(Hm:GetChildren()) do
							if B(vm) or (Km(vm)) then
								return vm
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			p.Valid = function(vm)
				if typeof(vm) ~= "Instance" or not vm:IsA("Tool") then
					return false
				end
				return tbl4.IsBatTool(vm) or (B(vm)) or (Km(vm))
			end

			p.Owned = function(B)
				if typeof(B) ~= "Instance" or not B:IsA("Tool") then
					return false
				end
				local vm, Hm = jm()
				local Dm = B.Parent
				return Dm ~= nil and (Dm == vm or Dm == Hm)
			end

			p.Name = function(B)
				if Km(B) then
					return "The Scrambler"
				end
				return tostring(B:GetAttribute("GearName") or B.Name)
			end

			p.Put = function(B, Km, vm)
				if os.clock() - p.EquipAt < 0.4 then
					return false
				end
				p.EquipAt = os.clock()

				pcall(function()
					Km:EquipTool(B)
				end)

				if B.Parent ~= vm then
					pcall(function()
						B.Parent = vm
					end)
				end

				return B.Parent == vm
			end

			local function B()
				local Km = localPlayer.Character
				local vm = Km and (Km:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid"))
				if not Km or not vm or vm.Health <= 0 then
					return nil, false
				end
				local Hm = Km:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")

				if Hm ~= nil and (p.Valid(Hm)) then
					p.Tool = Hm
					Q = p.Name(Hm)
					return Hm, true
				end

				if not p.Owned(p.Tool) then
					p.Tool = Fm()
				end

				Hm = p.Tool
				if not Hm then
					Q = ""
					return nil, false
				end
				Q = p.Name(Hm)
				p.Put(Hm, vm, Km)
				return Hm, Hm.Parent == Km
			end

			local function Q()
				local Km, Fm = B()

				if Km and Fm then
					pcall(function()
						Km:Deactivate()
						Km:Activate()
					end)
				end

				return Km ~= nil
			end

			C.SpamUntil = 0
			C.List = {}
			C.Dirty = true
			C.BuiltAt = 0
			C.NextBag = 0
			C.Links = {}

			C.Click = function(Km)
				pcall(Km.Deactivate, Km)
				pcall(Km.Activate, Km)
			end

			C.Rebuild = function()
				C.Dirty = false
				C.BuiltAt = os.clock()
				table.clear(C.List)
				local Km, Fm = jm()
				local jm = { Km, Fm }

				for Km, Km in ipairs(jm) do
					if Km then
						for jm, jm in ipairs(Km:GetChildren()) do
							if p.Valid(jm) then
								C.List[#C.List + 1] = jm
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			C.Beat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				local Km = os.clock()
				if Km >= C.SpamUntil then
					return
				end

				if C.Dirty or Km - C.BuiltAt > 1 then
					C.Rebuild()
				end

				local jm, Fm = localPlayer.Character, Km >= C.NextBag

				if Fm then
					C.NextBag = Km + 0.25
				end

				for vm, vm in ipairs(C.List) do
					Km = vm.Parent

					if Km == jm then
						C.Click(vm)
					elseif Fm and Km ~= nil then
						C.Click(vm)
					end
				end
			end)

			C.Unwatch = function()
				for Km = #C.Links, 1, -1 do
					pcall(function()
						C.Links[Km]:Disconnect()
					end)

					C.Links[Km] = nil
				end
			end

			C.Watch = function(Km)
				C.Unwatch()
				C.Dirty = true
				if not Km then
					return
				end

				C.Links[#C.Links + 1] = Km.ChildAdded:Connect(function(jm)
					if not jm:IsA("Tool") then
						return
					end
					C.Dirty = true

					if os.clock() < C.SpamUntil and (p.Valid(jm)) then
						C.Click(jm)
						task.defer(C.Click, jm)
					end
				end)

				C.Links[#C.Links + 1] = Km.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(p)
					if p:IsA("Tool") then
						C.Dirty = true
					end
				end)

				task.defer(function()
					local p = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or (localPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5))

					if p and localPlayer.Character == Km then
						C.Links[#C.Links + 1] = p.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
							C.Dirty = true
						end)

						C.Links[#C.Links + 1] = p.ChildRemoved:Connect(function()
							C.Dirty = true
						end)
					end
				end)
			end

			C.Watch(localPlayer.Character)
			C.CharLink = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(C.Watch)

			fn4(function()
				C.SpamUntil = 0
				C.Unwatch()
				local p = { "Beat", "CharLink" }

				for Km, Km in ipairs(p) do
					if C[Km] then
						pcall(function()
							C[Km]:Disconnect()
						end)

						C[Km] = nil
					end
				end
			end)

			local function p(C, Km, jm)
				local Fm = os.clock()
				local vm = Fm + 3

				while os.clock() < vm and not C() do
					local Hm, Dm = dm()

					if not Dm or Km and (Dm.Position - Km).Magnitude > (jm or 40) then
						if Km and os.clock() - Fm < 1.2 then
							task.wait(0.1)
						else
							return
						end
					elseif U() and not U(Dm.Position) then
						xm()
						D = "Leaving the base through the safe zone"
						if not T(Dm.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), C, 6) then
							return
						end
					else
						D = Dm.Kind == "Part" and "Picking up a Drone Part" or "Picking up Samples"
						Om(Dm.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), Dm.Position)
						local dm = os.clock() + 2.5

						while x[Hm] and os.clock() < dm and not C() do
							task.wait(0.1)
						end

						x[Hm] = nil
						vm = os.clock() + 1.2
					end
				end
			end

			local function C(dm, Km)
				local jm = os.clock()
				local Fm
				local vm, Hm, Dm = tonumber(dm.Health) or 0
				local Qm = false

				while not Km() do
					local pm = u[dm.Id]
					if not pm or (tonumber(pm.Health) or 0) <= 0 then
						return true
					end
					local Cm = mm(dm.Id)
					if Cm and Cm:GetAttribute("DroneState") == "Death" then
						u[dm.Id] = nil
						return true
					end
					local Sm = M()

					if Sm ~= nil and pm.Position ~= nil and (Sm.Position - (nm(pm) or pm.Position)).Magnitude <= 30 and not Cm then
						Fm = Fm or (os.clock())
						if os.clock() - Fm > 1.5 then
							u[dm.Id] = nil
							return false
						end
					else
						Fm = nil
					end

					Cm = tonumber(pm.Health) or 0

					if Cm ~= vm then
						vm, Hm = Cm, nil
					end

					if os.clock() - jm > 20 then
						L[dm.Id] = os.clock() + 30
						return false
					end
					Cm, Sm = nm(pm) or pm.Position, M()
					if not Sm then
						return false
					end

					if U() and not U(Cm) then
						xm()
						D = "Leaving the base through the safe zone"
						if not T(Cm, Km, 12) then
							return false
						end

						if Km() then
							return false
						end
					end

					if not Dm then
						local T, Km

						Dm = function()
							local jm = u[dm.Id]
							if not jm then
								return nil
							end

							if not T or not T.Parent then
								T = mm(dm.Id)
								local mm = T and (T:FindFirstChild("Hitbox"))
								Km = mm and (mm:IsA("BasePart")) and mm or T and T.PrimaryPart or nil
							end

							if Km and Km.Parent then
								return Km.Position
							end
							return jm.Position
						end
					end

					Om(Cm + Vector3.new(0, -1, 5), Cm)

					if (Sm.Position - Cm).Magnitude <= 60 and true then
						B()
					end

					if (Sm.Position - Cm).Magnitude <= 12 then
						Hm = Hm or (os.clock())
						if os.clock() - Hm > 8 then
							L[dm.Id] = os.clock() + 30
							return false
						end

						if Q() then
							D = string.format("Smashing %s  %d HP", pm.Tier ~= "" and pm.Tier or "drone", math.max(0, tonumber(pm.Health) or 0))
						elseif not Qm then
							D, Qm = "No bat found, get any bat to smash drones", true
						end
					else
						D = "Flying to a drone"
					end

					task.wait(0.1)
				end

				return false
			end

			local function Q(T)
				for B, dm in ipairs(n) do
					if T() then
						return false
					end
					D = "Looking for drones"
					Om(dm)
					B = os.clock() + 12

					while os.clock() < B and not T() do
						E()
						if #um() > 0 then
							return true
						end

						if tbl4.DistanceTo(dm) < 8 then
							break
						end
						task.wait(0.2)
					end
				end

				return #um() > 0
			end

			local function n()
				local T, B, dm = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), h()
				if B and dm and dm < 25 then
					return next(x) ~= nil
				end

				for B, B in pairs(x) do
					if B.Kind == "Part" or B.ExpiresAt and B.ExpiresAt - T < 30 then
						return true
					end
				end

				return false
			end

			local T

			local function B()
				local dm = type(K) == "table" and K.Window or nil
				return type(dm) == "table" and dm.Index or nil
			end

			local function dm(mm)
				local Km = T ~= nil and T == B()

				while not mm() do
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					if mm() then
						break
					end
					E()

					if n() then
						p(mm)
					end

					if U() then
						xm()
						if not t(mm) then
							break
						end
					end

					local t = G()

					if not t and next(x) ~= nil then
						p(mm)
						E()
						t = (G())
					end

					if not t then
						if not h() or Km then
							break
						end
						Km, T = true, B()
						if not Q(mm) then
							break
						end
					else
						local n, Q = nm(t) or t.Position, M()
						local T = Q and (Q.Position - n).Magnitude or 0

						if tm == "Teleport" and Q and not (U() and not U(n)) then
							if T > 12 and T <= 110 and os.clock() >= rm and os.clock() - lm >= 1.5 then
								lm = os.clock()
								local Q = n + Vector3.new(0, -1, 5)
								Om(Q, n)
								local U = M()

								if U then
									D = "Teleporting to the next drone"

									pcall(function()
										U.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Q, Vector3.new(n.X, Q.Y, n.Z))
										U.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
										U.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
									end)

									local n = os.clock() + 0.8

									while os.clock() < n and not mm() do
										local n = M()
										if n and (n.Position - Q).Magnitude > 40 then
											rm, D = os.clock() + 30, "Teleport pulled back, tweening"
											break
										end
										RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
									end
								end
							end
						end

						C(t, mm)
					end
				end

				p(mm)
				xm()
			end

			tbl4.ScrambleLostPart = function(t)
				return c(i(), t)
			end

			local function t(n)
				if not I() then
					return true
				end
				local Q = f("Exit")
				local p = X(Q, nil)
				if not p then
					return false
				end
				D = "Leaving the Secret Cave"
				if not o(p, n, 4) then
					return false
				end

				for C = 1, 4, 1 do
					if n() then
						return false
					end
					a(Q or (f("Exit")))
					p = os.clock() + 1.5

					while os.clock() < p and (I()) do
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					if not I() then
						return true
					end
				end

				return not I()
			end

			local function n()
				return tbl4.IsNight() or (tbl4.WallSealed())
			end

			local function Q(p)
				if not n() then
					return true
				end
				xm()

				while n() and not p() do
					D = tbl4.IsNight() and "Night, waiting for the wall to drop" or "Waiting for the wall to drop"
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				return not p()
			end

			local function p()
				if not tbl4.Toggle(P, false) or not A() then
					return false
				end

				if S.Ended then
					return false
				end

				if h() then
					return true
				end
				E()
				return #um() > 0 or next(x) ~= nil
			end

			local function C()
				local P = i()
				if not P or P.Completed == true or not A() then
					return false
				end
				local c = tonumber(P.TotalParts) or b(P) + (tonumber(P.DroneParts) or 0)
				return tbl4.Toggle(W, false) and b(P) < #l or tbl4.Toggle(R, false) and (c >= 5 or P.Discovered ~= true)
			end

			local function l(P)
				local function c()
					return P ~= v or tbl4.Movement.Owner ~= "scramble"
				end

				local function P()
					return c() or not p() or (n())
				end

				while p() and not c() do
					if not Q(c) then
						break
					end
					pcall(dm, P)
					if not n() then
						break
					end
				end

				xm()
				if c() or (p()) then
					return
				end

				if not C() then
					N(c)
					D = ""
					return
				end

				if not Q(c) then
					return
				end
				V(true)
				P = i()
				if not P then
					return
				end

				if not C() then
					D = ""
					return
				end

				if tbl4.Toggle(R, false) and P.Discovered ~= true then
					pcall(g, c)
				end

				if tbl4.Toggle(W, false) then
					pcall(_, function()
						return c() or not tbl4.Toggle(W, false) or (p()) or (n())
					end)
				end

				if tbl4.Toggle(R, false) then
					pcall(k, function()
						return c() or not tbl4.Toggle(R, false) or (p()) or (n())
					end)
				end

				if I() and not c() then
					pcall(t, c)
				end

				if not I() and not p() then
					pcall(N, c)
				end
			end

			local function t(n)
				if not (tbl4.Treadmill.Riding or (tbl4.OnBelt())) then
					return true
				end

				for Q = 1, 3, 1 do
					if n() then
						return false
					end
					D = "Jumping off the treadmill"
					tbl4.Treadmill.Riding = false
					task.spawn(tbl4.LeaveBelt)
					Q = localPlayer.Character
					local n = Q and (Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

					if n then
						pcall(function()
							n.Sit = false
							n.Jump = true
							n:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
						end)
					end

					Q = M()

					if Q then
						local n = Q.Position
						local Q, P = n + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0), os.clock()

						repeat
							local W
							RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							local R = M()
							if not R then
								break
							end
							W = math.min(1, (os.clock() - P) / 0.25)

							pcall(function()
								R.CFrame = CFrame.new(n:Lerp(Q, W)) * R.CFrame.Rotation
								R.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
								R.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
							end)
						until W >= 1
					end

					if not (tbl4.Treadmill.Riding or (tbl4.OnBelt())) then
						return true
					end
				end

				return not tbl4.OnBelt()
			end

			O.Handle = v6:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Auto Buy Scramble Shop",
				Note = "Buy the picked items with Samples",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function()
					w = 0
					tbl3.Wake()
				end,
			})

			fn6(v6:CreateMultiDropdown({
				Name = "Scramble Shop Items",
				Options = m,
				Default = { "Scrambled" },
				SubOf = O.Handle,
				Callback = function(n)
					local m = {}

					if type(n) == "table" then
						for Q, P in pairs(n) do
							if P == true and type(Q) == "string" then
								m[Q] = true
							elseif type(P) == "string" then
								m[P] = true
							end
						end
					end

					O.Picked = m
				end,
			}))

			v6:CreateSlider({
				Name = "Keep Samples",
				Note = "Never spend below this many Samples",
				Min = 0,
				Max = 10000,
				Default = 0,
				Increment = 25,
				Unit = "",
				SubOf = O.Handle,
				Callback = function(n)
					O.Keep = math.max(0, tonumber(n) or 0)
				end,
			})

			do
				local n, m = { "Highest Value", "Best Rarity", "Biggest Size" }, { idle = "#8C93A6", work = "#FFC857", good = "#57E08A", stop = "#FF6B6B" }

				local Q, P, W = {
					Handle = nil,
					BuyHandle = nil,
					Loop = 0,
					MinRarity = 0,
					MinIncome = 0,
					Priority = n[1],
					SkipMutated = true,
					Targets = {},
					Cooldown = 0,
					Status = "Idle",
					State = "idle",
					Detail = "Turn it on to start applying Scrambled",
					RarityColor = "#FFFFFF",
					Icon = "",
					Ui = {},
					Row = nil,
					Left = 0,
					Pen = 0,
					Match = 0,
					Tries = 0,
					Hits = 0,
					Locked = nil,
					Short = false,
					EggOptions = {},
					EggCategory = {},
				}, tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory, {}

				if type(P) == "table" then
					for R, c in pairs(P) do
						J = type(c) == "table" and c.Rarity or nil
						y = type(J) == "table" and (tonumber(J.RarityNumber or J.Rank)) or nil

						if y then
							table.insert(W, {
								Category = tostring(R),
								Name = tostring(c.DisplayName or R),
								Rarity = y,
								RarityName = tostring(J.DisplayName or J._id or y),
							})
						end
					end
				end

				table.sort(W, function(R, c)
					if R.Rarity ~= c.Rarity then
						return R.Rarity > c.Rarity
					end
					return R.Name < c.Name
				end)

				for R, R in ipairs(W) do
					P = string.format("%s [%s]", R.Name, R.RarityName)
					P = (if Q.EggCategory[P] then (string.format("%s [%s] (%s)", R.Name, R.RarityName, R.Category)) else P)
					table.insert(Q.EggOptions, P)
					Q.EggCategory[P] = R.Category
				end

				local function P(W)
					local R = tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory
					return type(R) == "table" and R[tostring(W)] or nil
				end

				tbl4.MutationState = Q

				local function W(R)
					local c = P(R.AssetCategory)
					R = type(c) == "table" and c.Rarity or nil
					return type(R) == "table" and (tonumber(R.RarityNumber or R.Rank)) or 0
				end

				local function R(c)
					local b = P(c.AssetCategory)
					local M, o = type(b) == "table" and (tonumber(b.EarningRate)) or 0, tonumber(c.AssetScale) or 0
					if M <= 0 or o <= 0 then
						return 0
					end
					return M * (o > 5 and (o / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or o ^ 1.85)
				end

				local function c(b)
					if tostring(b.BaseMutation or "") == "Scrambled" then
						return true
					end

					if type(b.Mutations) == "table" then
						for M, o in pairs(b.Mutations) do
							if type(o) == "string" and o == "Scrambled" then
								return true
							end

							if type(M) == "string" and M == "Scrambled" and o ~= false then
								return true
							end
						end
					end

					return false
				end

				local function b()
					local M = tbl.EggState
					if type(M) ~= "table" or type(M.ReadOwnerEggs) ~= "function" then
						return {}
					end
					local o, a = pcall(M.ReadOwnerEggs, localPlayer.UserId)
					if not o or type(a) ~= "table" then
						return {}
					end
					M = {}

					for o, X in pairs(a) do
						if type(X) == "table" and X.Placement ~= nil then
							X.Uid = X.Uid or o
							M[#M + 1] = X
						end
					end

					return M
				end

				local function M(o)
					local a = o and o.Uid

					if a then
						o = workspace:FindFirstChild("AreaEggSlotsClient")
						local X = o and (o:FindFirstChild(a))

						if X then
							local f, I = pcall(function()
								return X:GetPivot().Position
							end)

							if f and typeof(I) == "Vector3" then
								return I
							end
						end
					end

					if type(tbl4.PenAnchor) == "function" then
						o, a = pcall(tbl4.PenAnchor)
						if o and typeof(a) == "Vector3" then
							return a
						end
					end

					return nil
				end

				local function o(a, X)
					local f = M(a)
					if f == nil then
						return true
					end

					if tbl4.DistanceTo(f) <= 6 then
						return true
					end

					local function M()
						if X ~= Q.Loop or not tbl4.Toggle(Q.Handle, false) then
							return true
						end

						if tbl4.Movement.PlaceWanted == true and (tbl4.Priority.Above("Place", "Scrambled")) then
							return true
						end
						return tbl4.Movement.ScrambleWanted == true or tbl4.Steal.Wanted == true and (tbl4.Steal.WantedRank or 0) < (tbl4.Priority.Rank.Scrambled or 99)
					end

					if tbl4.Treadmill.Riding or (tbl4.OnBelt()) then
						tbl4.ExitBelt()
					end

					tbl4.HoldBelt()
					local a, X = pcall(tbl4.FlyTo, f + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), M, "mutation")
					tbl4.ReleaseBelt()
					tbl4.LeaveBelt()
					return a and X and tbl4.DistanceTo(f) <= 10
				end

				local M = r

				local function r(a)
					if not a then
						return 0
					end
					local X = tonumber(a:GetAttribute("Uses"))
					if X ~= nil then
						return X
					end
					return tonumber((string.match(a.Name, "%[X(%d+)%]"))) or 1
				end

				local function a()
					local X = M()
					if not X then
						return nil, 0
					end
					local M = r(X)
					if M <= 0 then
						return nil, 0
					end
					return X, M
				end

				Q.Grip = function(r)
					local M = localPlayer.Character
					local X = M and (M:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
					if not M or not X or not r or r.Parent == nil then
						return false
					end

					if r.Parent ~= M then
						pcall(function()
							X:EquipTool(r)
						end)

						if r.Parent ~= M then
							pcall(function()
								r.Parent = M
							end)
						end

						task.wait(0.2)
					end

					return r.Parent == M
				end

				local function r()
					if not tbl4.Toggle(Q.BuyHandle, false) or e then
						return false
					end
					e = true
					local M = false

					local X, f = pcall(function()
						M = Q.Purchase()
					end)

					e = false

					if not X then
						Q.Status = "Buy failed: " .. tostring(f)
					end

					return M
				end

				Q.Purchase = function()
					local M, X = 0, false

					for f = 1, 10, 1 do
						local I, U = M == 0 and (V(true)) or K, i()
						if type(I) ~= "table" or type(U) ~= "table" then
							break
						end
						f = nil

						for K, K in ipairs(type(I.Shop) == "table" and I.Shop or {}) do
							f = (if type(K) == "table" and K.Id == "MutationConsumable" then K else f)
						end

						if not f then
							break
						end
						I = tonumber(f.PurchaseLimit)
						if I and q(U, f) >= I then
							break
						end
						local K, i = tonumber(f.Price) or math.huge, X

						if (tonumber(U.Samples) or 0) - K < O.Keep then
							if M == 0 then
								Q.Status = "Need " .. tostring(math.floor(K)) .. " Samples"
							end

							X = true
							break
						end

						I = z("Shop", f.Id, { Quote = f.Quote, Sequence = tonumber(U.ShopSequence) or 0 })
						if type(I) ~= "table" or I.Ok ~= true then
							X = i
							break
						end
						M += 1
						task.wait(0.4)
					end

					if M > 0 then
						Q.Status = string.format("Bought %d Scrambled", M)
						Q.Short = X
						return true
					end

					Q.Short = X
					return false
				end

				local function K()
					local z, i, M, X = 0, 0, -1

					for f, I in ipairs(b()) do
						z += 1
						f = (if not ((if not ((if Q.SkipMutated and (c(I)) then true else false)) and W(I) < Q.MinRarity then true else (if Q.SkipMutated and (c(I)) then true else false))) and Q.MinIncome > 0 and R(I) < Q.MinIncome then true else (if not ((if Q.SkipMutated and (c(I)) then true else false)) and W(I) < Q.MinRarity then true else (if Q.SkipMutated and (c(I)) then true else false)))

						if not ((if not f and next(Q.Targets) ~= nil and Q.Targets[tostring(I.AssetCategory)] ~= true then true else f)) then
							i += 1
							local c = (if Q.Priority == n[2] then W(I) * 1000 + (tonumber(I.AssetScale) or 0) else (if Q.Priority == n[3] then tonumber(I.AssetScale) or 0 else (R(I))))
							local W = c > M

							if not W and X ~= nil and c == M and I.Uid == Q.Locked then
								M, X = c, I
							elseif W then
								M, X = c, I
							end
						end
					end

					Q.Pen = z
					Q.Match = i
					return X
				end

				local function W(R)
					if typeof(R) ~= "Color3" then
						return "#FFFFFF"
					end
					return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(R.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(R.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(R.B * 255 + 0.5))
				end

				local function R(z)
					local i, c = pcall(Color3.fromHex, z)
					if not i or typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then
						return z
					end
					local z, i, b = c:ToHSV()
					return W(Color3.fromHSV(z, math.min(i, 0.78), math.max(b, 0.82)))
				end

				local function z(i)
					local c = P(i and i.AssetCategory)
					i = type(c) == "table" and c.Icon or nil
					if i == nil then
						return ""
					end

					if tonumber(i) then
						return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(i)
					end
					return tostring(i)
				end

				local function i(c)
					local b = P(c and c.AssetCategory)
					c = type(b) == "table" and b.Rarity or nil
					return type(c) == "table" and (tostring(c.DisplayName or c._id or "")) or "", R(W(type(c) == "table" and c.Color or nil))
				end

				local function W(R)
					if type(R) ~= "table" then
						return "No egg selected"
					end
					local c = P(R.AssetCategory)
					return type(c) == "table" and (tostring(c.DisplayName or R.AssetCategory)) or (tostring(R.AssetCategory))
				end

				local function P()
					local R = m[Q.State] or m.idle

					if Q.Ui.Accent and type(Q.Ui.Accent.Set) == "function" then
						Q.Ui.Accent.Set({ Background = R })
					end

					if Q.Ui.Title and type(Q.Ui.Title.Set) == "function" then
						Q.Ui.Title.Set({ Text = Q.Status, Color = R })
					end

					if Q.Ui.Egg and type(Q.Ui.Egg.Set) == "function" then
						Q.Ui.Egg.Set({ Text = Q.Detail, Color = Q.RarityColor })
					end

					if Q.Ui.Meta and type(Q.Ui.Meta.Set) == "function" then
						Q.Ui.Meta.Set({
							Text = string.format("Charges %d  Eggs %d/%d  Tries %d  Applied %d", Q.Left, Q.Match, Q.Pen, Q.Tries, Q.Hits),
						})
					end

					if Q.Ui.Icon and type(Q.Ui.Icon.Set) == "function" then
						Q.Ui.Icon.Set({ Visible = Q.Icon ~= "", Image = Q.Icon, StrokeColor = Q.RarityColor })
					end

					if Q.Row and type(Q.Row.Set) == "function" then
						pcall(Q.Row.Set, Q.Row, Q.Status .. "  -  " .. Q.Detail)
					end
				end

				local function R(c)
					if type(c) ~= "table" then
						Q.Detail = "No egg matches the filters"
						Q.RarityColor = "#C7CBD6"
						Q.Icon = ""
						return
					end

					local b, M = i(c)
					local i = tonumber(c.AssetScale) or 0
					Q.Detail = string.format("%s   %.2f kg", W(c), i)

					if b ~= "" then
						Q.Detail = Q.Detail .. "   " .. string.upper(b)
					end

					Q.RarityColor = M
					Q.Icon = z(c)
				end

				Q.Apply = function(W, z)
					if not Q.Grip(z) then
						Q.State = "work"
						Q.Status = "Could not hold Scrambled"
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
						return false
					end

					z = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
					local i = z and (z:FindFirstChild("Networking"))
					local c = i and (i:FindFirstChild("RF/BossMastery/AskUseMutationConsumable"))

					if not c or not c:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
						Q.State = "stop"
						Q.Status = "Mutation remote is missing"
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 10
						return false
					end

					Q.State = "work"
					Q.Status = "Applying Scrambled"
					Q.Tries = Q.Tries + 1

					z, i = pcall(function()
						return c:InvokeServer(W.Uid)
					end)

					if not z or type(i) ~= "table" then
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 10
						return false
					end

					if i.Success == true then
						Q.Status = "Scrambled applied"
						Q.Locked = nil
						Q.State = "good"
						Q.Hits = Q.Hits + 1
						return true
					end

					z = tostring(i.Message or "")
					i = string.lower(z)
					Q.Status = z ~= "" and z or "Try failed"
					Q.State = "work"

					if string.find(i, "not found") or (string.find(i, "invalid")) then
						Q.Locked = nil
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3
						return false
					end

					return true
				end

				Q.Settle = function()
					local W = os.clock() + 3

					while os.clock() < W do
						if tbl4.Grounded() then
							return
						end
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end

				Q.Over = function(W)
					if W ~= Q.Loop or not tbl4.Toggle(Q.Handle, false) then
						return true
					end

					if tbl4.Movement.PlaceWanted == true and (tbl4.Priority.Above("Place", "Scrambled")) then
						return true
					end

					if tbl4.Priority.Above("Boss", "Scrambled") and type(tbl4.MechFirst) == "function" and (tbl4.MechFirst()) then
						return true
					end
					return tbl4.Movement.ScrambleWanted == true or tbl4.Steal.Wanted == true and (tbl4.Steal.WantedRank or 0) < (tbl4.Priority.Rank.Scrambled or 99)
				end

				Q.Idle = function(W, z, i)
					Q.State = "idle"
					Q.Status = W
					Q.Left = 0
					Q.Detail = z
					Q.RarityColor = "#C7CBD6"
					Q.Icon = ""
					Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + (i or 5)
				end

				Q.PauseInvis = function()
					Q.InvisResumeAt = nil

					if not tbl4.InvisMutate then
						tbl4.InvisMutate = true
						local W = tbl4.InvisibilityHandle

						if W ~= nil and (tbl4.Toggle(W, false)) then
							tbl4.Notify("Invisibility", "Invisibility is paused while Scrambled is applied and comes back after it.")
						end
					end

					local W = localPlayer.Character
					return not (W and W:GetAttribute("InvisApplied") == true)
				end

				Q.ResumeInvis = function(W)
					if not tbl4.InvisMutate then
						return
					end

					if not W then
						Q.InvisResumeAt = Q.InvisResumeAt or os.clock() + 5
						if os.clock() < Q.InvisResumeAt then
							return
						end
					end

					Q.InvisResumeAt = nil
					tbl4.InvisMutate = false
					W = tbl4.InvisibilityHandle

					if W ~= nil and (tbl4.Toggle(W, false)) then
						tbl4.Notify("Invisibility", "Scrambled is done, Invisibility is back on.")
					end
				end

				local function W(z)
					Q.ResumeInvis(false)

					if tbl4.Priority.Above("Boss", "Scrambled") and type(tbl4.MechFirst) == "function" and (tbl4.MechFirst()) then
						Q.State = "work"
						Q.Status = "Mech boss goes first"
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
						return
					end

					if tbl4.Movement.ScrambleWanted == true or tbl4.Steal.Wanted == true and (tbl4.Steal.WantedRank or 0) < (tbl4.Priority.Rank.Scrambled or 99) then
						Q.State = "work"
						Q.Status = tbl4.Movement.ScrambleWanted == true and "Drone hunt goes first" or "Auto Steal goes first"
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
						return
					end

					if os.clock() < Q.Cooldown then
						return
					end
					local i, c = a()

					if not i then
						pcall(K)
						if r() then
							Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 0.5
							return
						end

						if Q.Short then
							Q.Idle("Out of Samples, waiting for more", "Hunt drones to earn Samples", 10)
							return
						end

						if not string.find(Q.Status, "Samples", 1, true) then
							Q.Status = "Need a Scrambled consumable"
						end

						Q.Idle(Q.Status, "Buy Scrambled from the event shop", 5)
						return
					end

					Q.Left = c
					c = K()

					if not c or not c.Uid then
						Q.State = "stop"
						Q.Status = "Waiting"
						R(nil)
						return
					end

					if tbl4.Movement.PlaceWanted == true and (tbl4.Priority.Above("Place", "Scrambled")) then
						Q.State = "work"
						Q.Status = "Auto Place goes first"
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
						return
					end

					if not Q.PauseInvis() then
						Q.State = "work"
						Q.Status = "Leaving Invisibility to hold Scrambled"
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 0.5
						return
					end

					if not tbl4.ClaimMovement("mutation") then
						Q.State = "work"
						Q.Status = "Waiting for " .. tostring(tbl4.Movement.Owner or "movement")
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 2
						return
					end

					tbl4.Movement.MutationWanted = true

					c, i = pcall(function()
						while not Q.Over(z) do
							local r, b = a()
							if not r then
								break
							end
							Q.Left = b
							b = K()

							if not b or not b.Uid then
								Q.State = "stop"
								Q.Status = "Waiting"
								R(nil)
								break
							end

							if b.Uid ~= Q.Locked then
								Q.Locked = b.Uid
								Q.Status = "New target picked"
							end

							R(b)

							if not o(b, z) then
								Q.State = "work"
								Q.Status = "Could not reach the egg"
								Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3
								break
							end

							if Q.Over(z) then
								break
							end

							if not Q.Apply(b, r) then
								break
							end
							pcall(P)
							task.wait(0.35)
						end
					end)

					if not c then
						Q.Status = "Stopped: " .. tostring(i)
						Q.State = "work"
						Q.Cooldown = os.clock() + 3
					end

					Q.Settle()
					tbl4.Movement.MutationWanted = false
					tbl4.ReleaseMovement("mutation")
					Q.InvisResumeAt = os.clock() + 5
				end

				Q.Handle = v6:CreateToggle({
					Name = "Auto Use Scrambled",
					Default = false,
					Callback = function(r)
						Q.Loop = Q.Loop + 1
						tbl4.Movement.MutationWanted = false
						tbl4.ReleaseMovement("mutation")
						if r ~= true then
							Q.ResumeInvis(true)
							return
						end
						local r = Q.Loop

						task.spawn(function()
							while r == Q.Loop and (tbl4.Toggle(Q.Handle, false)) do
								pcall(W, r)
								pcall(P)
								task.wait(Q.State == "idle" and 3 or 1)
							end
						end)
					end,
				})

				if type(v6.CreateCanvas) == "function" then
					local r = v6:CreateCanvas({
						Name = "Scrambled Status",
						ShowTitle = false,
						Layout = "free",
						SubOf = Q.Handle,
						Style = {
							TextScale = 1,
							LineHeight = 1.1,
							MinLines = 4,
							MaxLines = 4,
							AutoHeight = true,
							BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
							TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
							TextStrokeTransparency = 0.7,
						},
						Build = function(K)
							Q.Ui.Card = K:Frame({
								X = 0,
								Y = 0,
								Width = 1,
								Height = 3.6,
								Corner = 0.3,
								Background = "#151821",
								BackgroundTransparency = 0.25,
							})

							Q.Ui.Accent = K:Frame({
								Parent = Q.Ui.Card,
								X = 0.08,
								Y = 0.18,
								Width = 0.16,
								Height = 3.24,
								Corner = 0.2,
								Background = m.idle,
							})

							Q.Ui.Icon = K:Image({
								Parent = Q.Ui.Card,
								X = 0.42,
								Y = 0.3,
								Width = 3,
								Height = 3,
								Corner = 0.3,
								Background = "#242938",
								BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
								StrokeThickness = 0.06,
								StrokeTransparency = 0,
								Visible = false,
							})

							Q.Ui.Title = K:Text({
								Parent = Q.Ui.Card,
								X = 3.7,
								Y = 0.32,
								Width = 1,
								Height = 1.05,
								Scale = 1.16,
								Wrap = false,
								Text = Q.Status,
								Color = m.idle,
								TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
							})

							Q.Ui.Egg = K:Text({
								Parent = Q.Ui.Card,
								X = 3.7,
								Y = 1.42,
								Width = 1,
								Height = 1,
								Scale = 1,
								Wrap = false,
								Text = Q.Detail,
								Color = "#FFFFFF",
								TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
							})

							Q.Ui.Meta = K:Text({
								Parent = Q.Ui.Card,
								X = 3.7,
								Y = 2.42,
								Width = 1,
								Height = 0.9,
								Scale = 0.86,
								Wrap = false,
								Text = "Charges 0  Eggs 0/0  Tries 0  Applied 0",
								Color = "#AEB4C6",
								TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
							})

							P()
						end,
					})

					fn4(function()
						pcall(function()
							r:Destroy()
						end)
					end)
				else
					Q.Row = v6:CreateText({ Name = "Scrambled Status", Text = "Idle", SubOf = Q.Handle })
				end

				v6:CreateDropdown({
					Name = "Mutation Min Rarity",
					Note = "Only eggs of this rarity and above are used",
					Options = tbl7,
					Default = tbl7[1],
					SubOf = Q.Handle,
					Callback = function(r)
						Q.MinRarity = tbl8[r] or 0
					end,
				})

				do
					local r, m = {
						["K/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 1000, Mult = 1000 },
						["M/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 1000, Mult = 1000000 },
						["B/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 100, Mult = 1000000000 },
					}, { Slider = nil, Value = 0, Unit = "M/s" }

					local function K(P, W)
						if P ~= nil then
							m.Value = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(P) or m.Value))
						end

						if W ~= nil then
							m.Unit = tostring(W)
						end

						P = r[m.Unit] or r["M/s"]
						Q.MinIncome = m.Value * P.Mult
					end

					m.Slider = fn5(v6, {
						Name = "Min Mutation Value",
						Note = "Skip eggs worth less than this (0 = off)",
						SubOf = Q.Handle,
						Legacy = "Mutation Min Value",
						SectionName = "Dr Scramble Event",
						OnRaw = function(r)
							K(math.floor(r / 1000), "K/s")
						end,
					})
				end

				v6:CreateDropdown({
					Name = "Mutation Priority",
					Note = "Which egg gets the consumable first",
					Options = n,
					Default = n[1],
					SubOf = Q.Handle,
					Callback = function(r)
						Q.Priority = tostring(r)
					end,
				})

				fn6(v6:CreateMultiDropdown({
					Name = "Mutation Target Eggs",
					Note = "Only use the consumable on these eggs (empty = all)",
					Options = Q.EggOptions,
					Default = {},
					SubOf = Q.Handle,
					Callback = function(r)
						local n = {}

						if type(r) == "table" then
							for m, K in pairs(r) do
								local r = K == true and type(m) == "string" and m or type(K) == "string" and K or nil

								if r and Q.EggCategory[r] then
									n[Q.EggCategory[r]] = true
								end
							end
						end

						Q.Targets = n
					end,
				}))

				Q.BuyHandle = v6:CreateToggle({
					Name = "Auto Buy Scrambled",
					Note = "Buy another Scrambled from the event shop when you run out",
					Default = false,
					SubOf = Q.Handle,
					Callback = function()
						Q.Cooldown = 0
					end,
				})

				fn4(function()
					Q.Loop = Q.Loop + 1
					tbl4.Movement.MutationWanted = false
					tbl4.ReleaseMovement("mutation")
				end)
			end

			local r
			local n, m = false, false

			tbl3.Add(function()
				if not m and os.clock() - j >= 6 then
					m = true

					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(V, true)
						m = false
					end)
				end

				if Y and type(Y.Set) == "function" then
					pcall(Y.Set, Y, Z())
				end

				local m, K = h(), tbl4.IsNight()

				if m and not n then
					S.Latch = K
					S.Ended = false
				end

				if not K then
					S.Latch = false
				elseif m and not S.Latch and not S.Ended then
					S.Ended = true
					D = "Night arrived, this outbreak is over"
					table.clear(u)
					table.clear(x)
				end

				if not m then
					S.Ended = false
				end

				if n and not m then
					task.delay(15, function()
						if not h() then
							table.clear(u)
							table.clear(L)
						end
					end)
				end

				n = m

				if tbl4.Toggle(O.Handle, false) and not e and os.clock() >= w and (A()) then
					e = true
					w = os.clock() + 8

					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(s, function()
							return not tbl4.Toggle(O.Handle, false)
						end)

						e = false
					end)
				end

				m, K = p(), C()
				tbl4.Movement.ScrambleWanted = m or K
				local n = tbl4.InvisibilityHandle
				local u = n ~= nil and (tbl4.Toggle(n, false))

				if m then
					r = nil

					if not tbl4.InvisSuspended then
						tbl4.InvisSuspended = true

						if u and type(v.Notify) == "function" then
							pcall(v.Notify, "Invisibility", "Invisibility is paused for the drone hunt and comes back after it.", 5)
						end
					end
				elseif tbl4.InvisSuspended and not F then
					r = r or os.clock() + 5

					if os.clock() >= r then
						r = nil
						tbl4.InvisSuspended = false

						if u and type(v.Notify) == "function" then
							pcall(v.Notify, "Invisibility", "The drone hunt is over, Invisibility is back on.", 5)
						end
					end
				end

				u = localPlayer.Character
				if m and not F and u and u:GetAttribute("InvisApplied") == true then
					D = "Leaving Invisibility for the hunt"
					return true
				end

				if F then
					return m
				end

				if not (m or K) or os.clock() < H then
					u = not m and not K

					if u then
						D = ""
					end

					return false
				end

				u = tbl4.Steal
				if u.Active or u.Carrying or u.Wanted then
					D = "Auto Steal goes first"
					return m
				end

				if not tbl4.ClaimMovement("scramble") then
					D = "Waiting for " .. tostring(tbl4.Movement.Owner or "movement") .. " to finish"
					return m
				end
				F = true
				H = os.clock() + 1.5
				local r = v

				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(t, function()
						return r ~= v
					end)

					tbl4.HoldBelt()
					pcall(l, r)
					xm()
					tbl4.ReleaseBelt()
					tbl4.ReleaseMovement("scramble")
					F = false
					tbl3.Wake()
				end)

				return m
			end)

			fn4(function()
				v += 1
				xm()
				tbl4.InvisSuspended = false
				tbl4.Movement.ScrambleWanted = false
				tbl4.ReleaseMovement("scramble")
			end)
		end
	__chilliStage("starting Scramble event")
	__startCurrentFeature()
	__chilliStage("finished Scramble event")
end

	local v11, v12

	do
		__chilliStage("creating Player tab")
		local v13 = v2:CreateTab({ Name = "Player", SectionsExpanded = true })
		tbl4.EspSection = v13:CreateSection({ Name = "ESP", Expanded = false })
		local v14 = v13:CreateSection({ Name = "Movement", Expanded = true })
		v11 = v13:CreateSection({ Name = "Character", Expanded = true })
		v12 = v13:CreateSection({ Name = "Combat", Expanded = true })
do
	local __startCurrentFeature = function()
			local t
			local r, l = 350
			local n = false

			local function m()
				local u = localPlayer.Character
				local x, O = u and (u:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")), u and (u:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
				if x and O and O.Health > 0 then
					return x, O
				end
				return nil, nil
			end

			local function u()
				if not n then
					return
				end
				n = false
				local x, O = m()
				if not x then
					return
				end
				local K, j = x.AssemblyLinearVelocity, O.MoveDirection
				local F = Vector3.new(j.X, 0, j.Z)
				local j = F.Magnitude > 0.001 and F.Unit * O.WalkSpeed or Vector3.zero

				pcall(function()
					x.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(j.X, K.Y, j.Z)
				end)
			end

			local x = nil

			x = function()
				if l then
					l:Disconnect()
					l = nil
				end

				u()
				tbl4.Shield("speed", false)
			end

			local O = nil

			O = function()
				if l then
					return
				end
				tbl4.Shield("speed", true)

				l = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if tbl4.Steal.Active or tbl4.Flying or tbl4.Driving > 0 or tbl4.Treadmill.Riding then
						n = false
						return
					end
					local l, K = m()
					if not l or K.Sit or K.PlatformStand then
						n = false
						return
					end
					local m = tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime"))
					if m and m > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
						n = false
						return
					end
					m = K.MoveDirection
					K = Vector3.new(m.X, 0, m.Z)
					if K.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
						u()
						return
					end
					local m, u = K.Unit * r, l.AssemblyLinearVelocity

					pcall(function()
						l.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(m.X, u.Y, m.Z)
					end)

					n = true
				end)
			end

			tbl4.SpeedForced = false

			local function l()
				if tbl4.Toggle(t, false) or tbl4.SpeedForced then
					O()
				else
					x()
				end
			end

			local n, m, u = false, false, false

			tbl4.SetSpeedForced = function(O)
				tbl4.SpeedForced = O == true
				n = true
				l()
			end

			t = v14:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Speed Boost",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function()
					if tbl4.SpeedForced and not tbl4.Toggle(t, false) then
						n, u = true, true
					end

					l()
				end,
			})

			local l = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if u then
					u = false

					if type(v.Notify) == "function" then
						pcall(v.Notify, "Speed Boost", "Speed Boost must stay on while Invisibility is on.", 5)
					end
				end

				if not n then
					return
				end
				n = false
				local n

				if tbl4.SpeedForced and not tbl4.Toggle(t, false) then
					m, n = true, true
				elseif not tbl4.SpeedForced and m then
					m, n = false, (if tbl4.Toggle(t, false) then false else n)
				end

				if n ~= nil then
					local m = { "Set", "SetValue" }

					for u, u in ipairs(m) do
						local m, O = pcall(function()
							return t[u]
						end)

						if m and type(O) == "function" and (pcall(O, t, n)) then
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end)

			fn4(function()
				l:Disconnect()
			end)

			v14:CreateSlider({
				Name = "Boost Speed",
				Min = 20,
				Max = 1000,
				Default = 350,
				Increment = 5,
				Unit = "studs/s",
				Callback = function(t)
					r = math.clamp(tonumber(t) or 350, 20, 1000)
				end,
			})

			fn4(x)

			do
				local t, r

				local function l()
					if r then
						r:Disconnect()
						r = nil
					end

					tbl4.Shield("jump", false)
				end

				t = v14:CreateToggle({
					Name = "Infinite Jump",
					Default = false,
					Callback = function()
						if not tbl4.Toggle(t, false) then
							l()
							return
						end

						if r then
							return
						end
						tbl4.Shield("jump", true)

						r = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
							local t = localPlayer.Character
							local r = t and (t:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

							if r then
								pcall(function()
									r:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
								end)
							end
						end)
					end,
				})

				fn4(l)
			end
		end
	__chilliStage("starting movement controls")
	__startCurrentFeature()
	__chilliStage("finished movement controls")
end

	end

	do
		local v13 = nil
		local flag3 = false
		local flag4 = true
		local flag5 = false
		local flag6 = false
		local flag7 = false
		local v14 = nil
		local v15 = nil
		local hipHeight = 999

		local function fn20()
			-- InvisMech (Mech boss) and InvisMutate (Scrambled) also pause invisibility; they
			-- weren't checked here, so those features waited forever for invis to drop
			return flag3 and not tbl4.InvisSuspended and not tbl4.InvisMech and not tbl4.InvisMutate
		end

		local function fn21(arg)
			return arg and arg:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
		end

		-- respawn cover: hides the reset (death, blank respawn, parts popping off) behind a
		-- short loading screen, and stops a failing apply from resetting in an endless loop
		local respawnCover = { Gui = nil, Shown = 0, FailStreak = 0, BackoffUntil = 0 }

		function respawnCover.Show()
			local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
			if respawnCover.Gui then
				return
			end
			local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
			gui.Name = fn3()
			gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
			gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
			gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
			local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
			bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 14)
			bg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
			bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			bg.Parent = gui
			local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
			grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(60, 6, 10), Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 12))
			grad.Rotation = 90
			grad.Parent = bg
			local logo = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			logo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			logo.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45)
			logo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 84)
			logo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			logo.Image = "rbxassetid://128961717706452"
			logo.ImageTransparency = 1
			logo.Parent = bg
			Instance.new("UICorner", logo).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 18)
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.45, 56)
			label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(320, 28)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
			label.TextSize = 22
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			label.TextTransparency = 1
			label.Text = "Refreshing character..."
			label.Parent = bg
			gui.Parent = v3
			respawnCover.Gui = gui
			respawnCover.Shown = os.clock()
			TS:Create(bg, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
			TS:Create(logo, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
			TS:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
			task.spawn(function()
				local t = 0
				while respawnCover.Gui == gui do
					t += RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
					logo.Rotation = math.sin(t * 3) * 8
					logo.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84 + math.sin(t * 6) * 4, 84 + math.sin(t * 6) * 4)
					if t > 20 then -- never trap the screen if a respawn hangs
						respawnCover.Hide()
					end
				end
			end)
			task.wait(0.27) -- fully covered before the character dies
		end

		function respawnCover.Hide()
			local gui = respawnCover.Gui
			if not gui then
				return
			end
			respawnCover.Gui = nil
			local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
			for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Frame") then
					TS:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
					TS:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { ImageTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") then
					TS:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
				end
			end
			task.delay(0.4, function()
				gui:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		fn4(function()
			respawnCover.Hide()
		end)

		local function fn22(arg)
			return networking:FindFirstChild(arg)
		end

		local function fn23(arg)
			return arg ~= nil and arg:GetAttribute("InvisApplied") == true
		end

		local function fn24()
			local AskDoff = fn22("RF/Treadmill/AskDoff")

			if AskDoff and AskDoff:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				for i = 1, 2 do
					pcall(AskDoff.InvokeServer, AskDoff)
				end
			end
		end

		local function fn25(arg)
			local AskRigWipe = fn22("RE/RigSync/AskRigWipe")

			if AskRigWipe and AskRigWipe:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				pcall(AskRigWipe.FireServer, AskRigWipe, arg)
			end
		end

		local function fn26(arg)
			local backpack = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

			for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Humanoid") then
					pcall(child.UnequipTools, child)
				end
			end

			if backpack then
				for _, child in ipairs(arg:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Tool") then
						pcall(function()
							child.Parent = backpack
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			for i = 1, 3 do
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end

		local function fn27(arg)
			local v16 = fn21(arg)
			if not arg or not v16 then
				return false
			end
			fn26(arg)
			fn24()

			pcall(function()
				v16:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
				v16.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
				v16.RequiresNeck = true
				v16.Health = 0
			end)

			pcall(function()
				v16:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
			end)

			pcall(function()
				arg:BreakJoints()
			end)

			fn25(arg)
			return true
		end

		local function fn28(parent)
			local v16 = fn21(parent)
			local n9 = os.clock() + 10

			while true do
				if os.clock() < n9 and flag4 and parent.Parent then
					v16 = v16 or fn21(parent)
					if not (v16 and parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and parent:FindFirstChild("Head")) then
						task.wait()
						continue
					end
				end

				break
			end

			local humanoidRootPart = parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not fn20() or not v16 or not humanoidRootPart or not parent:FindFirstChild("Head") then
				return false
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
			if not fn20() or parent.Parent == nil then
				return false
			end

			for i = 1, 2 do
				pcall(v16.UnequipTools, v16)
			end

			if type(replicatesignal) == "function" then
				for i = 1, 2 do
					pcall(replicatesignal, v16.ServerBreakJoints)
				end
			end

			local hipHeight2 = v16.HipHeight

			pcall(function()
				v16.HipHeight = hipHeight
			end)

			for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("BasePart") and child ~= humanoidRootPart then
					pcall(function()
						child.Parent = nil
					end)
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.12)

			local function fn29()
				pcall(function()
					v16.HipHeight = hipHeight2
				end)

				for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Humanoid") and child.HipHeight ~= hipHeight2 then
						pcall(function()
							child.HipHeight = hipHeight2
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			if parent.Parent == nil then
				fn29()
				return false
			end
			local motor6D = Instance.new("Motor6D")
			motor6D.Name = "RightWrist"
			motor6D.C0 = CFrame.new(1.2, 0, 0)
			motor6D.C1 = CFrame.new()
			motor6D.Part0 = humanoidRootPart
			motor6D.Parent = humanoidRootPart
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = "RightHand"
			part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
			part.Transparency = 1
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.Massless = true
			part.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame * motor6D.C0
			motor6D.Part1 = part
			part.Parent = parent

			pcall(function()
				humanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false
			end)

			fn29()
			parent:SetAttribute("InvisApplied", true)

			task.delay(1, function()
				local chilliToolKeeper = (typeof(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G).ChilliToolKeeper

				if parent.Parent and type(chilliToolKeeper) == "function" then
					pcall(chilliToolKeeper)
				end
			end)

			task.delay(0.2, function()
				if humanoidRootPart.Parent then
					pcall(function()
						humanoidRootPart.CanCollide = true
					end)
				end
			end)

			local connection = parent.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child:IsA("Humanoid") then
					task.defer(function()
						if child.HipHeight ~= hipHeight2 then
							pcall(function()
								child.HipHeight = hipHeight2
							end)
						end
					end)
				end
			end)

			local connection2 = nil

			connection2 = parent.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent2)
				if parent2 == nil then
					connection:Disconnect()
					connection2:Disconnect()
				end
			end)

			return true
		end

		local function fn29()
			local active = tbl4.Steal.Active or tbl4.Steal.Carrying or tbl4.Flying

			if not active then
				active = (tbl4.Driving or 0) > 0
			end

			return active
		end

		tbl4.RequestRespawn = function()
			flag7 = true
		end

		local function fn30()
			flag5 = true
			local v16 = flag7

			while flag4 and (fn29() or not tbl4.ClaimMovement("invisibility")) do
				task.wait(0.2)
			end

			local character = localPlayer.Character

			-- an automatic invis apply/remove that keeps failing waits a bit instead of looping
			local backingOff = not v16 and os.clock() < respawnCover.BackoffUntil

			if flag4 and not backingOff and character and (v16 or fn23(character) ~= fn20()) and fn21(character) then
				flag7 = false
				tbl6.Paused = true
				tbl4.ShieldPaused = true
				pcall(respawnCover.Show)
				pcall(tbl4.UndoSwap)
				task.wait()
				fn27(localPlayer.Character)
				local n9 = os.clock() + 60
				local n10 = os.clock() + 8

				while flag4 and os.clock() < n9 and localPlayer.Character == character do
					if n10 <= os.clock() then
						n10 = os.clock() + 8
						fn25(character)
					end

					task.wait(0.05)
				end

				task.wait(0.1)

				while flag4 and flag6 do
					task.wait(0.05)
				end

				-- give the new character a moment to settle, then check the apply stuck
				local settleUntil = os.clock() + 3
				while flag4 and os.clock() < settleUntil and fn23(localPlayer.Character) ~= fn20() do
					task.wait(0.1)
				end
				local newCharacter = localPlayer.Character
				if newCharacter and newCharacter ~= character and fn23(newCharacter) == fn20() then
					respawnCover.FailStreak = 0
				else
					respawnCover.FailStreak += 1
					if respawnCover.FailStreak >= 3 then
						respawnCover.FailStreak = 0
						respawnCover.BackoffUntil = os.clock() + 30
						tbl4.Notify("Invisibility", "Invisibility didn't apply after 3 tries, trying again in 30s.")
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.25)
				pcall(respawnCover.Hide)
			end

			tbl6.Paused = false
			tbl4.ShieldPaused = false
			tbl4.ReleaseMovement("invisibility")
			flag5 = false
		end

		local connection = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			if not fn20() then
				return
			end
			flag6 = true
			tbl4.ShieldPaused = true

			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(fn28, character)
				flag6 = false

				if not flag5 then
					tbl4.ShieldPaused = false
				end
			end)
		end)

		local thread = task.spawn(function()
			while flag4 do
				local character = localPlayer.Character
				local v16 = fn21(character)
				local flag8 = not flag5 and not flag6 and character and v16 and v16.Health > 0
				local flag9

				if flag8 then
					local v17 = flag7

					if flag7 then
						flag9 = v17
					else
						flag9 = fn23(character) ~= fn20()
					end
				else
					flag9 = flag8
				end

				if flag9 and (flag7 or os.clock() >= respawnCover.BackoffUntil) then
					fn30()
				end

				local v17 = fn23(localPlayer.Character)

				if v17 ~= v14 then
					v14 = v17
					tbl4.SetSpeedForced(v17)
				end

				task.wait(0.25)
			end
		end)

		local connection2 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			if not character or not fn23(character) then
				return
			end
			local rightHand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
			local tool = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
			local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if not rightHand or not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then
				return
			end
			local cframe = CFrame.new()

			for _, child in ipairs(rightHand:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("JointInstance") and child.Name == "RightGrip" and child.Part1 == handle then
					cframe = child.C0 * child.C1:Inverse()

					if child.Enabled then
						child.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end

			pcall(function()
				handle.CFrame = rightHand.CFrame * cframe
				handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
		end)

		fn4(function()
			connection2:Disconnect()
		end)

		local connection3 = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local v16 = fn21(character)
			local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not v16 or not humanoidRootPart or v16.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local flag8 = fn23(character) and not tbl4.Steal.Active and not tbl4.Flying

			if flag8 then
				flag8 = (tbl4.Driving or 0) == 0
			end

			if flag8 then
				flag8 = not (tbl4.Treadmill and tbl4.Treadmill.Riding)
			end

			if not (flag8 and not v16.Sit and not v16.PlatformStand) then
				if v15 == v16 then
					v15 = nil

					pcall(function()
						v16.AutoRotate = true
					end)
				end

				return
			end

			if v16.AutoRotate then
				pcall(function()
					v16.AutoRotate = false
				end)
			end

			v15 = v16
			local moveDirection = v16.MoveDirection
			local vector = Vector3.new(moveDirection.X, 0, moveDirection.Z)

			if vector.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				pcall(function()
					humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(humanoidRootPart.Position, humanoidRootPart.Position + vector.Unit)
				end)
			end
		end)

		tbl4.InvisibilityHandle = v11:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Invisibility",
			Note = "Makes you invisible to other players",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function()
				local str2

				if type(tbl4.CombatActive) == "function" and tbl4.CombatActive() then
					str2 = "Auto Hit"
				end

				if tbl4.Toggle(v13, false) and str2 then
					flag3 = false
					local v16 = v13

					tbl4.UiDefer(function()
						pcall(v16.Set, v16, false, false)
						tbl4.Notify("Invisibility", "Turn off " .. str2 .. " first, both cannot be on at the same time")
					end)

					return
				end

				flag3 = tbl4.Toggle(v13, false) == true

				if fn20() and not fn23(localPlayer.Character) and tbl4.Movement.Owner == nil then
					tbl4.Movement.Owner = "invisibility"
				end
			end,
		})

		fn4(function()
			flag4 = false
			connection:Disconnect()
			connection3:Disconnect()
			pcall(task.cancel, thread)
			tbl6.Paused = false
			tbl4.ShieldPaused = false
			tbl4.ReleaseMovement("invisibility")
		end)
	end

	local tbl15
	tbl15 = { BallSocketConstraint = true, NoCollisionConstraint = true, HingeConstraint = true }
	local tbl16

	tbl16 = {
		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true,
		[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
	}

	local n9
	n9 = 0.5
	local v13, v14

	do
		local n10 = 5
		local n11 = 0

		v13 = fn2(function()
			return ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Modules.Ragdoll
		end)

		local v15 = nil

		local function fn20()
			if v15 then
				return v15
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return require(localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 5):WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 5)):GetControls()
			end)

			if ok then
				v15 = result
			end

			return v15
		end

		v14 = nil
		local flag3 = false
		local connection = nil
		local n12 = 0
		local fn21 = nil
		local tbl17 = {}
		local tbl18 = {}
		local n13 = 0
		local v16 = nil
		local humanoid = nil

		local function fn22(arg)
			for _, v17 in ipairs(arg) do
				if v17.Connected then
					v17:Disconnect()
				end
			end

			table.clear(arg)
		end

		local function fn23(arg)
			tbl17[#tbl17 + 1] = arg
		end

		local function fn24(arg)
			tbl18[#tbl18 + 1] = arg
		end

		local function fn25()
			if not v16 or not humanoid then
				return
			end
			local humanoidRootPart = v16:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoidRootPart then
				return
			end
			local assemblyLinearVelocity = humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local vector = Vector3.new(assemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, assemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
			local n14 = humanoid.WalkSpeed + n10
			local y = assemblyLinearVelocity.Y
			local flag4 = false

			if n14 < vector.Magnitude then
				vector = vector.Unit * n14
				flag4 = true
			end

			if n11 < y then
				y = n11
				flag4 = true
			end

			if flag4 then
				pcall(function()
					humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vector.X, y, vector.Z)
				end)
			end
		end

		local function fn26()
			if type(v13) ~= "table" then
				return
			end

			if type(v13.ClearClientRagdoll) == "function" then
				pcall(v13.ClearClientRagdoll)
			end

			if type(v13.Unragdoll) == "function" then
				pcall(v13.Unragdoll, v16)
			end
		end

		local function fn27()
			if not v16 or not v16.Parent then
				return
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(v16:GetDescendants()) do
				if tbl15[descendant.ClassName] then
					pcall(function()
						descendant:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		local function fn28()
			if not v16 or not v16.Parent then
				return
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(v16:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Motor6D") and not descendant.Enabled then
					pcall(function()
						descendant.Enabled = true
					end)
				elseif descendant:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and not descendant.Enabled then
					pcall(function()
						descendant.Enabled = true
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		local function fn29()
			local v17 = fn20()

			if v17 and v17.controlsEnabled == false then
				pcall(function()
					v17:Enable()
				end)
			end
		end

		local function fn30()
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

			if currentCamera and humanoid and currentCamera.CameraSubject ~= humanoid then
				pcall(function()
					currentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
				end)
			end
		end

		local function fn31()
			if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end

			if tbl16[humanoid:GetState()] then
				pcall(function()
					humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
				end)
			end

			if humanoid.PlatformStand then
				humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			end
		end

		local function fn32()
			if type(v13) == "table" and type(v13.IsRagdolled) == "function" then
				local ok, result = pcall(v13.IsRagdolled, v16)
				if ok and result == true then
					return true
				end
			end

			local num = tonumber(localPlayer:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime"))
			return num ~= nil and num > workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		end

		local n14 = 21

		local function fn33()
			if tbl4.AntiGuard.Busy == true then
				return true
			end

			if (tonumber(tbl4.AntiGuard.HitArms) or 0) <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			return os.clock() - (tonumber(tbl4.AntiGuard.HitArmedAt) or 0) <= n14
		end

		local function fn34()
			if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if humanoid.PlatformStand then
				return true
			end
			return tbl16[humanoid:GetState()] == true
		end

		local function fn35()
			if not v16 or not v16.Parent then
				return false
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(v16:GetChildren()) do
				if tbl15[child.ClassName] then
					return true
				end

				if child:IsA("BasePart") then
					for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
						if tbl15[child2.ClassName] then
							return true
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function fn36()
			fn25()
			fn26()
			fn27()
			fn28()
			fn31()
			fn29()
			fn30()
		end

		local function fn37()
			if not flag3 or fn33() then
				return
			end
			n12 = os.clock() + n9
		end

		local function fn38()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
