		local function fn31(arg, arg2)
			local tbl20 = tbl17.Tracks[arg]

			if not tbl20 then
				tbl20 = { Samples = {}, Smooth = nil, Heading = nil }
				tbl17.Tracks[arg] = tbl20
			end

			local now = os.clock()
			local samples = tbl20.Samples
			table.insert(samples, { Time = now, Position = arg2.Position })

			while #samples > 2 and now - samples[1].Time > n22 do
				table.remove(samples, 1)
			end

			local assemblyLinearVelocity = arg2.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v16 = samples[1]
			local n27 = now - v16.Time

			if n27 >= 0.03 then
				local n28 = (arg2.Position - v16.Position) / n27

				if n28.Magnitude <= 1500 and assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude <= n28.Magnitude * 1.4 then
					assemblyLinearVelocity = n28
				end
			end

			local vector = Vector3.new(assemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, assemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
			tbl20.Smooth = tbl20.Smooth and tbl20.Smooth:Lerp(vector, 0.25) or vector
			local smooth = tbl20.Smooth

			if smooth.Magnitude > 1 then
				local heading = tbl20.Heading and tbl20.Heading:Lerp(smooth.Unit, 0.25) or smooth.Unit
				tbl20.Heading = heading.Magnitude > 0.01 and heading.Unit or smooth.Unit
			end

			return assemblyLinearVelocity, vector, smooth, tbl20
		end

		local function fn32()
			local n27 = 0

			for _, stat in ipairs(tbl17.Stats) do
				n27 += stat.Shots
			end

			local option = tbl17.Option
			local n28 = -math.huge

			for i, stat in ipairs(tbl17.Stats) do
				local n29 = stat.Shots + 1
				local n30 = (stat.Hits + 1) / (stat.Shots + 2) + math.sqrt(2 * math.log(n27 + 2) / n29) * 0.35

				if n30 > n28 then
					n28 = n30
					option = i
				end
			end

			tbl17.Option = option
			return option
		end

		local function fn33()
			local now = os.clock()

			for i = #tbl17.Pending, 1, -1 do
				local v16 = tbl17.Pending[i]
				local v17 = tbl17.Stats[v16.Option]

				if v16.RagdollBefore + 0.01 < fn22(v16.Target) then
					v17.Hits = v17.Hits + 1
					v17.Shots = v17.Shots + 1
					table.remove(tbl17.Pending, i)
				elseif v16.Wait < now - v16.At then
					if (v16.Tool and tonumber(v16.Tool:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0) > v16.CooldownBefore + 0.01 then
						v17.Shots = v17.Shots + 1
					end

					table.remove(tbl17.Pending, i)
				end
			end
		end

		combat.Plan = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
			if not arg3 then
				local v16
				v16, arg3 = combat.Parts(arg)
			end

			if not arg3 or not arg3.Parent then
				return nil
			end
			local n27 = math.clamp(localPlayer:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 1)
			local n28 = math.clamp(n27 + n10, 0.05, 0.35)
			local v16, v17, v18, v19 = fn31(arg or arg3, arg3)
			local v20 = fn32()
			local v21 = tbl18[v20]
			local position = arg3.Position
			local n29 = position + v16 * math.max(0, v21 + n27 - n28)
			local n30 = position + v16 * (v21 + n27)
			local magnitude = v18.Magnitude
			local heading = v19.Heading

			if not heading then
				local vector = Vector3.new(arg2.Position.X - position.X, 0, arg2.Position.Z - position.Z)
				heading = vector.Magnitude > 0.1 and vector.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local v22 = combat.Range(character and combat.PickBat(character) or nil)
			local n31 = position + v18 * (n27 + v21 + n12 + n13) + (magnitude > 1 and v18.Unit * n15 * n14 or Vector3.zero)
			local n32 = math.max(5, math.min(v22 * 0.7, 6 + magnitude * 0.07)) * n14
			local now = os.clock()
			local n33 = (math.sin(now * 2 * 3.1415926535897931 / n16) * 0.5 + 0.5) * n32
			local n34 = math.sin(now * 2 * 3.1415926535897931 / n17) * n18
			local vector = Vector3.new(-heading.Z, 0, heading.X)

			if vector:Dot(arg2.Position - n31) < 0 then
				vector = -vector
			end

			local n35 = n31 + heading * n33 + vector * (v17.Magnitude < n19 and 3 or 1.5) + Vector3.new(0, n34, 0)
			local position2 = arg2.Position

			if not arg4 then
				position2 = combat.KeepOffWalls(arg2.Position, fn30(Vector3.new(n35.X, n35.Y, position.Z)))
			end

			return {
				Goal = position2,
				Velocity = Vector3.new(v18.X, 0, v18.Z),
				Face = n30,
				Current = n30,
				Historical = n29,
				Option = v20,
				Distance = (position - arg2.Position).Magnitude,
			}
		end

		combat.Steer = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
			local n27 = math.max(arg5, 0.0041666666666666666)
			local velocity = arg2.Velocity
			local n28 = velocity + (arg2.Goal - arg.Position) / math.max(0.12, n27)
			local n29 = math.min(arg3 + velocity.Magnitude, arg4)

			if n29 < n28.Magnitude then
				n28 = n28.Unit * n29
			end

			local position = arg.Position
			local n30 = position + n28 * n27
			local v16 = combat.KeepOffWalls(position, n30)

			if (v16 - n30).Magnitude > 0.01 then
				n28 = (v16 - position) / n27
			end

			local v17 = combat.KeepOffWalls(position, position)

			if (v17 - position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
				n28 = (v17 - position) / math.max(0.12, n27)
			end

			local assemblyLinearVelocity = n28 + Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * n27 * 0.5, 0)

			pcall(function()
				local vector = Vector3.new(arg2.Face.X - position.X, 0, arg2.Face.Z - position.Z)

				if vector.Magnitude > 0.05 then
					arg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + vector.Unit)
				end

				arg.AssemblyLinearVelocity = assemblyLinearVelocity
				arg.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end)
		end

		combat.TryHit = function(arg, arg2)
			fn33()
			if workspace:GetAttribute("PvPDisabled") == true then
				return "Player hits are off right now"
			end
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local v16 = combat.Humanoid(character)
			if not humanoidRootPart or not v16 or v16.Health <= 0 then
				return "Waiting for your character"
			end
			local v17 = combat.PickBat(character)
			if not v17 then
				return "No bat found"
			end

			if not fn24(character, v16, v17) then
				return "Equipping " .. tostring(v17:GetAttribute("GearName") or v17.Name)
			end

			if not combat.Hittable(arg) or combat.Ragdolled(arg) then
				return nil
			end
			arg2 = arg2 or combat.Plan(arg, humanoidRootPart)
			if not arg2 then
				return nil
			end
			local n27 = combat.Range(v17) - n11
			local n28 = humanoidRootPart.Position - humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * n12
			if (arg2.Historical - n28).Magnitude > n27 and (arg2.Current - n28).Magnitude > n27 then
				return nil
			end
			local v18 = fn21()
			if not v18 then
				return nil
			end
			local n29 = math.clamp(localPlayer:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 1)
			local n30 = tonumber(v17:GetAttribute("CooldownEndTime")) or 0
			if fn20() < n30 - n29 * 0.5 then
				return nil
			end
			local lastFire = tbl17.LastFire
			if os.clock() - lastFire < math.max(0.12, n29 * 1.5) then
				return nil
			end
			tbl17.LastFire = os.clock()
			tbl17.Trace = tbl17.Trace + 1

			table.insert(tbl17.Pending, {
				Target = arg,
				Option = arg2.Option,
				At = os.clock(),
				Wait = math.max(0.5, n29 * 2 + 0.3),
				RagdollBefore = fn22(arg),
				CooldownBefore = n30,
				Tool = v17,
			})

			local str2 = string.format("%d:%d:%d", localPlayer.UserId, tbl17.Trace, math.floor(fn20() * 1000))

			pcall(function()
				v18:FireServer(arg, str2)
			end)

			return "Hitting " .. arg.DisplayName
		end

		combat.ReadyBat = function()
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local v16 = combat.Humanoid(character)
			if not character or not v16 or v16.Health <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			local v17 = combat.PickBat(character)
			return v17 ~= nil and fn24(character, v16, v17)
		end

		combat.Swing = function()
			if tbl4.Steal.Active or tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
				return false
			end
			local lastFire = tbl17.LastFire
			local flag3 = os.clock() - lastFire < 0.3

			if not flag3 then
				flag3 = os.clock() - (tbl17.LastSwing or 0) < 0.15
			end

			if flag3 then
				return false
			end
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local v16 = combat.Humanoid(character)
			if not character or not v16 or v16.Health <= 0 then
				return false
			end
			local v17 = combat.PickBat(character)
			if not v17 or not fn24(character, v16, v17) then
				return false
			end
			tbl17.LastSwing = os.clock()

			pcall(function()
				v17:Activate()
			end)

			return true
		end

		combat.HolderOf = function(arg)
			local v16 = workspace:FindFirstChild(arg)
			if not v16 then
				return nil
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(v16:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("JointInstance") or descendant:IsA("WeldConstraint") or descendant:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
					local ok, result, result2 = pcall(function()
						return descendant.Part0, descendant.Part1
					end)

					if ok then
						for _, v17 in ipairs({ result, result2 }) do
							if typeof(v17) == "Instance" and not v17:IsDescendantOf(v16) then
								local model = v17:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

								if model then
									model = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) or Players:FindFirstChild(model.Name)
								end

								model = model or nil
								if model and model ~= localPlayer and model:IsA("Player") then
									return model
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			while not tbl4.CombatDisposed do
				local holders = {}

				if tbl4.CombatWantsHolders then
					local eggState = tbl.EggState

					if type(eggState) == "table" and type(eggState.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
						local ok, result = pcall(eggState.ReadFieldEggs)
						local records = ok and type(result) == "table" and result.Records or nil

						if type(records) == "table" then
							for _, record in pairs(records) do
								if type(record) == "table" and record.State == "Carried" and type(record.Uid) == "string" then
									local v16 = combat.HolderOf(record.Uid)

									if v16 then
										holders[v16] = true
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				tbl17.Holders = holders
				task.wait(0.3)
			end
		end)

		combat.IsHolder = function(arg)
			return tbl17.Holders[arg] == true
		end

		local function fn22(arg)
			if not combat2.Hittable(arg) then
				return false
			end

			if tbl18.TargetMode == tbl19[2] then
				return combat2.IsHolder(arg)
			end

			if tbl18.TargetMode == tbl19[3] then
				return tbl18.Picked ~= nil and arg.Name == tbl18.Picked
			end
			return true
		end

		local function fn23(arg)
			local target = tbl18.Target
			local magnitude

			if target and fn22(target) then
				local v15, v16 = combat2.Parts(target)
				magnitude = (v16.Position - arg).Magnitude
			else
				target = nil
				magnitude = math.huge
			end

			local huge = math.huge
			local v15 = nil

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= target and fn22(player) and not combat2.Ragdolled(player) then
					local v16, v17 = combat2.Parts(player)
					local magnitude2 = (v17.Position - arg).Magnitude

					if magnitude2 < huge then
						huge = magnitude2
						v15 = player
					end
				end
			end

			if target then
				if v15 and not combat2.Ragdolled(target) and huge < magnitude * n20 then
					return v15
				end
				return target
			end

			return v15
		end

		local function fn24(arg, arg2)
			local v15 = nil

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= localPlayer then
					local character = player.Character
					character = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

					if character then
						local magnitude = (character.Position - arg).Magnitude

						if magnitude < arg2 and combat2.Hittable(player) and not combat2.Ragdolled(player) then
							arg2 = magnitude
							v15 = player
						end
					end
				end
			end

			return v15, arg2
		end

		end

			return tbl4.Steal.Active or tbl4.Steal.Carrying or tbl4.Steal.Wanted and tbl4.Toggle(v4, false) or movement.Owner ~= nil and movement.Owner ~= "combat" and movement.Owner ~= "treadmill"
		end

		local function fn27(arg)
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local n21 = combat2.Range(character and combat2.PickBat(character) or nil) + 6

			end

			tbl18.Status = combat2.TryHit(v15, combat2.Plan(v15, arg, nil, true)) or "Aura on " .. v15.DisplayName
		end

		local function fn28()
			local v15 = fn20()

			if v15 and v15 ~= tbl18.TargetMode then
				tbl18.TargetMode = v15
				tbl18.Target = nil
			end

			tbl4.CombatWantsHolders = v15 == tbl19[2]
			local v16 = fn21()
			local flag3 = not v15

			if flag3 then
				if tbl18.Target or tbl18.Moving then
					tbl18.Target = nil
					fn25()
				end
			end

			if flag3 and not v16 then
				tbl18.Status = "Idle"
				return
			end
			local character = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local v17 = combat2.Humanoid(character)

			if not humanoidRootPart or not v17 or v17.Health <= 0 then
				tbl18.Target = nil
				fn25()
				tbl18.Status = "Waiting for your character"
				return
			end

			if flag3 then
				fn27(humanoidRootPart)
				return
			end
			local v18 = fn23(humanoidRootPart.Position)
			tbl18.Target = v18

			if not v18 then
				fn25()
				if v16 then
					fn27(humanoidRootPart)
					return
				end
				tbl18.Status = v15 == tbl19[2] and "Waiting for someone to hold an egg" or v15 == tbl19[3] and "Picked player is not reachable" or "No player to hit"
				return
			end

			local plan = combat2.Plan(v18, humanoidRootPart)
			local flag4 = v15 ~= tbl19[2]

			if not fn26() and (flag4 or not combat2.SelfRagdolled()) and tbl4.ClaimMovement("combat") and not tbl4.AntiGuard.Busy then
				if not tbl18.Moving then
					tbl18.Moving = true
					tbl4.Shield("combat", true)
					tbl4.GodMode(true)
					tbl4.BeginFlight()
				end

				tbl4.GodTick()
				tbl18.Plan = plan
			else
				if tbl18.Moving then
					fn25()
				end

				tbl18.Plan = nil
			end

			local v19 = combat2.TryHit(v18, plan, flag4)
			plan = plan and math.floor(plan.Distance + 0.5) or 0

			if v19 then
				tbl18.Status = v19 .. string.format("  %d studs", plan)
			elseif fn26() then
				tbl18.Status = string.format("Waiting for Auto Steal, near %s", v18.DisplayName)
			else
				tbl18.Status = string.format("Chasing %s  %d studs", v18.DisplayName, plan)
			end
		end

		local function fn29()
			local tbl20 = {}

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player ~= localPlayer then
					table.insert(tbl20, player)
				end
			end

			table.sort(tbl20, function(arg, arg2)
				return string.lower(arg.DisplayName) < string.lower(arg2.DisplayName)
			end)

			local tbl21 = {}

			for _, v15 in ipairs(tbl20) do
				tbl21[v15.DisplayName] = (tbl21[v15.DisplayName] or 0) + 1
			end

			local tbl22 = {}
			local tbl23 = {}

			for _, v15 in ipairs(tbl20) do
				local displayName = v15.DisplayName

				if tbl21[displayName] > 1 then
					displayName = string.format("%s (@%s)", v15.DisplayName, v15.Name)
				end

				table.insert(tbl22, displayName)
				tbl23[displayName] = v15.Name
			end

			if #tbl22 == 0 then
				tbl22[1] = str2
			end

			return tbl22, tbl23
		end

		local v18 = v12:CreateLabel({ Name = "Chase Settings", Text = "Chase Settings" })

				local i = z and (z:FindFirstChild(p))
				if i and (i:IsA("Model")) then
					p = i:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
					return i, p and (p:IsA("BasePart")) and p or nil
				end
				return nil, nil
			end

			local function p()
				local z = not W or not W.Parent

				if z then
					W = tbl5.CreateRuntime()
				end
			end

			local function z(i)
				local A = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
				i = tonumber(i) or 0
				local h = 1

				while math.abs(i) >= 1000 and h < #A do
					i, h = i / 1000, h + 1
				end

				return string.format(h == 1 and "%.0f%s" or "%.2f%s", i, A[h])
			end

			local function i(A)
				local h = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if not h then
					return D.MaxDistance
				end
				local c = math.tan(math.rad(h.FieldOfView) * 0.5)
				return math.min(D.MaxDistance, A * h.ViewportSize.Y / (40 * c))
			end

			local function A(h)
				local c, b = {
					{ h.IconHolder, m.Icon, h.ShowIcon },
					{ h.NameRow.Holder, m.Name, h.ShowName },
					{ h.RarityRow.Holder, m.Rarity, h.ShowRarity },
					{ h.MutationRow.Holder, m.Mutation, h.ShowMutation },
					{ h.ValueRow.Holder, m.Value, h.ShowValue },
					{ h.ExtraRow.Holder, m.Info, h.ShowExtra },
				}, 0

				for m, m in ipairs(c) do
					b = (if m[3] then b + m[2] else b)
				end

				b = math.max(b, 1)

				for m, m in ipairs(c) do
					m[1].Visible = m[3]
					m[1].Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, m[3] and m[2] / b or 0)
				end

				local m, M = tbl5.ScaledWidth(120, D.SizeScale), math.max(1, math.floor(tbl5.RowHeight(D.SizeScale) * b))

				if h.Width ~= m or h.Height ~= M or h.Fixed ~= D.FixedSize then
					h.Width = m
					h.Height = M
					h.Fixed = D.FixedSize

					if D.FixedSize then
						c = 4.5 * D.SizeScale
						h.Billboard.Size = UDim2.fromScale(c, c * M / m)
						h.Billboard.MaxDistance = i(c)
					else
						h.Billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(m, M)
						h.Billboard.MaxDistance = D.MaxDistance
					end
				end
			end

			local function m(i)
				i.Width = nil
				A(i)
			end

			local function i()
				local h, c = tbl5.CreateTag(W, D.MaxDistance)
				local b = Instance.new("Frame")
				b.Name = fn3()
				b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				b.BorderSizePixel = 0
				b.LayoutOrder = 0
				b.Parent = c
				local M = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				M.Name = fn3()
				M.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
				M.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				M.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1)
				M.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
				M.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
				M.Parent = b
				local Z = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
				Z.Name = fn3()
				Z.AspectRatio = 1
				Z.DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Height
				Z.Parent = M

				Z = {
					Billboard = h,
					IconHolder = b,
					Icon = M,
					NameRow = tbl5.CreateTextRow(c, tbl5.MainFont, 1, 0.4),
					RarityRow = tbl5.CreateTextRow(c, u, 2, 0.2),
					MutationRow = tbl5.CreateTextRow(c, tbl5.MainFont, 3, 0.2),
					ValueRow = tbl5.CreateTextRow(c, tbl5.MainFont, 4, 0.2),
					ExtraRow = tbl5.CreateTextRow(c, tbl5.MainFont, 5, 0.2),
					Highlight = nil,
					Anchor = nil,
					CFrame = nil,
					Width = nil,
					Height = nil,
					ShowIcon = false,
					ShowName = true,
					ShowRarity = false,
					ShowMutation = false,
					ShowValue = false,
					ShowExtra = false,
				}

				A(Z)
				return Z
			end

			local function u(h)
				if h.Highlight then
					h.Highlight:Destroy()
					h.Highlight = nil
					R -= 1
				end
			end

			local function h(c, b)
				local M = tonumber(c.AssetScale) or 1
				local Z, o, a = M > 5 and (M / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or M ^ 1.85, 1, tbl.Mutations

				if type(a) == "table" and type(a.EarningsFor) == "function" then
					local M, X = pcall(a.EarningsFor, type(c.Mutations) == "table" and c.Mutations or {})
					o = (if M and type(X) == "number" then X else o)
				end

				return b.EarningRate * Z * o
			end

			local function c()
				local b, M, Z = {}, tbl.EggState, workspace:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggRenders")
				if not Z or type(M) ~= "table" or type(M.ReadOwnerEggs) ~= "function" then
					return b
				end
				local o, a = pcall(M.ReadOwnerEggs, localPlayer.UserId)
				if not o or type(a) ~= "table" then
					return b
				end
				o, M = tostring(localPlayer.UserId), {}

				for X, X in ipairs(Z:GetChildren()) do
					if string.find(X.Name, o, 1, true) then
						M[#M + 1] = X
					end
				end

				for X, f in pairs(a) do
					if type(f) == "table" and f.Placement ~= nil and type(f.AssetCategory) == "string" then
						o = tostring(X)
						local a

						for X, X in ipairs(M) do
							if X.Name == o or (string.find(X.Name, o, 1, true)) or X:GetAttribute("Uid") == o then
								a = X
								break
							end
						end

						if a then
							local M, X = pcall(function()
								return a:IsA("Model") and (a:GetPivot()) or a.CFrame
							end)

							Z = type(f.Mutations) == "table" and f.Mutations or {}

							b[#b + 1] = {
								Uid = "base:" .. o,
								AssetCategory = f.AssetCategory,
								AssetScale = f.AssetScale,
								Mutations = Z,
								BaseMutation = f.BaseMutation or Z[1],
								State = "Base",
								AreaId = "Your Base",
								BottomCFrame = M and X or nil,
								Model = a,
							}
						end
					end
				end

				return b
			end

			local function b(M, Z)
				if M.State == "Claimed" then
					return false
				end

				if D.MinRarity > 0 and Z.Number < D.MinRarity then
					return false
				end

				if D.MinValue > 0 and h(M, Z) < D.MinValue then
					return false
				end
				return true
			end

			local function M(Z, o, a)
				local X, f

				if typeof(o.Model) == "Instance" then
					X = o.Model
					local I = X:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true) or (X:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
					f = I and (I:IsA("BasePart")) and I or nil
				else
					X, f = x(o.Uid)
				end

				local x = o.BottomCFrame

				if typeof(x) == "CFrame" then
					local I = f or workspace.Terrain

					if Z.Anchor ~= I or Z.CFrame ~= x then
						Z.Anchor = I
						Z.CFrame = x
						Z.Billboard.Adornee = I
						local U = (f and f.Position.Y - x.Position.Y or 1) + 0.8
						Z.Billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = x.Position - I.Position + Vector3.new(0, U, 0)
					end
				end

				local I, U = D.Info, o.BaseMutation
				local N, q, T = type(U) == "string" and U ~= "", tonumber(o.AssetScale) or 1, I.Icon == true and a.Icon ~= nil

				if T and Z.Icon.Image ~= tostring(a.Icon) then
					Z.Icon.Image = tostring(a.Icon)
				end

				f = I.Name == true

				if f then
					tbl5.SetRow(Z.NameRow, a.DisplayName, K)
				end

				local K = I.Rarity == true and a.Name ~= ""

				if K then
					tbl5.SetRow(Z.RarityRow, string.upper(a.Name), a.RarityPalette)
				end

				N = I.Mutation == true and N

				if N then
					tbl5.SetRow(Z.MutationRow, string.upper(fn7(U)), j[U] or F)
				end

				U = I.Value == true

				if U then
					tbl5.SetRow(Z.ValueRow, "$" .. z(h(o, a)) .. "/s", O)
				end

				local O, j = {}, tbl.EggRecords

				if I.Weight and type(j) == "table" and type(j.WeightKgForScale) == "function" then
					local F, h = pcall(j.WeightKgForScale, o.AssetCategory, q)

					if F and (tonumber(h)) then
						table.insert(O, z(h) .. " kg")
					end
				end

				if I.Size then
					table.insert(O, string.format("x%.2f", q))
				end

				if I["Sell Price"] and type(j) == "table" and type(j.SellPrice) == "function" then
					local F, h = pcall(j.SellPrice, o)

					if F and (tonumber(h)) then
						table.insert(O, "$" .. z(h))
					end
				end

				if I.Distance and typeof(x) == "CFrame" then
					j = localPlayer.Character
					q = j and (j:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))

					if q then
						table.insert(O, string.format("%dm", math.floor((q.Position - x.Position).Magnitude + 0.5)))
					end
				end

				if I.Area and o.AreaId ~= nil then
					table.insert(O, tostring(o.AreaId))
				end

				if I.State and o.State ~= nil and o.State ~= "Slot" then
					table.insert(O, tostring(o.State))
				end

				q = #O > 0

				if q then
					tbl5.SetRow(Z.ExtraRow, table.concat(O, "  |  "), tbl5.Palettes.Sheen)
				end

				if Z.ShowIcon ~= T or Z.ShowName ~= f or Z.ShowRarity ~= K or Z.ShowMutation ~= N or Z.ShowValue ~= U or Z.ShowExtra ~= q then
					Z.ShowIcon = T
					Z.ShowName = f
					Z.ShowRarity = K
					Z.ShowMutation = N
					Z.ShowValue = U
					Z.ShowExtra = q
					A(Z)
				end

				if (D.Highlight == n[3] or D.Highlight == n[2] and a.Number >= D.HighlightMin) and X then
					if not Z.Highlight and R < 18 then
						q = Instance.new("Highlight")
						q.Name = fn3()
						q.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
						q.FillTransparency = 0.82
						q.OutlineTransparency = 0.05
						q.FillColor = a.Color
						q.OutlineColor = a.Palette.Outline
						q.Parent = W
						Z.Highlight = q
						R += 1
					end

					if Z.Highlight and Z.Highlight.Adornee ~= X then
						Z.Highlight.Adornee = X
					end
				else
					u(Z)
				end
			end

			local function n(x)
				u(x)
				x.Billboard:Destroy()
			end

			local function u()
				local x, O = Q, W
				Q, W, R = {}, nil, 0

				task.spawn(function()
					local K = (os.clock())

					for j, j in pairs(x) do
						if j.Highlight then
							j.Highlight:Destroy()
						end

						j.Billboard:Destroy()

						if os.clock() - K > 0.002 then
							RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							K = (os.clock())
						end
					end

					if O then
						O:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			end

			local function x(O, K, j)
				local function F()
					return K == Y and j == w and e
				end

				p()
				local K, j = {}, (os.clock())

				for p, W in pairs(O) do
					p = type(W) == "table" and W.Uid

					if type(p) == "string" and type(W.AssetCategory) == "string" then
						local R = V(W.AssetCategory)

						if D.Eggs and (b(W, R)) then
							K[p] = true
							local z = Q[p]

							if not z then
								z = i()
								Q[p] = z
							end

							M(z, W, R)
						end
					end

					if os.clock() - j > 0.002 then
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						j = os.clock()
						if not F() then
							return
						end
					end
				end

				if D.Eggs and D.OwnBase then
					for F, F in ipairs(c()) do
						O = V(F.AssetCategory)

						if b(F, O) then
							K[F.Uid] = true
							j = Q[F.Uid]

							if not j then
								j = i()
								Q[F.Uid] = j
							end

							M(j, F, O)
						end
					end
				end

				for O, j in pairs(Q) do
					if not K[O] then
						Q[O] = nil
						n(j)
					end
				end

				return true
			end

			local n, O = false, false

			local function K()
				if not e or not S then
					return
				end
				n = true
				if O then
					return
				end
				O = true

				task.defer(function()
					while e and S and n do
						n = false
						Y += 1
						local j, F = pcall(x, S, Y, w)
						local x = j and F ~= true

						if x then
							n = true
						end

						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					O = false
				end)
			end

			local function n()
				local x = w

				if S and next(Q) == nil then
					K()
				end

				local O
				local j = tbl.EggState

				if type(j) == "table" and type(j.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
					local F, p = pcall(j.ReadFieldEggs)
					O = (if F and type(p) == "table" and type(p.Records) == "table" then p.Records else O)
				end

				if O == nil and v and os.clock() >= H then
					H = os.clock() + 30
					local j, F = pcall(v.InvokeServer, v)
					O = (if j and type(F) == "table" and type(F.Records) == "table" then F.Records else O)
				end

				if x ~= w or not e then
					return
				end

				if O ~= nil then
					x = {}

					for j, F in pairs(O) do
						x[j] = F
					end

					S = x
				end

				if S then
					K()
				end
			end

			local function x()
				task.spawn(pcall, n)
			end

			local function n()
				if P then
					return
				end
				P = true

				task.delay(0.5, function()
					P = false

					if e then
						x()
					end
				end)
			end

			local function O()
				for j, j in pairs(Q) do
					m(j)
				end
			end

			local function m()
				e = false
				w += 1
				Y += 1
				tbl5.DisconnectAll(C)
				u()
			end

			local function u()
				if e then
					x()
					return
				end
				e = true
				local j, F = w, tbl.EggState

				if type(F) == "table" then
					local v = {
						"FieldRefreshed",
						"FieldShifted",
						"FieldGone",
						"FieldClaimed",
						"SnapshotRefreshed",
					}

					for H, Q in ipairs(v) do
						H = F[Q]

						if type(H) == "table" and type(H.Connect) == "function" then
							local v, Q = pcall(H.Connect, H, n)

							if v and Q then
								table.insert(C, Q)
							end
						end
					end
				end

				F = { "AreaEggSlotsClient", "PlacedEggRenders" }

				for v, H in ipairs(F) do
					v = workspace:FindFirstChild(H)

					if v then
						table.insert(C, v.ChildAdded:Connect(n))
						table.insert(C, v.ChildRemoved:Connect(n))
					end
				end

				task.spawn(function()
					while j == w do
						task.wait(10)
						if j ~= w then
							break
						end
						n()
					end
				end)

				task.spawn(function()
					while j == w do
						task.wait(1)
						if j ~= w then
							break
						end

						if D.Info.Distance then
							K()
						end
					end
				end)

				x()
			end

			local function n()
				if D.Eggs then
					u()
				else
					m()
				end
			end

			local u, x, j = { Eggs = nil }, { Eggs = false }, false

			local function F()
				if j then
					return
				end
				local v = tbl5.ReadToggle(u.Eggs, x.Eggs)
				if v == D.Eggs and e == v then
					return
				end
				D.Eggs = v
				n()
			end

			fn4(function()
				j = true
				D.Eggs = false
				m()
			end)

			local function n(m)
				local j = {}

				if type(m) == "table" then
					for v, H in pairs(m) do
						local m = H == true and type(v) == "string" and v or type(H) == "string" and H or nil

						if m then
							j[m] = true
						end
					end
				end

				return j
			end

			u.Eggs = espSection:CreateToggle({
				Name = "ESP Eggs",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function(m)
					x.Eggs = m == true
					tbl5.SyncSoon(F)
				end,
			})

			espSection:CreateToggle({
				Name = "ESP Fixed Size",
				Default = false,
				SubOf = u.Eggs,
				Callback = function(m)
					m = m == true

					if D.FixedSize ~= m then
						D.FixedSize = m
						O()
					end
				end,
			})

			espSection:CreateToggle({
				Name = "ESP Own Base Eggs",
				Note = "Also show the eggs placed in your own base",
				Default = true,
				SubOf = u.Eggs,
				Callback = function(m)
					D.OwnBase = m ~= false
					K()
				end,
			})

			do
				local m, x, j, F, v, H, Q, p = { "Any" }, { Any = 0 }, {}, {}, { "Any Mutation", "No Mutation" }, tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory, {}, {}

				if type(H) == "table" then
					for C, S in pairs(H) do
						t = type(S) == "table" and S.Rarity or nil
						local e = type(t) == "table" and (tonumber(t.RarityNumber or t.Rank)) or nil

						if e then
							local w = tostring(t.DisplayName or t._id or e)
							Q[e] = Q[e] or w

							table.insert(p, {
								Category = tostring(C),
								Name = tostring(S.DisplayName or C),
								Rarity = e,
								RarityName = w,
							})
						end
					end
				end

				H = {}

				for t in pairs(Q) do
					table.insert(H, t)
				end

				table.sort(H)

				for t, C in ipairs(H) do
					t = string.format("%d - %s", C, Q[C])
					table.insert(m, t)
					x[t] = C
				end

				table.sort(p, function(t, C)
					if t.Rarity ~= C.Rarity then
						return t.Rarity > C.Rarity
					end
					return t.Name < C.Name
				end)

				for t, t in ipairs(p) do
					H = string.format("%s [%s]", t.Name, t.RarityName)
					H = (if F[H] then (string.format("%s [%s] (%s)", t.Name, t.RarityName, t.Category)) else H)
					table.insert(j, H)
					F[H] = t.Category
				end

				j, Q = {}, tbl.Mutations

				if type(Q) == "table" and type(Q.IdSet) == "table" then
					for t in pairs(Q.IdSet) do
						table.insert(j, tostring(t))
					end
				end

				table.sort(j)

				for t, t in ipairs(j) do
					table.insert(v, t)
				end

				espSection:CreateDropdown({
					Name = "ESP Min Rarity",
					Note = "Show eggs of the chosen rarity and every rarity above it",
					Options = m,
					Default = (function(t)
						for j, j in ipairs(m) do
							if x[j] == t then
								return j
							end
						end

						return m[1]
					end)(5),
					SubOf = u.Eggs,
					Callback = function(t)
						D.MinRarity = x[type(t) == "table" and t[1] or t] or 0
						K()
					end,
				})

				fn6(espSection:CreateMultiDropdown({
					Name = "ESP Show Info",
					Options = r,
					Default = l,
					SubOf = u.Eggs,
					Callback = function(t)
						D.Info = n(t)
						K()
					end,
				}))

				local t, r, l = {
					["K/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 1000, Mult = 1000 },
					["M/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 1000, Mult = 1000000 },
					["B/s"] = { Min = 0, Max = 100, Mult = 1000000000 },
				}, 0, "M/s"

				local function n(m, x)
					if m ~= nil then
						r = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(m) or r))
					end

					if x ~= nil then
						l = tostring(x)
					end

					m = t[l] or t["M/s"]
					D.MinValue = r * m.Mult
					K()
				end

				fn5(espSection, {
					Name = "Min ESP Value",
					SubOf = u.Eggs,
					Legacy = "ESP Min Value",
					SectionName = "ESP",
					OnRaw = function(t)
						n(math.floor(t / 1000), "K/s")
					end,
				})

				espSection:CreateSlider({
					Name = "ESP Egg Size",
					Min = 50,
					Max = 200,
					Default = 75,
					Increment = 5,
					Unit = "%",
					SubOf = u.Eggs,
					Callback = function(d)
						local t = tonumber(d)

						if t and D.SizeScale ~= t / 100 then
							D.SizeScale = t / 100
							O()
						end
					end,
				})
			end
		end
	__chilliStage("starting egg ESP")
	__startCurrentFeature()
	__chilliStage("finished egg ESP")
end
do
	local __startCurrentFeature = function()
			local t = math.huge
			local r = 0.75

			local l, n, m, u, x, O = {
				Sleeping = tbl5.Palettes.Accent,
				Waking = tbl5.Palettes.Gold,
				Chasing = tbl5.Palettes.Red,
			}, tbl5.Palettes.Orange, {}, {}, false

			local function K(j)
				local F = j:GetAttribute("GuardState")

				if F == "Sleeping" then
					return "Sleeping"
				elseif F == "Waking" then
					return "Waking Up"
				elseif F == "Chasing" then
					local v = j:GetAttribute("TargetPlayer")
					if v == tostring(localPlayer.UserId) then
						return "Chasing You"
					end
					local j = tonumber(v) and (Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(v)))
					return j and "Chasing " .. j.DisplayName or "Chasing"
				end

				return F and (tostring(F)) or "Awake"
			end

			local function j(F, v)
				local H = l[v:GetAttribute("GuardState")] or n
				F.Highlight.FillColor = H.Outline
				F.Highlight.OutlineColor = H.Outline
				tbl5.SetRow(F.StateRow, K(v), H)
			end

			local function l(n)
				n.Tag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tbl5.ScaledWidth(115, r), math.floor(tbl5.RowHeight(r) * 1.6))
			end

			local function n(K)
				local F = m[K]
				if not F then
					return
				end
				m[K] = nil
				tbl5.DisconnectAll(F.Connections)
				F.Highlight:Destroy()
				F.Tag:Destroy()
			end

			local function K(F, v)
				if m[v] then
					return
				end
				local H = tbl5.FindGuardRoot(v)
				if not H then
					return
				end
				local D = not O or not O.Parent

				if D then
					O = tbl5.CreateRuntime()
				end

				D = Instance.new("Highlight")
				D.Name = fn3()
				D.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
				D.FillTransparency = 0.76
				D.OutlineTransparency = 0.02
				D.Adornee = v
				D.Parent = O
				local Q, p, C = pcall(v.GetBoundingBox, v)
				local S, e, w = (if Q and typeof(p) == "CFrame" then p.Position.Y + C.Y * 0.5 - H.Position.Y + 1 else 6), tbl5.CreateTag(O, t)
				e.Adornee = H
				e.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, S, 0)
				S, Q = tbl5.CreateTextRow(w, tbl5.StatusFont, 1, 0.45), tbl5.CreateTextRow(w, tbl5.StatusFont, 2, 0.55)
				tbl5.SetRow(S, tostring(F) .. " Guard", tbl5.Palettes.Sheen)
				local t = { Highlight = D, Tag = e, StateRow = Q, Connections = {} }
				m[v] = t
				l(t)
				j(t, v)

				local function F()
					j(t, v)
				end

				table.insert(t.Connections, v:GetAttributeChangedSignal("GuardState"):Connect(F))
				table.insert(t.Connections, v:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TargetPlayer"):Connect(F))

				table.insert(t.Connections, v.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					if not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
						n(v)
					end
				end))
			end

			local function t()
				x = false
				tbl5.DisconnectAll(u)

				for j in pairs(m) do
					n(j)
				end

				if O then
					O:Destroy()
					O = nil
				end
			end

			local function n()
				if x then
					return
				end
				x = true
				u = tbl5.WatchGuards(K)
			end

			local u
			local O, K = false, false

			local function j()

					return
				end

				if tbl5.ReadToggle(u, O) then
					n()
				elseif x then
					t()
				end
			end

			fn4(function()
				K = true
				t()
			end)

			u = espSection:CreateToggle({
				Name = "ESP Guards",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function(t)
					O = t == true
					tbl5.SyncSoon(j)
				end,
			})

			espSection:CreateSlider({
				Name = "ESP Guard Size",
				Min = 50,
				Max = 200,
				Default = 75,
				Increment = 5,
				Unit = "%",
				SubOf = u,
				Callback = function(d)
					local t = tonumber(d)

					if t and r ~= t / 100 then
						r = t / 100

						for d, d in pairs(m) do
							l(d)
						end
					end
				end,
			})
		end

	__startCurrentFeature()
	__chilliStage("finished guard ESP")

						return C(P)
					end
				end

				for Y, Y in ipairs(e:GetDescendants()) do
					w = (if Y:IsA("Decal") or (Y:IsA("Texture")) then (C(Y.Texture)) else (if Y:IsA("ImageLabel") or (Y:IsA("ImageButton")) then (C(Y.Image)) else w))

					end
				end

			local function F()
				if m then
					return
				end
				m = true
				u += 1
				local C = u
				x = tbl5.CreateRuntime()

				for x, x in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					r(x)
				end

				table.insert(K, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(r))
				table.insert(K, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(t))
				local t = workspace.CurrentCamera

				if t then
					table.insert(K, t:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(l))
				end

				task.spawn(function()

					um.Color = x(226, 178, 255)
					Km(u:Create(um, mm, { Color = x(255, 245, 255) }))
				end
			end

			local m = setthreadidentity or set_thread_identity

			local function nm()
				local mm = tbl.EggState

				if type(mm) == "table" and type(mm.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
					local um

					task.spawn(function()
						local Om, Km = pcall(mm.ReadFieldEggs)
						local mm = Om and type(Km) == "table" and type(Km.Records) == "table" and next(Km.Records) ~= nil

						if mm then
							um = Km.Records
						end
					end)

					if type(m) == "function" then
						pcall(m, 8)
					end

					if um then
						return um
					end
				end

				local m = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFieldEggSnapshot")
				if not m or not m:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
					return nil
				end
				local mm, um = false

				task.spawn(function()
					local Om, Km = pcall(m.InvokeServer, m)
					local m = Om and type(Km) == "table" and type(Km.Records) == "table"

					if m then
						um = Km.Records
					end

					mm = true
				end)

				local m = os.clock()

				while not mm and os.clock() - m < 4 do
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				return um
			end

			local function m()
				return C ~= nil and (C.ActivePets and C.ActivePets.Enabled or C.GrowingEggs and C.GrowingEggs.Enabled) or false
			end

			local function mm()
				local um, Om, Km = ipairs, { C.ActivePets, C.GrowingEggs }, false

				for jm, Fm in um(Om) do
					if Fm and Fm.Enabled then
						jm = Fm:FindFirstChild("Frame")
						local um, Om = jm and (jm:FindFirstChild("Close")), false

						if um and typeof(getconnections) == "function" then
							local jm, vm = pcall(getconnections, um.Activated)

							if jm and type(vm) == "table" then
								for um, um in ipairs(vm) do
									Om = (if pcall(function()
										um:Fire()
									end) then true else Om)
								end
							end
						end

						if not Om then
							Fm.Enabled = false
						end

						Km = true
					end
				end

				return Km
			end

			local function um(Om, Km)
				local jm = C and C.Column
				if not jm or not jm.Parent then
					return
				end

				if M then
					M:Cancel()
					M = nil
				end

				local Fm = jm.Position
				local vm = UDim2.new(Fm.X.Scale, Om and (math.ceil(jm.AbsoluteSize.X * 1.03)) or 0, Fm.Y.Scale, Fm.Y.Offset)
				if Km then
					jm.Position = vm
					return
				end
				M = u:Create(jm, Om and l or n, { Position = vm })
				M:Play()
			end

			local l, n, M = UDim2.new(0.955, 0, 0.6, 0), UDim2.new(0.849, 0, 0.6, 0), UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.56, 0)

			local function Om(Km, jm)
				if Km and Km.Button.Visible ~= jm then
					Km.Button.Visible = jm
				end
			end

			local function Km(jm, Fm, vm, Hm)
				local Dm = Fm ~= nil
				jm.Rank = Fm
				Om(jm.Steal, not Dm)
				Om(jm.Up, Dm)
				Om(jm.Down, Dm)
				Om(jm.Cancel, Dm)

				if Dm then
					rm(jm.Up, Fm > 1 and K.Hud or K.Queued)
					rm(jm.Down, Fm < (Hm or Fm) and K.Hud or K.Queued)
				end

				rm(jm.Star, Fm == 1 and K.PriorityOn or K.Queued)

				if jm.Badge then
					if jm.Badge.Visible ~= Dm then
						jm.Badge.Visible = Dm
					end

					if Dm then
						F(jm.Badge, "#" .. Fm)
						Hm = vm and K.Steal or K.PriorityOn

						if jm.BadgeStyle ~= Hm and jm.BadgeGradient then
							jm.BadgeStyle = Hm
							jm.BadgeGradient.Color = Hm.Color
							jm.BadgeGradient.Rotation = 90
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local Om = nil

			Om = function()
				if not o then
					return
				end
				local jm = tbl4.Toggle(v4, false)

				if o.On ~= jm then
					o.On = jm
					rm(o.Toggle, jm and K.Steal or K.Cancel)
					F(o.Toggle.Label, jm and "Auto Steal: ON" or "Auto Steal: OFF")
				end

				jm = tbl4.SafeCarry.LineDrop == true

				if o.Guard and o.GuardOn ~= jm then
					o.GuardOn = jm
					rm(o.Guard, jm and K.Steal or K.Cancel)
					F(o.Guard.Label, jm and "Instant Steal: ON" or "Instant Steal: OFF")
				end

				if V and o.SortShown ~= tbl4.StealSort then
					o.SortShown = tbl4.StealSort
					F(V.Label, "Sort: " .. tostring(tbl4.StealSort))
				end
			end

			local jm, Fm = {}, {}

			local function vm()
				if not z then
					return
				end
				Om()
				local Hm = {}

				for Dm, Dm in pairs(I) do
					table.insert(Hm, Dm)
				end

				local Dm, Qm = {}

				if type(tbl4.StealPlan) == "function" then
					task.spawn(function()
						local pm, Cm, Sm = pcall(tbl4.StealPlan)

						if pm and type(Cm) == "table" then
							Dm, Qm = Cm, Sm
						end
					end)
				end

				local pm = {}

				for Cm, Sm in ipairs(Dm) do
					if pm[Sm] == nil then
						pm[Sm] = Cm
					end
				end

				local Cm = tbl4.StealSort

				table.sort(Hm, function(Sm, em)
					local wm, Ym = pm[Sm.Uid], pm[em.Uid]
					if wm ~= nil ~= (Ym ~= nil) then
						return wm ~= nil
					end

					if wm and Ym then
						return wm < Ym
					end

					if Cm == tbl4.StealSortOptions[1] and Sm.Style.RarityNumber ~= em.Style.RarityNumber then
						return Sm.Style.RarityNumber > em.Style.RarityNumber
					elseif Cm == tbl4.StealSortOptions[2] and (Sm.Weight or 0) ~= (em.Weight or 0) then
						return (Sm.Weight or 0) > (em.Weight or 0)
					elseif Cm == tbl4.StealSortOptions[5] and Sm.Value ~= em.Value then
						return Sm.Value < em.Value
					end

					if Sm.Value ~= em.Value then
						return Sm.Value > em.Value
					end
					return Sm.Uid < em.Uid
				end)

				local Cm, Sm, em = os.clock(), {}, {}

				for wm, Ym in ipairs(Hm) do
					wm = jm[Ym.Uid]

					if wm and wm > Cm and Fm[Ym.Uid] then
						table.insert(em, Ym)
					else
						jm[Ym.Uid] = nil
						table.insert(Sm, Ym)
					end
				end

				table.sort(em, function(Hm, wm)
					return Fm[Hm.Uid] < Fm[wm.Uid]
				end)

				for Hm, Hm in ipairs(em) do
					table.insert(Sm, math.clamp(Fm[Hm.Uid], 1, #Sm + 1), Hm)
				end

				table.clear(Fm)

				for Hm, em in ipairs(Sm) do
					Fm[em.Uid] = Hm
					Cm = f[em.Uid]

					if Cm then
						if Cm.Frame.LayoutOrder ~= Hm then
							Cm.Frame.LayoutOrder = Hm
						end

						Km(Cm, pm[em.Uid], em.Uid == Qm, #Dm)
					end
				end
			end

			local function Km()
				if not z then
					return
				end
				local Fm = math.max(1, math.floor(z.AbsoluteSize.X / 4.426229508196721 + 0.5))
				if Fm == Z then
					return
				end
				Z = Fm

				for Hm, Hm in pairs(f) do
					Hm.Frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Fm)
				end
			end

			local function Fm(Hm)
				local Dm = i:Clone()
				local Qm = Dm:FindFirstChild("Spacer")
				local pm = Qm:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")

				local Cm = {
					Uid = Hm,
					Frame = Dm,
					Icon = Qm:FindFirstChild("Icon"),
					Label = pm,
					ValueLabel = Qm:FindFirstChild("Value"),
					DetailLabel = Qm:FindFirstChild("Detail"),
					Gradient = pm and (pm:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")),
					Steal = dm(Qm:FindFirstChild("Unequip")),
					Cancel = dm(Qm:FindFirstChild("Cancel")),
					Star = dm(Qm:FindFirstChild("Star")),
					Up = dm(Qm:FindFirstChild("Up")),
					Down = dm(Qm:FindFirstChild("Down")),
					Badge = Qm:FindFirstChild("Rank"),
				}

				Cm.BadgeGradient = Cm.Badge and (Cm.Badge:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")) or nil

				if pm and not Cm.Gradient then
					Cm.Gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
					Cm.Gradient.Parent = pm
				end

				lm(Cm.Steal)
				lm(Cm.Cancel)
				lm(Cm.Star)
				lm(Cm.Up)
				lm(Cm.Down)
				pm, Qm = ipairs, { { Cm.Up, -1 }, { Cm.Down, 1 } }

				for Hm, Hm in pm(Qm) do
					if Hm[1] then
						Hm[1].Button.Activated:Connect(function()
							if type(tbl4.MoveInPlan) == "function" then
								tbl4.MoveInPlan(Cm.Uid, Hm[2])
							end

							tbl4.UiDefer(vm)
						end)
					end
				end

				if Cm.Steal then
					Cm.Steal.Button.Activated:Connect(function()
						if Cm.Rank == nil and type(tbl4.StealNow) == "function" then
							tbl4.StealNow(Cm.Uid, false)
						end

						tbl4.UiDefer(vm)
					end)
				end

				if Cm.Cancel then
					Cm.Cancel.Button.Activated:Connect(function()
						jm[Cm.Uid] = os.clock() + 4

						if type(tbl4.CancelSteal) == "function" then
							tbl4.CancelSteal(Cm.Uid)
						end

						tbl4.UiDefer(vm)
					end)
				end

				if Cm.Star then
					Cm.Star.Button.Activated:Connect(function()
						if type(tbl4.PrioritizeSteal) == "function" then
							tbl4.PrioritizeSteal(Cm.Uid)
						end

						tbl4.UiDefer(vm)
					end)
				end

				G(Dm, true)
				J(Dm)
				Dm.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(Z, 1))
				Dm.Visible = true
				Dm.Parent = z
				return Cm
			end

			local function jm(Hm, Dm)
				local Qm = Dm.Style

				if Hm.Category ~= Dm.Category then
					Hm.Category = Dm.Category

					if Hm.Icon then
						Hm.Icon.Image = Qm.Icon
					end

					if Hm.Gradient then
						Hm.Gradient.Color = Qm.GradientColor
						Hm.Gradient.Rotation = Qm.GradientRotation
					end
				end

				F(Hm.Label, Qm.Name)
				F(Hm.ValueLabel, v(Dm.Value))
				F(Hm.DetailLabel, Dm.Detail or "")
			end

			local function v(Hm)
				Hm = tonumber(Hm) or 0
				local Dm = Hm >= 1000 and (string.format("%.0f", Hm)) or (string.format("%.2f", Hm))
				local Qm, pm = string.match(Dm, "^(%-?%d+)(%.%d+)$")
				Hm = Qm or Dm

				while true do
					Dm, Qm = string.gsub(Hm, "^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
					if Qm == 0 then
						Hm = Dm
						break
					end
					Hm = Dm
				end

				return Hm .. (pm or "") .. " Kg"
			end

			local function Hm(Dm, Qm)
				local pm = string.format("x%.2f", Qm)
				local Cm = 0
				local Sm = tbl.EggRecords

				if type(Sm) == "table" and type(Sm.WeightKgForScale) == "function" then
					local em, wm = pcall(Sm.WeightKgForScale, Dm, Qm)

					if em and (tonumber(wm)) then
						Cm, pm = (tonumber(wm)), pm .. "  " .. utf8.char(183) .. "  " .. v(wm)
					end
				end

				return pm, Cm
			end

			local v

			local function Dm(Qm)
				local pm = nm()

				if pm and Qm == Q and D then
					local nm, Cm, Sm = {}, -1
					local em = (os.clock())

					for wm, Ym in pairs(pm) do
						local pm, Pm = type(Ym) == "table" and Ym.Uid or nil, Ym.State == "Slot" or Ym.State == "Dropped" or Ym.State == "Carried"

						if type(pm) == "string" and Pm and type(Ym.AssetCategory) == "string" then
							nm[pm] = true
							local Pm, Wm = H(Ym.AssetCategory), I[pm]

							if not Wm then
								Wm = { Uid = pm }
								I[pm] = Wm
							end

							wm = tonumber(Ym.AssetScale) or 1

							if Wm.Detail == nil or Wm.Scale ~= wm or Wm.Category ~= Ym.AssetCategory then
								Wm.Scale = wm
								Wm.Detail, Wm.Weight = Hm(Ym.AssetCategory, wm)
							end

							Wm.Category = Ym.AssetCategory
							Wm.Style = Pm
							Wm.Value = j(Ym, Pm)
							Wm.Position = typeof(Ym.BottomCFrame) == "CFrame" and Ym.BottomCFrame.Position or nil

							if (Ym.State == "Slot" or Ym.State == "Dropped") and Pm.Icon ~= "" and Wm.Value > Cm then
								Cm, Sm = Wm.Value, Wm
							end

							if A and z then
								Pm = f[pm]

								if not Pm then
									Pm = Fm(pm)
									f[pm] = Pm
								end

								jm(Pm, Wm)
							end
						end

						if os.clock() - em > 0.002 then
							RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
							em = os.clock()
							if Qm ~= Q or not D then
								return
							end
						end
					end

					for j in pairs(I) do
						if not nm[j] then
							I[j] = nil
							Cm = f[j]

							if Cm then
								f[j] = nil
								Cm.Frame:Destroy()
							end
						end
					end

					if w and Sm and w.Image ~= Sm.Style.Icon then
						w.Image = Sm.Style.Icon
					end

					vm()
				end
			end

			local j = 0

			local function H(nm)
				if g and os.clock() - j < 10 then
					_ = true
					return
				end
				g = true
				j = os.clock()
				local jm = j
				pcall(Dm, nm)
				nm = j

				if nm == jm then
					g = false
				end

				if _ then
					_ = false
					v()
				end
			end

			v = function()
				if s or not D then
					return
				end
				s = true
				local j = Q

				task.delay(A and 0.15 or 1, function()
					s = false

					if D and j == Q then
						task.spawn(pcall, H, j)
					end
				end)
			end

			local function j(g)
				if A or not P then
					return
				end
				A = true

				if g then
					h:Set(true)
				end

				if mm() then
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					if not A or not P then
						return
					end
				end

				um(true)
				P.Visible = true
				Y.Enabled = true

				if b then
					b:Cancel()
				end

				P.Position = UDim2.new(W.X.Scale, math.ceil(P.AbsoluteSize.X * 1.392), W.Y.Scale, W.Y.Offset)
				b = u:Create(P, t, { Position = W })
				b:Play()
				N()
				Km()
				task.spawn(pcall, H, Q)
			end

			local function t(g, nm)
				if not A or not P then
					return
				end
				A = false

				if nm then
					h:Set(false)
				end

				if b then
					b:Cancel()
				end

				local nm = u:Create(P, r, {
					Position = UDim2.new(W.X.Scale, math.ceil(P.AbsoluteSize.X * 1.392), W.Y.Scale, W.Y.Offset),
				})

				b = nm

				nm.Completed:Connect(function(r)
					if r == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and b == nm and not A and Y then
						Y.Enabled = false
						P.Position = W
					end
				end)

				nm:Play()

				if g then
					um(false)
				end
			end

			local function r(u)
				local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
				g.Name = fn3()
				g.Archivable = false
				g.ResetOnSpawn = false
				g.IgnoreGuiInset = u.IgnoreGuiInset
				g.ZIndexBehavior = u.ZIndexBehavior
				g.DisplayOrder = u.DisplayOrder

				pcall(function()
					g.ScreenInsets = u.ScreenInsets
				end)

				return g
			end

			local function u()
				if S and S.Parent and e and e.Button then
					return true
				end
				local g = E(C.Pets)
				if not g then
					return false
				end

				local nm = {
					"Notification",
					"ReadyNotification",
					"NightImage",
					"NightText",
					"ConsoleButton",
					"Badge",
				}

				for mm, jm in ipairs(nm) do
					mm = g:FindFirstChild(jm)

					if mm then
						mm:Destroy()
					end
				end

				e = dm(g)
				w = g:FindFirstChild("ImageLabel")

				if e.Scale then
					e.Scale.Scale = 1
				end

				rm(e, K.Chilli)
				lm(e)
				xm(e)
				g.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

				g.Activated:Connect(function()

									pcall(j, true)
								end
							end)

							return
						end

						if A then
							t(true, true)
						else
							j(true)
						end
					end)
				end)

				G(g)
				J(g)
				S = r(C.Hud)
				g.Parent = S
				S.Parent = v3
				return true
			end

			local g, nm

			local function mm()
				local jm, Fm, Hm = e and e.Button, C.Eggs, C.Pets
				if not jm or not Fm.Parent or not Hm.Parent then
					return
				end

				if C.Hud.Enabled and C.GameHud.Visible and C.Column.Visible and Fm.Visible and Hm.Visible and Fm.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
					local Dm = Fm:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
					local Qm = Dm and Dm.Scale or 1
					Qm = (if Qm <= 0 then 1 else Qm)
					local pm, Cm, Sm, em = Fm.AbsolutePosition + Fm.AbsoluteSize / 2, Hm.AbsolutePosition + Hm.AbsoluteSize / 2, Fm.AbsoluteSize / Qm, S.AbsolutePosition
					Qm, Dm = UDim2.fromOffset(pm.X - em.X, pm.Y - (Cm.Y - pm.Y) - em.Y), UDim2.fromOffset(Sm.X, Sm.Y)

					if not A then
						g, nm = Qm, Dm
					end

					if jm.Position ~= Qm then
						jm.Position = Qm
					end

					if jm.Size ~= Dm then
						jm.Size = Dm
						tm()
					end
				elseif not A and g then
					if jm.Position ~= g then
						jm.Position = g
					end

					if nm and jm.Size ~= nm then
						jm.Size = nm
						tm()
					end
				end

				if jm.Visible ~= true then
					jm.Visible = true
				end
			end

			local function g()
				local nm = C.ActivePets.Frame
				local jm = E(nm)
				if not jm then
					return false
				end
				local E, Fm, Hm = jm:FindFirstChild("Header"), jm:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame"), jm:FindFirstChild("Close")
				local Dm = Fm and (Fm:FindFirstChild("Template"))
				local Qm = Dm and (Dm:FindFirstChild("Spacer"))
				local pm, Cm = Qm and (Qm:FindFirstChild("Unequip")), Qm and (Qm:FindFirstChild("TextLabel"))
				if not (E and Fm and Hm and Qm and pm and Cm) then
                    warn("[Chilli pet preview] ActivePets.Frame template is missing Header, ScrollingFrame.Template.Spacer, Close, Unequip, or TextLabel")
					jm:Destroy()
					return false
				end

				for Sm, Sm in ipairs(Fm:GetChildren()) do
					if Sm ~= Dm and (Sm:IsA("GuiObject")) and Sm.Name ~= "EmptyLast" then
						Sm:Destroy()
					end
				end

				local Sm = jm:FindFirstChild("EquipBest")

				if Sm then
					Sm:Destroy()
				end

				Sm = jm:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
				local em = Sm and Sm.AspectRatio or 1.25
				local wm = not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
				local Ym, Pm = wm and 1.2 or 1, wm and 1.15 or 1
				wm = 0.86 / Pm
				local Wm = wm / em
				a = { Width = nm.Size.X.Scale, Height = nm.Size.Y.Scale, Aspect = em }
				jm.Size = UDim2.new(0.3 * Ym, 0, 0.62 * Ym * Pm, 0)

				if not Sm then
					Sm = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
					Sm.Parent = jm
				end

				Sm.AspectRatio = wm
				Sm.AspectType = Enum.AspectType.FitWithinMaxSize
				E.Size = UDim2.new(E.Size.X.Scale, E.Size.X.Offset, E.Size.Y.Scale * Wm, E.Size.Y.Offset)
				E.Position = UDim2.new(E.Position.X.Scale, E.Position.X.Offset, E.Position.Y.Scale * Wm, E.Position.Y.Offset)
				Hm.Size = UDim2.new(Hm.Size.X.Scale * 1, Hm.Size.X.Offset, Hm.Size.Y.Scale * Wm, Hm.Size.Y.Offset)
				Hm.Position = UDim2.new(Hm.Position.X.Scale * 1, Hm.Position.X.Offset, Hm.Position.Y.Scale, Hm.Position.Y.Offset)
				Sm, em, wm = Fm.Size.Y.Scale, Fm.Position.Y.Scale, Fm.AnchorPoint.Y

				return (string.gsub(tostring(t), "[<>&]", { ["<"] = "&lt;", [">"] = "&gt;", ["&"] = "&amp;" }))
			end

				return tbl.ChilliPresentation.Paint(tbl.ChilliPresentation.Color.Separator, "  " .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.Bullet .. "  ")
			end

			tbl.ChilliPresentation.FormatRate = function(t)
				t = tonumber(t) or 0

				if t >= 1000000000000 then
					return string.format("%.2fT/s", t / 1000000000000)
				elseif t >= 1000000000 then
					return string.format("%.2fB/s", t / 1000000000)
				elseif t >= 1000000 then
					return string.format("%.2fM/s", t / 1000000)
				elseif t >= 1000 then
					return string.format("%.1fK/s", t / 1000)
				end

				return string.format("%d/s", math.floor(t))
			end

			tbl.ChilliPresentation.FormatWeight = function(t)
				t = tonumber(t) or 0
				local r = t >= 1000 and (string.format("%.0f", t)) or (string.format("%.2f", t))
				local l, n = string.match(r, "^(%-?%d+)(%.%d+)$")
				t = l or r

				while true do
					r, l = string.gsub(t, "^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
					if l == 0 then
						t = r
						break
					end
					t = r
				end

				return t .. (n or "") .. " Kg"
			end

			tbl.ChilliPresentation.FormatClock = function(t)
				local r = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(t) or 0))
				return string.format("%02dh %02dm %02ds", math.floor(r / 3600), math.floor(r % 3600 / 60), r % 60)
			end

			tbl.ChilliPresentation.ScaleFactor = function(t)
				if t > 5 then
					return (t / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113
				end
				return t ^ 1.85
			end

					local l, n = pcall(t.EarningsFor, r)

					end
				end

				return 1
			end

			local function r(l)

				end

			end

					return l

				if u == nil and type(m) == "table" then
					local x = string.gsub(string.lower(n), "[^%a%d]", "")

					for O, K in pairs(m) do
						if type(K) == "table" then
							local m, j = { tostring(O), tostring(K._id or ""), tostring(K.DisplayName or "") }, type(K.Egg) == "table" and K.Egg or nil

							if j ~= nil then
								m[#m + 1] = tostring(j.ModelName or "")
							end

							for O, O in ipairs(m) do
								if O ~= "" and string.gsub(string.lower(O), "[^%a%d]", "") == x then
									u = K
									break
								end
							end
						end

						if u ~= nil then
							break
						end
					end
				end

				local m, x = type(u) == "table" and type(u.Rarity) == "table" and u.Rarity or nil, type(u) == "table" and u.Icon or nil
				local O, K = m and (tostring(m.DisplayName or m._id or "Common")) or "Common", m and typeof(m.Color) == "Color3" and m.Color or (Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))

			local function F()

					return

					p = V + 0.1

					b = tonumber(H("GetBannerWeight", M.Id)) or 0
					h, c = h + b, (if M.Id == A then b else c)
				end

					W.Chance[h] = c
				end

			end

			local function i(h)
				local c, b, M = H("GetBanner", h), {}, 0

				for Z, o in ipairs(type(c) == "table" and c.Pets or {}) do
					Z = tonumber(H("GetPetWeight", h, o.AssetId)) or 0

					if Z > 0 then
						M += Z
						table.insert(b, { AssetId = o.AssetId, Weight = Z })
					end
				end

				for h, h in ipairs(b) do
					h.Chance = M > 0 and h.Weight / M * 100 or 0
				end

				table.sort(b, function(h, c)

				if not b then
					return ""

			local function c(b)
				local M = math.max(0, math.floor(b))
				local b, Z, o = math.floor(M / 86400), math.floor(M % 86400 / 3600), math.floor(M % 3600 / 60)
				if b > 0 then
					return string.format("%dd %dh %02dm", b, Z, o)
				end
				return string.format("%dh %02dm", Z, o)
			end

			local function b(M)
				return r(t(M >= 10 and l.Income or (M >= 1 and l.Clock or "#FF7A7A"), (string.format(M >= 1 and "%.1f%%" or "%.2f%%", M))))
			end

			local function M(Z)
				if Z <= 0 then
					return ""
				end
				local o = 100 / Z
				return t(l.Hint, o < 10 and (string.format("1 in %.1f", o)) or (string.format("1 in %d", math.floor(o + 0.5))))
			end

			local function Z(o)
				if next(tbl4.Lab.Banners) ~= nil and tbl4.Lab.Banners[tostring(o)] then
					return tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. r(t(l.Ready, "Your pick"))
				end
				return ""
			end

			local function o()
				if Q or os.clock() < p then
					return
				end
				Q = true
				p = os.clock() + 30

				task.spawn(function()
					local p = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskState")

					if p and (p:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
						local a, X = pcall(p.InvokeServer, p)
						local p = a and type(X) == "table"

						if p then
							D = X
						end
					end

					Q = false
				end)
			end

			local function Q(p, a, X)
				local f = p ~= nil
				n:SetDock(f and 5 or 0, { Gap = 0.22 })
				m.Icon.Set({ Visible = f })
				m.Name.Set({ Visible = f })
				m.Rarity.Set({ Visible = f })
				m.Info.Set({ Visible = f })
				if not f then
					return
				end
				local I, U = R(p), H("GetBannerEggIcon", p)

				m.Icon.Set({
					Visible = type(U) == "string" and U ~= "",
					Image = type(U) == "string" and U or "",
					StrokeColor = Color3.fromHex(I),
				})

				m.Name.Set({ Text = tbl.ChilliPresentation.Escape(V(p)) })
				m.Rarity.Set({ Text = "ACTIVE", Color = Color3.fromHex(l.Ready), Gradient = nil })
				I = X - a % X

				X, f = {
					r(t(l.Clock, "Ends in " .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.FormatClock(I))) .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. t(l.Text, i(a + I)),
					t(l.Hint, "Banner chance ") .. b(A(p)),
				}, D

				if type(f) == "table" and f.BannerId == p then
					if f.Unlocked == false then
						table.insert(X, t("#FF7A7A", "Locked on this account"))
					else
						table.insert(X, t(l.Hint, "Pity ") .. r(t(l.Text, string.format("%s/%s", tostring(f.PityCount or 0), tostring(f.PityThreshold or 0)))) .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. t(l.Hint, "Free rerolls ") .. r(t(l.Text, tostring(f.FreeRefreshesRemaining or 0))))
					end
				end

				m.Info.Set({ Text = table.concat(X, "\n") })
			end

			local function m()
				if not n then
					return
				end
				S = 2
				table.clear(O)
				local p, a = 0, 0

				local function X(f, I)
					p += 1
					local U = j(p)
					U.Set({ Visible = true, Text = f })
					table.insert(O, { Kind = "text", Handle = U, Gap = I })
				end

				local function j(f, I)
					X(string.format("<b><font color=\"%s\">%s</font></b>", I, f), #O > 0)
				end

				local function f()
					a += 1
					local I = v(a)
					I.Frame.Set({ Visible = true })
					table.insert(O, { Kind = "slot", Slot = I })
					return I
				end

				local O, v = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), tonumber(H("RotationSeconds")) or 3600
				local I = math.floor(O / v)

				if os.clock() >= W.Clears then
					W.Clears = os.clock() + 60
					table.clear(W.Banner)
					table.clear(W.Odds)
					table.clear(W.Chance)
				end

				local W = z(I)

				if type(K) ~= "table" or W == nil then
					Q(nil)
					X(r(t(l.Hint, "Lab data is not available yet")), false)
				else
					Q(W, O, v)
					local Q = D

					if type(Q) == "table" and Q.BannerId == W and type(Q.Requirements) == "table" and #Q.Requirements > 0 then
						j("CURRENT RECIPE", l.Text)
						local D = {}

						for U, N in ipairs(Q.Requirements) do
							U = tbl.ChilliPresentation.AssetInfo(N)
							table.insert(D, r(t(U.Hex, tbl.ChilliPresentation.Escape(U.Name))))
						end

						X(table.concat(D, tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator()), false)
					end

					j("REWARD ODDS" .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. string.upper(V(W)), R(W))
					Q = h(W)

					for D, U in ipairs(Q) do
						local N, q = tbl.ChilliPresentation.AssetInfo(U.AssetId), f()
						q.Icon.Set({ Visible = N.Icon ~= nil, Image = N.Icon or "", StrokeColor = N.Color })
						q.Name.Set({ Text = tbl.ChilliPresentation.Escape(N.Name) })

						q.Rarity.Set({
							Text = string.upper(tostring(N.Rarity)),
							Color = w(N),
							Gradient = e(N),
							GradientRotation = Y(N),
						})

						q.Status.Set({ Text = b(U.Chance) })
						N = M(U.Chance)

						q.Detail.Set({
							Text = (if D == #Q then N .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. r(t(l.Clock, "Chase pet")) else N),
						})
					end

					j("UPCOMING LAB BANNERS", l.Text)

					for D = 1, 8, 1 do
						local e, w, Y = z(I + D), (I + D) * v, f()
						local M, f = H("GetBannerEggIcon", e), R(e)

						Y.Icon.Set({
							Visible = type(M) == "string" and M ~= "",
							Image = type(M) == "string" and M or "",
							StrokeColor = Color3.fromHex(f),
						})

						Y.Name.Set({ Text = tbl.ChilliPresentation.Escape(V(e)) })

						Y.Rarity.Set({
							Text = D == 1 and "NEXT" or "#" .. D,
							Color = Color3.fromHex(f),
							Gradient = nil,
						})

						Y.Status.Set({ Text = r(t(l.Clock, "in " .. c(w - O))) })
						Q = h(e)
						M, f = Q[#Q], t(l.Hint, "Starts ") .. t(l.Text, i(w)) .. Z(e)

						if M then
							D = tbl.ChilliPresentation.AssetInfo(M.AssetId)
							f ..= tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. t(l.Hint, "Chase ") .. r(t(D.Hex, tbl.ChilliPresentation.Escape(D.Name))) .. " " .. b(M.Chance)
						end

						Y.Detail.Set({ Text = f })
					end

					j("NEXT TIME EACH BANNER OPENS", l.Text)

					for j, H in ipairs(K.Banners or {}) do
						j, Q = r(t(R(H.Id), tbl.ChilliPresentation.Escape(V(H.Id)))), H.Id

						if Q == W then
							j ..= tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. r(t(l.Ready, "Open now"))
						else
							local K

							for D = 1, 2000, 1 do
								if z(I + D) == H.Id then
									K = D
									break
								end
							end

							if K then
								local D = (I + K) * v
								j ..= tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. r(t(l.Clock, "in " .. c(D - O))) .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. t(l.Text, i(D))
							else
								j ..= tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. t(l.Hint, "Not soon")
							end
						end

						X(j .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator() .. t(l.Hint, "chance ") .. b(A(H.Id)) .. Z(H.Id), false)
					end
				end

				for t = p + 1, #x, 1 do
					x[t].Set({ Visible = false })
				end

				for t = a + 1, #u, 1 do
					u[t].Frame.Set({ Visible = false })
				end

				F()
				S = 2
			end

			if not tbl.ChilliPresentation.Ready then
				tbl.LabPredictorSection:CreateText({
					Name = "Lab Predictor",
					Text = "Update the Chilli Library to use the predictor canvas.",
				})
			else
				local t = tbl.LabPredictorSection:CreateCanvas({
					Name = "Lab Predictor",
					Layout = "free",
					Style = {
						TextScale = 0.84,
						LineHeight = 1.1,
						MinLines = 16,
						MaxLines = 34,
						BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
						ScrollBarColor = Color3.fromRGB(170, 174, 184),
						TextColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
						TextStrokeTransparency = 0.7,
					},
					Build = function(r)
						P(r)
						pcall(m)
					end,
				})

				fn4(function()
					t:Destroy()
				end)

				local t = 1

				local r = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(l)
					if not n or not tbl.ChilliPresentation.PageVisible() or not tbl.ChilliPresentation.IsShown(n:Root()) then
						return
					end
					o()
					t += l

					if t >= 1 then
						t = 0
						pcall(m)
					end

					if S > 0 or C then
						l = S

						if l > 0 then
							S -= 1
						end

						pcall(F)
					end
				end)

				fn4(function()
					r:Disconnect()
				end)
			end
		end
	__chilliStage("starting Lab predictor")
	__startCurrentFeature()
	__chilliStage("finished Lab predictor")
end
do
	local __startCurrentFeature = function()
			local t, r, l
			local n, m, u, x, O = false, 0, 0, 0
			local K, j, F = 0, "", false

			local function v(H, D)
				local Q = networking:FindFirstChild(H)
				if not Q or not Q:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
					return false, nil, nil
				end

				if D == nil then
					return pcall(Q.InvokeServer, Q)
				end
				return pcall(Q.InvokeServer, Q, D)
			end

			local function H()
				local D = tbl.Save
				if type(D) ~= "table" or type(D.Get) ~= "function" then
					return nil
				end
				local Q, p = pcall(D.Get)
				return Q and type(p) == "table" and p or nil
			end

			local function D(Q)
				local p = tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory
				local C = type(p) == "table" and p[tostring(Q)] or nil
				return tostring(type(C) == "table" and C.DisplayName or Q)
			end

			local function Q(p)
				if not p and type(O) == "table" and os.clock() < x then
					return O
				end
				x = os.clock() + 1
				local p, C = v("RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskState")

				if p and type(C) == "table" then
					O = C
					K = os.clock()
				end

				return O
			end

			local function p()
				local C = {}
				local S = tbl.EggState

				if type(S) == "table" and type(S.ReadOwnerEggs) == "function" then
					local e, w = pcall(S.ReadOwnerEggs, localPlayer.UserId)

					if e and type(w) == "table" then
						for S, e in pairs(w) do
							if type(e) == "table" and e.Placement ~= nil then
								C[S] = true
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return C
			end

			local function C(S, e)
				local w = type(S) == "table" and S.Requirements or nil
				if type(w) ~= "table" or #w == 0 then
					return nil, "No active recipe", {}
				end
				local Y, P, W = p(), {}, {}

				for p, p in ipairs(w) do
					P[tostring(p)] = {}
				end

				for p, R in pairs(e.EggInventory or {}) do
					S = type(R) == "table" and (tostring(R.AssetCategory)) or nil
					local e = S and P[S] or nil

					if e then
						if Y[p] then
							W[S] = true
						else
							local Y = R.BaseMutation ~= nil and R.BaseMutation ~= "Normal" or type(R.Mutations) == "table" and next(R.Mutations) ~= nil
							table.insert(e, { Uid = p, Scale = tonumber(R.AssetScale) or 0, Mutated = Y })
						end
					end
				end

				for p, p in pairs(P) do
					table.sort(p, function(p, e)
						if p.Mutated ~= e.Mutated then
							return e.Mutated
						end
						return p.Scale < e.Scale
					end)
				end

				local p, e, Y, R = {}, {}, {}

				for V, z in ipairs(w) do
					S = nil

					for w, w in ipairs(P[tostring(z)] or {}) do
						if not e[w.Uid] then
							S = w
							break
						end
					end

					if S then
						e[S.Uid] = true
						Y[V] = S.Uid
						table.insert(p, S.Uid)
					else
						R = (if not R then (if W[tostring(z)] then "Need a " .. D(z) .. " egg, yours is placed on a nest" else "Need a " .. D(z) .. " egg") else R)
					end
				end

				if R then
					return nil, R, e, Y
				end
				return p, nil, e, Y
			end

			local p = {}

			local function S()
				local e = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
				local w = e and (e:FindFirstChild("DrScrambleTradeIn"))
				local Y, P = w and (w:FindFirstChild("DrScrambleTradeInMain")), w and (w:FindFirstChild("DrScrambleTradeInInventory", true))
				e = Y and (Y:FindFirstChild("SacrificeInputs"))
				if not Y or not P or not e then
					return nil
				end
				return { Main = Y, Inventory = P, Inputs = e }
			end

			local function e(w)
				if typeof(w) ~= "Instance" or not w:IsA("GuiButton") then
					return false
				end
				local Y, P = pcall(getconnections, w.Activated)
				if not Y or type(P) ~= "table" or #P == 0 then
					return false
				end
				w = false

				for W, R in ipairs(P) do
					Y, W = pcall(function()
						return R.Function
					end)

					local P

					if Y and type(W) == "function" then
						local Y, V = pcall(debug.getupvalues, W)

						if Y and type(V) == "table" then
							for Y = 1, #V, 1 do
								if type(V[Y]) == "function" then
									P = V[Y]
									break
								end
							end
						end
					end

					w = (if P then pcall(P) or w else pcall(function()
						R:Fire()
					end) or w)
				end

				return w
			end

			local function w(Y)
				local P = Y and (Y:FindFirstChild("Full"))
				return P ~= nil and P.Visible == true
			end

			local function Y(P, W)
				for R = 1, W, 1 do
					if not w(P.Inputs:FindFirstChild("Input" .. R)) then
						return false
					end
				end

				return W > 0
			end

			local function P(W, R)
				local V, z = S(), type(W) == "table" and W.Requirements or nil
				if not V or type(z) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				for i = 1, #z, 1 do
					local A, h = V.Inputs:FindFirstChild("Input" .. i), R[i]

					if A and h and not w(A) and (p[h] or 0) <= os.clock() then
						W = A:FindFirstChild("Empty")

						if e(W and (W:FindFirstChild("Add"))) then
							local W, R, i = V.Inventory:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame"), 0

							while R < 2 do
								i = W and (W:FindFirstChild("Egg_" .. h))
								if i then
									break
								end
								R += task.wait(0.1)
							end

							if i then
								e(i)
							end

							R = 0

							while R < 2 and not w(A) do
								R += task.wait(0.1)
							end

							if V.Inventory.Visible then
								if not e(V.Inventory:FindFirstChild("Close")) then
									V.Inventory.Visible = false
								end
							end
						end

						if not w(A) then
							p[h] = os.clock() + 30
						end
					end
				end

				return Y(V, #z)
			end

			local function p()
				local w = O
				if type(w) ~= "table" then
					return "Lab status unknown"
				end

				if w.Unlocked ~= true then
					return "Lab is locked on this account"
				end
				local Y = {}

				for W, W in ipairs(w.Requirements or {}) do
					table.insert(Y, D(W))
				end

				local D = (tonumber(w.SecondsUntilRotation) or 0) - (os.clock() - K)
				local W = string.format("%s  -  needs %s  -  pity %s/%s  -  free rerolls %s  -  rotates in %d:%02d", tostring(w.BannerDisplayName or w.BannerId or "Lab"), #Y > 0 and (table.concat(Y, ", ")) or "unknown", tostring(w.PityCount or 0), tostring(w.PityThreshold or 0), tostring(w.FreeRefreshesRemaining or 0), math.floor(((if D < 0 then 0 else D)) / 60), math.floor(((if D < 0 then 0 else D)) % 60))
				return (if j ~= "" then W .. "  -  " .. j else W)
			end

			local D = nil

			D = function(w)
				local Y = Q(true)
				if type(Y) ~= "table" or Y.Unlocked ~= true then
					return
				end

				if Y.PendingReward ~= nil and Y.PendingReward ~= false then
					local W, R = v("RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskFinishReveal")
					j, x = W and R ~= false and "Reward claimed" or "Reward claim failed", 0
					return
				end

				if not tbl4.Lab.BannerOk(Y.BannerId) then
					tbl4.Lab.Reserved = {}
					j = "Waiting for " .. tbl4.Lab.PickedText()
					return
				end

				local W = H()
				if not W then
					return
				end
				local H, R, V, z = C(Y, W)
				W = tbl4.Toggle(r, false)
				tbl4.Lab.Reserved = W and V or {}
				V = false

				if W and w == m then
					local C, i = pcall(P, Y, z or {})
					V = C and i == true
				end

				if not H then
					j = R or "Recipe not ready"

					if w == m and (tbl4.Toggle(l, false)) and (tonumber(Y.FreeRefreshesRemaining) or 0) > 0 then
						local C, Y, P = v("RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskRefresh")
						j, x = (if C and Y ~= false then "Recipe rerolled" else tostring(P or "Reroll rejected")), 0
					end

					return
				end

				if not tbl4.Toggle(r, false) then
					j = "Ready to trade in"
					return
				end

				if w ~= m then
					return
				end

				if V then
					z = S()
					if z and (e(z.Main:FindFirstChild("Sacrifice", true))) then
						j, x = "Trade-in sent", 0
						return
					end
				end

				w, V, W = v("RF/ScrambleTradeIn/AskTradeIn", H)
				j, x = (if w and V ~= false then "Trade-in sent" else tostring(W or "Trade rejected")), 0
			end

			tbl4.LabStatusText = p
			t = tbl.LabSection:CreateText({ Name = "Lab Status", Text = "Loading Lab data..." })

			do
				local v, H = {}, {}

				for C, C in ipairs(tbl4.Lab.BannerList()) do
					table.insert(v, C.Name)
					H[C.Name] = C.Id
				end

				fn6(tbl.LabSection:CreateMultiDropdown({
					Name = "Lab Banners",
					Note = "Only trade and steal for these banners (empty = all)",
					Options = v,
					Default = {},
					Callback = function(v)
						local C = {}

						if type(v) == "table" then
							for S, e in pairs(v) do
								local v = e == true and type(S) == "string" and S or type(e) == "string" and e or nil

								if v and H[v] then
									C[H[v]] = true
								end
							end
						end

						tbl4.Lab.Banners = C
						j, u, x = "", 0, 0
						tbl4.Rift.Next = 0

						if type(tbl4.Lab.ForceSteal) == "function" then
							pcall(tbl4.Lab.ForceSteal)
						end

						tbl3.Wake()
					end,
				}))
			end

			r = tbl.LabSection:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Auto Lab Trade-In",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function()
					if not tbl4.Toggle(r, false) then
						tbl4.Lab.Reserved = {}
					end

					m += 1
					j, u, x = "", 0, 0
					tbl3.Wake()
				end,
			})

			l = tbl.LabSection:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Auto Reroll Lab Recipe",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function()
					m += 1
					j, u, x = "", 0, 0
					tbl3.Wake()
				end,
			})

			tbl4.Lab.PlaceHandle = tbl.LabSection:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Auto Place Lab Reward Eggs",
				Note = "Places the reward eggs from Lab trades",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function(j)
					tbl4.Lab.PlaceOn = ((if type(j) ~= "boolean" then (tbl4.Toggle(tbl4.Lab.PlaceHandle, false)) else j)) == true

					if type(tbl4.PlaceEggRefresh) == "function" then
						pcall(tbl4.PlaceEggRefresh)
					end

					tbl3.Wake()
				end,
			})

			tbl3.Add(function()
				local j, v = tbl4.Toggle(r, false), tbl4.Toggle(l, false)
				local r = (j or v) and 1 or 30

				if not F and (O == nil or x == 0 or os.clock() - K >= r) then
					F = true

					task.spawn(function()
						pcall(Q, true)
						F = false
					end)
				end

				if t and type(t.Set) == "function" then
					pcall(t.Set, t, p())
				end

				if n or not (j or v) or os.clock() < u then
					return false
				end
				n = true
				u = os.clock() + 1
				local t = m

				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(D, t)
					n = false
					tbl3.Wake()
				end)

				return false
			end)
		end
	__chilliStage("starting Lab trading")
	__startCurrentFeature()
	__chilliStage("finished Lab trading")
end
do
	local __startCurrentFeature = function(t)
			local r, l = pcall(function()
				return require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.ScrambleBossHazards)
			end)

			local n = {
				Handle = nil,
				Row = nil,
				Status = "Idle",
				Shown = nil,
				Busy = false,
				Generation = 0,
				Hazards = {},
				TravelSpeed = 250,
				Radius = 18,
				SwingGap = 0.12,
				Dodge = false,
				TryBall = true,
				Leave = true,
				HopWindow = 3,
				OpenSeconds = 900,
				ChainPath = "ChilliLibrary/SAE_BossHop.json",
