				ChainCycle = nil,
				ArmedCycle = nil,
				HopStamp = 0,
				ArrivedByHop = false,
				HopDelay = 5,
				HopConfirmed = false,
				HopNote = nil,
				HopAt = nil,
				Hopping = false,
				LoadedAt = os.clock(),
				BaitSpeed = 225,
				Interval = 1800,
				Run = nil,
				SwapTools = true,
				SwapIndex = 1,
				SwapSince = 0,
				MainHold = 0.3,
				SecondHold = 0.4,
				LastSwing = 0,
				Links = {},
			}

			tbl4.Mech = n

			local function m()
				return tbl4.Toggle(n.Handle, false) == true
			end

			local function u()
				return workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleArena")
			end

			local function x()
				return workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleArenaPortal")
			end

			local function O()
				return tbl4.InMechArena()
			end

			n.LeaveBelt = function()
				local function K()
					return tbl4.Treadmill.Riding == true or type(tbl4.OnBelt) == "function" and (tbl4.OnBelt())
				end

				for j = 1, 3, 1 do
					if not K() then
						return true
					end
					pcall(tbl4.ExitBelt)
				end

				return not K()
			end

			n.PrepareLeave = function()
				if n.Preparing then
					return
				end
				n.Preparing = true

				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(n.LeaveBelt)
					n.Preparing = false
				end)
			end

			n.LeaveFailed = function()
				n.LeaveFails = (n.LeaveFails or 0) + 1
				n.LeaveBlockedUntil = os.clock() + (n.LeaveFails >= 2 and 900 or 30)
			end

			tbl4.MechLeaveBlocked = function()
				return O() and os.clock() < (n.LeaveBlockedUntil or 0)
			end

			n.StealFirst = function()
				if tbl4.MechLeaveBlocked() then
					return nil
				end
				local K = tbl4.Steal
				if tbl4.Toggle(v4, false) == true and K ~= nil and K.Carrying == true then
					return "Delivering the egg first"
				end

				if tbl4.Toggle(v4, false) == true and K ~= nil and K.BossOverride == true then
					return "An egg that goes before the boss showed up, stealing it first"
				end

				if tbl4.Priority.Above("Place", "Boss") and tbl4.Movement.PlaceWanted == true then
					return "Auto Place Egg goes first"
				end
				return nil
			end

			n.Defeated = function()
				local K = u()
				local j = K and (tostring(K:GetAttribute("Phase"))) or ""
				return j == "Defeated" or j == "Final" or j == "Ended" or j == "Won"
			end

			n.CycleDone = function()
				return n.DoneCycle ~= nil and n.DoneCycle == math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() / n.Interval)
			end

			tbl4.MechFirst = function()
				if not m() or n.Hopping or (n.CycleDone()) then
					return false
				end
				local K = tbl4.Steal
				if K ~= nil and (K.Carrying == true or K.BossOverride == true) then
					return false
				end

				if O() then
					return not n.Defeated()
				end
				return n.Busy == true or x() ~= nil
			end

			pcall(function()
				local K = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Flags.ScrambleBossFlags).ScheduleIntervalSeconds
				local j = type(K) == "table" and (tonumber(K.Value)) or nil

				if j and j > 0 then
					n.Interval = j
				end
			end)

			n.Clock = function(K)
				K = math.max(0, math.floor(K + 0.5))
				return string.format("%d:%02d", math.floor(K / 60), K % 60)
			end

			n.Timer = function()
				local K, j = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleArena")
				local F = j and (tonumber(j:GetAttribute("SpawnsAt"))) or 0

				if workspace:FindFirstChild("ScrambleArenaPortal") then
					if F > K then
						return "Mech portal is open  |  boss spawns in " .. n.Clock(F - K)
					end
					return "Mech portal is open now"
				end

				j = n.Interval
				return "Next Mech portal in " .. n.Clock(math.ceil(K / j) * j - K)
			end

			tbl4.MechTimerText = n.Timer

			local function K(j)
				if not j then
					return nil
				end
				local F = j:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true)
				if F and (F:IsA("BasePart")) then
					return F
				end

				for F, F in ipairs(j:GetDescendants()) do
					if F:IsA("TouchTransmitter") and F.Parent and (F.Parent:IsA("BasePart")) then
						return F.Parent
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			local function j(F)
				local v = tbl4.Root()
				if not v or not F or type(firetouchinterest) ~= "function" then
					return
				end

				pcall(function()
					firetouchinterest(v, F, 0)
					task.wait(0.05)
					firetouchinterest(v, F, 1)
				end)
			end

			local function F(v, H)
				if not n.Dodge or not r or type(l) ~= "table" or type(l.Contains) ~= "function" then
					return false
				end

				for r, D in pairs(n.Hazards) do
					local Q, p = tonumber(D.At) or 0, tonumber(D.Warn) or 0

					if H > Q + (tonumber(D.Duration) or 0.5) + 1.5 then
						n.Hazards[r] = nil
					elseif H >= Q - p - 0.1 then
						local r, Q = pcall(l.Contains, D, v, H)
						if r and Q then
							return true
						end
					end
				end

				return false
			end

			local r = nil

			r = function()
				local l, v = ipairs, { localPlayer.Character, (localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")) }

				for H, H in l(v) do
					if H then
						for l, v in ipairs(H:GetChildren()) do
							if v:IsA("Tool") and tostring(v:GetAttribute("ItemType")) == "Gear" then
								l = string.lower(tostring(v:GetAttribute("GearName") or ""))
								if string.find(l, "scrambler", 1, true) then
									return v
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			local function l()
				if os.clock() - n.LastSwing < n.SwingGap then
					return
				end
				n.LastSwing = os.clock()
				local v = localPlayer.Character
				local H, D, Q = v and (v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")), type(tbl4.FindBat) == "function" and (tbl4.FindBat()) or nil, n.SwapTools and (r()) or nil
				local r = D

				if D and Q and D ~= Q then
					if (n.SwapIndex == 2 and n.SecondHold or n.MainHold) <= os.clock() - n.SwapSince then
						n.SwapIndex = n.SwapIndex == 2 and 1 or 2
						n.SwapSince = os.clock()
					end

					r = n.SwapIndex == 2 and Q or D
				else
					r = D or Q
				end

				if not r or not H then
					return
				end

				if r.Parent ~= v then
					pcall(function()
						H:EquipTool(r)
					end)
				end

				pcall(function()
					r:Activate()
				end)
			end

			local function r(v, H)
				local D, Q = localPlayer.Character, tbl4.Root()
				if not D or not Q then
					return
				end

				if (Q.Position - v).Magnitude > 3 then
					pcall(function()
						D:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(v, Vector3.new(H.X, v.Y, H.Z)))
						Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end
			end

			local function v(H)
				local D = H:FindFirstChild("Mech")
				local Q = D and (D:FindFirstChild("Hitbox"))
				if Q and (Q:IsA("BasePart")) then
					return Q.Position, D
				end

				for D, D in ipairs(H:GetChildren()) do
					if D:IsA("Model") and D.Name ~= "Ball" and D.Name ~= "LeaveTeleport" and D.Name ~= "Structure" then
						Q = D:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
						if Q and (Q:IsA("BasePart")) then
							return Q.Position, D
						end
					end
				end

				return nil, nil
			end

			local function H(D, Q)
				local p = D:FindFirstChild("Ball")
				if not p then
					return false
				end
				local C = p:GetBoundingBox().Position
				local S, e = (tonumber(D:GetAttribute("FloorY")) or C.Y) + 3, tonumber(D:GetAttribute("CoreStage")) or 0

				if D:GetAttribute("BallStunned") == true then
					n.Run = nil
					p = Vector3.new(Q.Position.X - C.X, 0, Q.Position.Z - C.Z)
					local w = p.Magnitude > 1 and p.Unit or (Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))
					r(Vector3.new(C.X, S, C.Z) + w * 10, C)
					l()
					n.Status = string.format("Smashing the core  |  stage %d / 3  |  core %s", e, tostring(D:GetAttribute("CoreHealth") or "?"))
					return true
				end

				local w, Y = tostring(D:GetAttribute("BallTarget")), D:GetAttribute("BallCoil")

				if not n.Run and w == tostring(localPlayer.UserId) and type(Y) == "string" and Y ~= "" then
					p = D:FindFirstChild("Coils")
					local P = p and (p:FindFirstChild(Y))
					local W = P and (P:GetAttribute("Home"))

					if typeof(W) == "Vector3" then
						n.Run = {
							Centre = Vector3.new(W.X, S, W.Z),
							Goal = Vector3.new(W.X, S, W.Z),
							Leg = 1,
							Until = os.clock() + 10,
							Coil = Y,
						}
					end
				end

				if n.Run then
					p = n.Run

					if os.clock() > p.Until or w ~= tostring(localPlayer.UserId) or Y ~= p.Coil then
						n.Run = nil

						pcall(function()
							Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
						end)

						return true
					end

					D = Vector3.new(p.Goal.X - Q.Position.X, 0, p.Goal.Z - Q.Position.Z)

					if D.Magnitude < 3 then
						p.Leg = 2

						pcall(function()
							Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
						end)

						n.Status = string.format("In the middle of %s, waiting for the ball  |  stage %d / 3", p.Coil, e)
						return true
					end

					local w = D.Unit * math.min(n.BaitSpeed, D.Magnitude / 0.05)

					pcall(function()
						Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(w.X, Q.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, w.Z)
					end)

					n.Status = string.format("Flying into %s  |  stage %d / 3", p.Coil, e)
					return true
				end

				D = Vector3.new(Q.Position.X - C.X, 0, Q.Position.Z - C.Z)

				if D.Magnitude > 18 or D.Magnitude < 6 then
					Y = D.Magnitude < 1 and (Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)) or D.Unit
					r(Vector3.new(C.X, S, C.Z) + Y * 12, C)
				end

				n.Status = string.format("Ball phase, waiting for it to lock on  |  stage %d / 3", e)
				return true
			end

			local function D(Q, p)
				local C = Q:FindFirstChild("ScrambleHuman")
				if not C then
					return false
				end
				local S = C:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or C.PrimaryPart or (C:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
				local e, w = S and S.Position or C:GetPivot().Position, S and S.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
				S = e + Vector3.new(w.X, 0, w.Z) * 0.15
				C = Vector3.new(p.Position.X - S.X, 0, p.Position.Z - S.Z)
				w = C.Magnitude > 1 and C.Unit * 5 or Vector3.zero
				local C, Y = Vector3.new(S.X, p.Position.Y, S.Z) + w, localPlayer.Character

				pcall(function()
					Y:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(C, Vector3.new(e.X, C.Y, e.Z)))
				end)

				l()
				n.Status = string.format("Chasing Dr Scramble  |  hits %s / %s", tostring(Q:GetAttribute("HumanHits") or 0), tostring(Q:GetAttribute("HumanNeeded") or 3))
				return true
			end

			local function Q()
				local p, C, S = u(), tbl4.Root(), localPlayer.Character
				local e = S and (S:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
				if not p or not C then
					return
				end
				local w, Y, P = tostring(p:GetAttribute("Phase")), tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Health")) or 0, tonumber(p:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")) or 0

				if tostring(p:GetAttribute("GrabVictim")) == tostring(localPlayer.UserId) and e then
					e.Jump = true
					l()
					n.Status = "Grabbed, breaking free"
					return
				end

				if w == "Ball" and n.TryBall and (H(p, C)) then
					return
				end

				if w == "Human" and (D(p, C)) then
					return
				end
				e, S = v(p)

				if not e then
					local v = (tonumber(p:GetAttribute("SpawnsAt")) or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
					n.Status = v > 0 and "In the arena  |  boss spawns in " .. n.Clock(v) or (string.format("Phase %s, waiting for the boss", w))
					return
				end

				local v, H, D, W = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), (tonumber(p:GetAttribute("FloorY")) or e.Y) + 3

				for R = 0, 15, 1 do
					p = R / 16 * 3.141592653589793 * 2
					R = Vector3.new(e.X + math.cos(p) * n.Radius, H, e.Z + math.sin(p) * n.Radius)
					local H = (R - C.Position).Magnitude
					H = (if F(R, v) or (F(R, v + 0.4)) then H + 10000 else H)

					if not D or H < D then
						D, W = H, R
					end
				end

				if W then
					r(W, e)
				end

				l()
				D = S and S:GetAttribute("Overheated") == true
				n.Status = string.format("Fighting %s  |  boss %d / %d%s", w, math.floor(Y + 0.5), math.floor(P + 0.5), D and "  |  OVERHEAT" or "")
			end

			local function r()
				local l = u()
				local F = K(l and (l:FindFirstChild("LeaveTeleport")))
				if not F then
					return
				end
				local l = localPlayer.Character

				pcall(function()
					l:PivotTo(CFrame.new(F.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
				end)

				task.wait(0.2)
				j(F)
			end

			tbl4.MechLeave = function()
				for l = 1, 2, 1 do
					if not O() then
						return true
					end
					pcall(r)
					l = 0

					while O() and l < 4 do
						l += task.wait(0.2)
					end
				end

				return not O()
			end

			local function l(F)
				local v = x()
				local H = K(v)
				if not v or not H then
					return false
				end
				local K = type(tbl4.StealHome) == "function" and (tbl4.StealHome()) or nil

				if K and (tbl4.InsideBase()) then
					local D, p = n.Respawned == true, K + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
					local C, S = D and (math.min(n.TravelSpeed, 300)) or n.TravelSpeed, os.clock()

					while os.clock() - S < 20 do
						if F ~= n.Generation or not m() or (O()) or (n.StealFirst()) then
							return false
						end
						local S = tbl4.Root()
						if not S then
							return false
						end
						local e = p - S.Position
						if e.Magnitude <= 4 then
							break
						end
						n.Status = D and "Respawned, going out through the safe zone" or "Leaving the base through the safe zone"
						local w = math.min(C * RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), e.Magnitude)

						pcall(function()
							S.CFrame = CFrame.new(S.Position + e.Unit * w) * S.CFrame.Rotation
							S.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						end)
					end

					if D then
						n.Status = "Respawned, resting in the safe zone"
						p = 0

						while p < 0.75 do
							local D = tbl4.Root()

							if D then
								pcall(function()
									D.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
								end)
							end

							p += RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end
					end
				end

				n.Respawned = false

				for D = 1, 5, 1 do
					if F ~= n.Generation or not m() or (O()) or (n.StealFirst()) then
						break
					end
					local D = tbl4.Root()
					if not D or not H.Parent then
						break
					end
					n.Status = "Teleporting to the Mech portal"

					pcall(function()
						D.CFrame = H.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
						D.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						D.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)

					j(H)
					v = os.clock() + 0.6

					while os.clock() < v and not O() do
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end

				if O() then
					return true
				end
				K, v = H.Position, os.clock()

				while os.clock() - v < 60 do
					if F ~= n.Generation or not m() or (O()) or (n.StealFirst()) then
						break
					end
					local v = tbl4.Root()
					if not v then
						return false
					end
					local D = Vector3.new(K.X - v.Position.X, 0, K.Z - v.Position.Z)

					if D.Magnitude <= 14 then
						pcall(function()
							v.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						end)

						j(H)
						task.wait(0.4)

						if not O() then
							pcall(function()
								local K = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/ScrambleBoss/EnterArena")

								if K then
									K:InvokeServer()
								end
							end)
						end

						break
					end

					local K = D.Unit * math.min(n.TravelSpeed, D.Magnitude / 0.05)
					n.Status = string.format("Going to the Mech portal, %d studs", math.floor(D.Magnitude + 0.5))

					pcall(function()
						v.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(K.X, v.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, K.Z)
					end)

					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end

				F = os.clock()

				while not O() and os.clock() - F < 5 do
					task.wait(0.1)
				end

				return O()
			end

			local function K(j)
				pcall(n.LeaveBelt)
				tbl4.HoldBelt()
				local F, v = pcall(l, j)
				tbl4.ReleaseBelt()
				return F and v or false
			end

			local function l()
				local j = tbl4.Movement
				local F = tbl4.Steal
				if F and (F.Wanted == true or F.Carrying == true) or tbl4.Toggle(v4, false) == true or j.PlaceWanted or j.ScrambleWanted or j.MutationWanted or j.FracturedWanted then
					return true
				end
				F = tbl4.Treadmill
				return F ~= nil and type(F.Wanted) == "function" and F.Wanted() == true
			end

			local j = nil

			j = function()
				n.Busy = true
				n.Generation = n.Generation + 1
				local F = n.Generation
				tbl4.Shield("mech", true)
				local v = {}

				local H = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
					if not O() then
						return
					end
					local D = localPlayer.Character
					if not D then
						return
					end

					for p, p in ipairs(D:GetDescendants()) do
						if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
							if v[p] == nil then
								v[p] = true
							end

							p.CanCollide = false
						end
					end
				end)

				pcall(function()
					if tbl4.Treadmill and tbl4.Treadmill.Riding or type(tbl4.OnBelt) == "function" and (tbl4.OnBelt()) then
						tbl4.ExitBelt()
					end
				end)

				if not O() and not n.StealFirst() then
					pcall(K, F)
				end

				while F == n.Generation and (m()) and (O()) and not n.StealFirst() do
					local K = u()
					local u = K and (tostring(K:GetAttribute("Phase"))) or ""

					if u == "Defeated" or u == "Final" or u == "Ended" or u == "Won" then
						K = u ~= "Final"
						n.Status = "Dr Scramble defeated, going back home"

						if not n.DefeatedAt and type(n.StartChain) == "function" then
							pcall(n.StartChain)
						end

						n.DefeatedAt = n.DefeatedAt or (os.clock())
						n.DoneCycle = math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() / n.Interval)

						if K and (l()) then
							if type(tbl4.RequestRespawn) == "function" then
								n.Status = "Dr Scramble defeated, respawning"
								n.RespawnAt = os.clock()
								break
							end

							pcall(r)
							task.wait(2)
						else
							task.wait(0.3)
						end
					else
						pcall(Q)
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end
				end

				if O() and (n.StealFirst()) then
					n.Status = tostring(n.StealFirst()) .. ", leaving the arena"
					pcall(r)
					F = 0

					while O() and F < 5 do
						F += task.wait(0.2)
					end

					if O() then
						n.LeaveFailed()
						n.Status = "Could not leave the arena, finishing the boss first"
					end
				end

				n.DefeatedAt = nil
				n.Run = nil
				H:Disconnect()

				for r in pairs(v) do
					if r.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							r.CanCollide = true
						end)
					end
				end

				tbl4.Shield("mech", false)
				tbl4.ReleaseMovement("mech")
				n.Busy = false

				if n.RespawnAt and os.clock() - n.RespawnAt < 1 then
					tbl4.InvisMech = false
					pcall(tbl4.RequestRespawn)
				end

				tbl3.Wake()
			end

			pcall(function()
				local r = networking:FindFirstChild("RE/ScrambleBoss/Hazard")

				if r and (r:IsA("RemoteEvent")) then
					table.insert(n.Links, r.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(r)
						if type(r) == "table" then
							n.Hazards[r.Id or #n.Hazards + 1] = r
						end
					end))
				end
			end)

			table.insert(n.Links, localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(r)
				n.Respawned = true

				if n.RespawnAt and os.clock() - n.RespawnAt < 15 then
					tbl4.MechFreshCharacter = r
					tbl4.MechSeenAt = os.clock()
					n.RespawnAt = os.clock() - 12
				end
			end))

			tbl4.MechRespawning = function()
				return n.RespawnAt ~= nil and os.clock() - n.RespawnAt < 12
			end

			tbl4.MechWants = function()
				if not m() then
					return false
				end

				if n.Busy or (O()) then
					return true
				end
				return x() ~= nil and not n.CycleDone() and n.StealFirst() == nil and not (type(tbl4.StealNightHold) == "function" and (tbl4.StealNightHold()))
			end

			do
				local r = { Still = 0, Level = 0, Pos = nil, ActedAt = 0 }
				n.Guard = r
				local l = { 10, 8 }

				local function u(K)
					r.Level = K
					r.ActedAt = os.clock()
					r.Still = 0
					tbl4.Treadmill.Riding = false
					n.Generation = n.Generation + 1

					if K == 1 then
						n.Status = "Stuck, leaving the treadmill"
						pcall(n.LeaveBelt)
						tbl4.ReleaseMovement("treadmill")
						tbl4.ReleaseMovement("mech")
					else
						n.Status = "Still stuck, respawning to get free"
						tbl4.InvisMech = false
						n.RespawnAt = os.clock()
						tbl4.ReleaseMovement("treadmill")
						tbl4.ReleaseMovement("mech")
						r.Level = 0
						pcall(tbl4.RequestRespawn)
					end

					tbl3.Wake()
				end

				task.spawn(function()
					while not n.Dead do
						local K, F, v, H = task.wait(0.5), tbl4.Root(), tbl4.Movement, tbl4.Steal

						if not (m() and F ~= nil and not O() and x() ~= nil and not n.CycleDone() and n.StealFirst() == nil and not (type(tbl4.StealNightHold) == "function" and (tbl4.StealNightHold())) and not (H and (H.Carrying == true or H.Active == true)) and (v.Owner == nil or v.Owner == "treadmill" or v.Owner == "mech") and not (n.RespawnAt ~= nil and os.clock() - n.RespawnAt < 6)) then
							r.Still = 0
							r.Pos = F and F.Position or nil

							if os.clock() - r.ActedAt > 90 then
								r.Level = 0
							end
						elseif r.Pos and (F.Position - r.Pos).Magnitude < 2 then
							r.Still = r.Still + K
							local K = l[r.Level + 1]

							if K and r.Still >= K then
								pcall(u, r.Level + 1)
							end
						else
							r.Still = 0
							r.Pos = F.Position
						end
					end
				end)
			end

			n.Row = t:CreateText({ Name = "Mech Status", Text = "Idle" })

			n.Handle = t:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Auto Mech Boss",
				Default = false,
				Callback = function()
					if not m() then
						n.Generation = n.Generation + 1
					end

					tbl3.Wake()
				end,
			})

			local r = {
				{ "Mech Tween Speed", 100, 1000, 250, 10, "studs/s", "TravelSpeed" },
				{ "Main Weapon Hold", 0, 1.5, 0.3, 0.01, "s", "MainHold" },
				{ "Scrambler Hold", 0, 1.5, 0.4, 0.01, "s", "SecondHold" },
			}

			for l, l in ipairs(r) do
				t:CreateSlider({
					Name = l[1],
					Min = l[2],
					Max = l[3],
					Default = l[4],
					Increment = l[5],
					Unit = l[6],
					SubOf = n.Handle,
					Callback = function(u)
						n[l[7]] = math.clamp(tonumber(u) or l[4], l[2], l[3])
					end,
				})
			end

			r = { { "Swap Two Weapons", "SwapTools" } }

			for l, l in ipairs(r) do
				t:CreateToggle({
					Name = l[1],
					Default = true,
					SubOf = n.Handle,
					Callback = function(r)
						n[l[2]] = r ~= false
					end,
				})
			end

			n.HopHandle = t:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Boss Server Hop",
				Note = "After each boss, hops to a less crowded server to fight again",
				Default = false,
				SubOf = n.Handle,
				Callback = function()
					n.HopAt = nil

					if not tbl4.Toggle(n.HopHandle, false) then
						n.HopConfirmed = false
						n.HopNote = nil
						pcall(tbl4.HopPrompt.Hide)
						return
					end

					n.ArmedCycle = math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() / n.Interval)
					if not tbl4.HopPrompt.Manual() then
						n.HopConfirmed = true
						return
					end
					n.ArrivedByHop = false
					n.HopConfirmed = false

					if not pcall(tbl4.HopPrompt.Show, {
						Title = "Boss Server Hop",
						Warn = "WARNING",
						Body = "After you beat a Mech boss, Boss Server Hop keeps joining less crowded servers. It fights the boss wherever one is still up and hops again when there is none. Turn it off to stop hopping.",
						Tip = "",
						Cancel = "Cancel",
						Accept = "Turn On",
					}, function()
						n.HopConfirmed = true
						tbl3.Wake()
					end, function()
						pcall(function()
							n.HopHandle:Set(false)
						end)
					end) then
						n.HopConfirmed = true
					end
				end,
			})

			n.PortalCloses = function()
				local r = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				return math.floor(r / n.Interval) * n.Interval + n.OpenSeconds
			end

			n.SaveChain = function()
				if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
					return
				end

				pcall(function()
					if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder("ChilliLibrary") then
						makefolder("ChilliLibrary")
					end

					writefile(n.ChainPath, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({ Until = n.ChainUntil, Cycle = n.ChainCycle, HopAt = n.HopStamp }))
				end)
			end

			n.StartChain = function()
				if not tbl4.Toggle(n.HopHandle, false) or not n.HopConfirmed then
					return
				end
				local r = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				local l = math.floor(r / n.Interval)
				if n.ChainUntil > r or n.ChainCycle == l and n.ArrivedByHop then
					return
				end
				n.ChainCycle = l
				n.ChainUntil = math.min(r + n.HopWindow * 60, n.PortalCloses())
				n.SaveChain()
			end

			pcall(function()
				if type(isfile) == "function" and (isfile(n.ChainPath)) then
					local r = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(n.ChainPath))

					if type(r) == "table" then
						n.ChainUntil = tonumber(r.Until) or 0
						n.ChainCycle = tonumber(r.Cycle)
						n.HopStamp = tonumber(r.HopAt) or 0
						n.ArrivedByHop = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - n.HopStamp < 120
					end
				end
			end)

			t:CreateSlider({
				Name = "Keep Hopping For",
				Note = "Keeps fighting every boss it finds and hopping for this long",
				Min = 1,
				Max = 15,
				Default = 3,
				Increment = 1,
				Unit = "min",
				SubOf = n.Handle,
				Callback = function(r)
					n.HopWindow = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(r) or 3), 1, 15)
				end,
			})

			do
				local r

				r = {
					Loop = 0,
					On = false,
					Run = function(l)
						local u, K = tbl4.ScrambleRead, tbl4.ScrambleRequest
						if type(u) ~= "function" or type(K) ~= "function" then
							return
						end
						local F = u(true)
						u = type(F) == "table" and F.State or nil
						if type(u) ~= "table" or F.Ready ~= true or F.Enabled ~= true then
							return
						end
						F = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Data")
						local v, H = pcall(require, F and (F:FindFirstChild("ScrambleMastery")))
						if not v or type(H) ~= "table" or type(H.Milestones) ~= "table" then
							return
						end
						local D, Q, p = type(u.ClaimedMilestoneIds) == "table" and u.ClaimedMilestoneIds or {}, tonumber(u.Mastery) or 0, {}

						for C, S in ipairs(H.Milestones) do
							F = type(S) == "table" and (tonumber(S.Kills)) or nil

							if F and S.Id and not D[S.Id] and Q >= F then
								C, v = pcall(H.Presentation, S.Reward)
								local e = C and type(v) == "table" and (v.Title or v.Name) or nil

								table.insert(p, {
									Id = S.Id,
									Text = (e and (tostring(e)) or "a reward") .. " at " .. F .. " kills",
								})
							end
						end

						Q, v = pcall(H.FinalMilestone)

						if Q and type(v) == "table" and D[v.Id] and H.InfiniteMilestoneId then
							local F, v = pcall(H.ClaimableInfiniteCount, u)

							if F and (tonumber(v) or 0) > 0 then
								table.insert(p, { Id = H.InfiniteMilestoneId, Text = "the repeat reward" })
							end
						end

						for u, u in ipairs(p) do
							if l ~= r.Loop or not r.On then
								return
							end
							H = K("Milestone", u.Id)

							if type(H) == "table" and H.Ok == true then
								tbl4.Notify("Boss Mastery", "Claimed " .. u.Text)
							end

							task.wait(1)
						end
					end,
				}

				t:CreateToggle({
					Name = "Auto Claim Mastery",
					Note = "Claims Boss Mastery rewards as soon as they unlock",
					Default = false,
					Callback = function(t)
						r.Loop = r.Loop + 1
						r.On = t == true
						if not r.On then
							return
						end
						local t = r.Loop

						task.spawn(function()
							while t == r.Loop and r.On do
								pcall(r.Run, t)
								task.wait(10)
							end
						end)
					end,
				})

				fn4(function()
					r.Loop = r.Loop + 1
					r.On = false
				end)
			end

			tbl3.Add(function()
				if not m() or not tbl4.Toggle(n.HopHandle, false) or not n.HopConfirmed then
					n.HopAt = nil
					n.HopNote = nil
					return false
				end

				if n.Hopping then
					return false
				end
				local t = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

				if n.ChainUntil > 0 and t >= n.ChainUntil then
					n.ChainUntil = 0
					n.SaveChain()
				end

				if n.ChainUntil <= t then
					local r = math.floor(t / n.Interval)
					local l = t - r * n.Interval

					if (n.ArmedCycle == r or n.ChainCycle ~= r) and l >= 20 and l < n.OpenSeconds and os.clock() - n.LoadedAt >= 8 and not n.Busy and not O() and not x() then
						pcall(n.StartChain)
					end

					if n.ArmedCycle ~= r then
						n.ArmedCycle = nil
					end
				end

				if n.ChainUntil <= t then
					local r = t - math.floor(t / n.Interval) * n.Interval
					n.HopAt = nil

					if r >= n.OpenSeconds then
						n.HopNote = "Boss hop waits for the next portal"
					elseif n.ArrivedByHop and n.ChainCycle == math.floor(t / n.Interval) then
						n.HopNote = "Boss hop is done for this portal"
					elseif n.Busy or (O()) or (x()) then
						n.HopNote = "Boss hop starts after this boss"
					else
						n.HopNote = "Looking for the boss here"
					end

					return false
				end

				local r = n.ChainUntil - t

				if n.Busy or (O()) or (x()) then
					n.HopAt = nil
					n.HopNote = "Boss hop on, " .. n.Clock(r) .. " left"
					return false
				end

				if os.clock() - n.LoadedAt < 8 then
					n.HopAt = nil
					n.HopNote = "Looking for the boss here"
					return false
				end

				local t = tbl4.Steal

				if tbl4.Toggle(v4, false) == true and t and (t.Wanted == true or t.Carrying == true or t.Active == true) then
					n.HopAt = nil
					n.HopNote = "A filtered egg is here, stealing before the hop"
					return false
				end

				n.HopAt = n.HopAt or os.clock() + n.HopDelay
				if os.clock() < n.HopAt then
					n.HopNote = string.format("No boss here, hopping in %ds  |  %s left", math.ceil(n.HopAt - os.clock()), n.Clock(r))
					return false
				end

				if type(tbl4.ServerHop) ~= "function" then
					n.HopNote = "Server hop is not ready"
					return false
				end
				n.Hopping = true
				n.HopNote = "Joining a less crowded server"
				n.HopStamp = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				n.SaveChain()

				task.spawn(function()
					local t, r = pcall(tbl4.ServerHop, "Least Players")
					r = t and (tostring(r)) or "error"
					n.Hopping = false

					if r == "waiting" then
						n.HopAt = os.clock() + 15
						n.HopNote = "Teleporting to the next server"
					elseif r == "fetch" then
						n.HopAt = os.clock() + 10
						n.HopNote = "Server list unavailable, trying again soon"
					else
						n.HopAt = os.clock() + 3
						n.HopNote = "Hop did not land, trying again"
					end
				end)

				return false
			end)

			tbl3.Add(function()
				local t = n.Row

				if not m() then
					n.Status = "Off  |  " .. n.Timer()
				elseif not n.Busy then
					if O() then
						n.Status = "In the arena"
					else
						n.Status = n.Timer()
					end

					if n.HopNote then
						n.Status = n.Status .. "  |  " .. n.HopNote
					end
				end

				if t and n.Shown ~= n.Status and type(t.Set) == "function" then
					n.Shown = n.Status
					pcall(t.Set, t, n.Status)
				end

				t = tbl4.InvisibilityHandle
				local r, l, u = t ~= nil and (tbl4.Toggle(t, false)), n.RespawnAt ~= nil and os.clock() - n.RespawnAt < 15, m() and (n.Busy or (O()))
				t = m() and not u and x() ~= nil and not n.CycleDone()
				local K = t and (type(tbl4.StealNightHold) == "function" and (tbl4.StealNightHold()) or n.StealFirst() ~= nil)

				if t and not K then
					n.WaitSince = n.WaitSince or (os.clock())
				else
					n.WaitSince = nil
				end

				if l then
					n.InvisResumeAt = nil
					tbl4.InvisMech = false
				elseif u or t and not K and os.clock() - n.WaitSince >= 3 then
					n.InvisResumeAt = nil

					if not tbl4.InvisMech then
						tbl4.InvisMech = true

						if r then
							n.PrepareLeave()
						end

						if r then
							tbl4.Notify("Invisibility", "Invisibility is paused for the Mech boss and comes back after it.")
						end
					end
				elseif t then
					n.InvisResumeAt = nil
				elseif tbl4.InvisMech and not n.Busy then
					n.InvisResumeAt = n.InvisResumeAt or os.clock() + 5

					if os.clock() >= n.InvisResumeAt then
						n.InvisResumeAt = nil
						tbl4.InvisMech = false

						if r then
							tbl4.Notify("Invisibility", "The Mech boss is over, Invisibility is back on.")
						end
					end
				end

				if not m() or n.Busy then
					return true
				end

				if n.CycleDone() and (O() or (x())) then
					if O() and n.RespawnAt and os.clock() - n.RespawnAt < 15 then
						n.Status = "Dr Scramble defeated, respawning"
					elseif O() then
						n.Status = "Boss defeated, leaving the arena"

						if not n.Leaving then
							n.Leaving = true

							task.spawn(function()
								pcall(tbl4.MechLeave)
								n.Leaving = false
							end)
						end
					else
						n.Status = "Boss defeated  |  " .. n.Timer()
					end

					return true
				end

				if not O() and (x()) and type(tbl4.StealNightHold) == "function" and (tbl4.StealNightHold()) then
					n.Status = "Night, deciding egg or boss after the field resets  |  " .. n.Timer()
					return true
				end

				if O() or (x()) then
					if not O() then
						n.LeaveFails = 0
						n.LeaveBlockedUntil = 0
					end

					l = n.StealFirst()

					if l then
						n.Status = l .. "  |  " .. n.Timer()

						if O() and not n.Leaving then
							n.Leaving = true

							task.spawn(function()
								local t, l = pcall(tbl4.MechLeave)

								if not (t and l) and (O()) then
									n.LeaveFailed()
								end

								n.Leaving = false
								tbl3.Wake()
							end)
						end

						return true
					end

					r = localPlayer.Character

					if r and r:GetAttribute("InvisApplied") == true then
						n.Status = "Leaving Invisibility for the boss"
						n.PrepareLeave()
						return true
					end

					if not tbl4.ClaimMovement("mech") then
						n.Status = "Waiting for " .. tostring(tbl4.Movement.Owner or "movement")
						return true
					end
					task.spawn(j)
					return true
				end

				return true
			end)

			fn4(function()
				n.Dead = true
				tbl4.InvisMech = false
				n.Generation = n.Generation + 1

				for t, t in ipairs(n.Links) do
					pcall(function()
						t:Disconnect()
					end)
				end

				pcall(tbl4.Shield, "mech", false)
				pcall(tbl4.ReleaseMovement, "mech")
			end)
		end
	__chilliStage("starting Mech boss")
	__startCurrentFeature(tbl.MechSection)
	__chilliStage("finished Mech boss")
end
do
	local __startCurrentFeature = function()
			local t = v2:CreateTab({ Name = "Auto Hop", SectionsExpanded = true })
			tbl4.AutoHopTab = t
			local r = t:CreateSection({ Name = "Egg Finder", Expanded = true })
			local l = { "Until An Egg Matches", "Steal Then Hop", "After A Rare Spawns" }

			local n = {
				Mode = l[2],
				Link = true,
				MinRarity = 0,
				Areas = {},
				Specific = {},
				MinIncome = 0,
				RareMin = tbl8.Cosmic or 7,
				RareLabel = tbl8.Cosmic and "Cosmic" or (tostring(tbl7[2])),
				HopDelay = 5,
				LoadedAt = os.clock(),
				Kind = "idle",
				Status = "Idle",
				HopStart = 0,
				HopEnd = 0,
				Survey = nil,
				Generation = 0,
				Window = 0,
				WindowMode = nil,
				Visited = {},
				Delivered = false,
				CarriedSince = nil,
				LastCarry = nil,
				Handle = nil,
				ModeHandle = nil,
				View = nil,
			}

			for m, m in ipairs(tbl.CurrentAreas) do
				n.Areas[m] = true
			end

			local function m()
				return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			end

			local function u(x)
				local O, K = false

				task.spawn(function()
					local j, F = pcall(x)

					if j then
						K = F
					end

					O = true
				end)

				if not O then
					return nil
				end
				return K
			end

			local function x()
				return u(function()
					return tbl4.IsNight() or (tbl4.WallSealed())
				end) == true
			end

			local O = nil

			O = function()
				return u(function()
					return tonumber(tbl.AreaEggCycle.NextNightTime(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
				end)
			end

			local function u()
				if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
					return
				end

				pcall(function()
					if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder("ChilliLibrary") then
						makefolder("ChilliLibrary")
					end

					local K = {}

					for j, F in pairs(n.Visited) do
						K[#K + 1] = { j, F }
					end

					writefile("ChilliLibrary/SAE_AutoHop.json", game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({ Window = n.Window, WindowMode = n.WindowMode, Visited = K }))
				end)
			end

			pcall(function()
				if type(readfile) ~= "function" then
					return
				end

				if type(isfile) == "function" and not isfile("ChilliLibrary/SAE_AutoHop.json") then
					return
				end
				local K = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile("ChilliLibrary/SAE_AutoHop.json"))
				if type(K) ~= "table" then
					return
				end
				n.Window = tonumber(K.Window) or 0
				n.WindowMode = type(K.WindowMode) == "string" and K.WindowMode or nil
				local j = m()

				for F, v in ipairs(type(K.Visited) == "table" and K.Visited or {}) do
					F = type(v) == "table" and (tonumber(v[2])) or nil

					if F and type(v[1]) == "string" and j - F < 1800 then
						n.Visited[v[1]] = F
					end
				end
			end)

			n.Visited[tostring(game.JobId)] = m()
			tbl4.HopAvoid = n.Visited

			local function K()
				if n.Window <= 0 then
					return 0
				end
				local j = m()

				if n.Window <= j then
					n.Window = 0
					n.WindowMode = nil
					u()
					return 0
				end

				if n.WindowMode ~= n.Mode then
					return 0
				end
				return n.Window - j
			end

			local function j()
				local F = O()
				if not F or F <= m() then
					return
				end

				if n.Window == F and n.WindowMode == n.Mode then
					return
				end
				n.Window = F
				n.WindowMode = n.Mode
				u()
			end

			local function F()
				if n.Window ~= 0 then
					n.Window = 0
					n.WindowMode = nil
					u()
				end
			end

			local function v(H)
				local D = tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory
				local Q = type(D) == "table" and D[tostring(H)] or nil
				if type(Q) ~= "table" then
					return 0, 0, tostring(H)
				end
				D = type(Q.Rarity) == "table" and Q.Rarity or nil
				return D and (tonumber(D.RarityNumber or D.Rank)) or 0, tonumber(Q.EarningRate) or 0, tostring(Q.DisplayName or H)
			end

			local function H(D)
				local Q = tbl.Mutations

				if type(Q) == "table" and type(Q.EarningsFor) == "function" then
					local p, C = pcall(Q.EarningsFor, type(D) == "table" and D or {})
					if p and type(C) == "number" then
						return C
					end
				end

				return 1
			end

			local function D(Q, p)
				local C = tonumber(Q.AssetScale) or 1
				return p * (C > 5 and (C / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113 or C ^ 1.85) * H(Q.Mutations)
			end

			local function H(Q, p, C, S, e)
				if type(Q) ~= "table" or Q.Uid == nil then
					return false
				end

				if p[tostring(Q.AreaId)] ~= true then
					return false
				end
				p = tostring(Q.AssetCategory)
				local w, Y = v(p)
				if w < C then
					return false
				end

				if next(S) ~= nil and S[p] ~= true then
					return false
				end

				if e > 0 and D(Q, Y) < e then
					return false
				end
				return true
			end

			local function Q(p)
				return H(p, n.Areas, n.MinRarity, n.Specific, n.MinIncome)
			end

			local function p(C)
				return H(C, tbl4.StealFilters.Areas, tbl4.StealFilters.MinRarity, tbl4.StealFilters.Specific, tbl4.StealFilters.MinValue)
			end

			local H = nil

			H = function(C)
				local S

				if not C then
					local e = tbl.EggState

					if type(e) == "table" and type(e.ReadFieldEggs) == "function" then
						task.spawn(function()
							local w, Y = pcall(e.ReadFieldEggs)
							local e = w and type(Y) == "table" and type(Y.Records) == "table" and next(Y.Records) ~= nil

							if e then
								S = Y.Records
							end
						end)
					end
				end

				if not S then
					C = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFieldEggSnapshot")

					if C and (C:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
						local e, w = pcall(C.InvokeServer, C)

						if e and type(w) == "table" and type(w.Records) == "table" then
							S = w.Records
						end
					end
				end

				return S
			end

			local function C(S)
				local e = tbl4.Steal

				local w, Y = e.Carrying == true and e.CarryUid ~= nil and (tostring(e.CarryUid)) or nil, {
					Free = 0,
					FreeSteal = 0,
					Carried = 0,
					Mine = false,
					Best = nil,
					Rare = false,
					Matched = {},
					Count = 0,
				}

				for P, W in pairs(S) do
					if type(W) == "table" and W.Uid ~= nil and W.State ~= "Claimed" then
						local S, R = tostring(W.Uid), tostring(W.AssetCategory)
						P, e = v(R)
						local V = W.State == "Slot" or W.State == "Dropped" or W.State == "Carried"

						if V and P >= n.RareMin then
							Y.Rare = true
						end

						if V and (Q(W)) then
							local Q = false

							pcall(function()
								Q = tbl4.SafeCarry.Unsafe({ Uid = W.Uid, Category = R }) ~= nil
							end)

							local P = false

							if S == w then
								Y.Mine = true
								P = true
							elseif not Q and tbl.CancelledSteals[W.Uid] ~= true then
								if W.State == "Carried" then
									Y.Carried = Y.Carried + 1
								else
									Y.Free = Y.Free + 1

									if p(W) then
										Y.FreeSteal = Y.FreeSteal + 1
									end
								end

								P = true
							end

							if P then
								Y.Matched[S] = true
								Y.Count = Y.Count + 1
								local Q, p = D(W, e), Y.Best

								if not p or S == w or p.State ~= "Mine" and Q > p.Value then
									Y.Best = {
										Uid = S,
										Category = R,
										Record = W,
										Value = Q,
										Area = tostring(W.AreaId),
										State = S == w and "Mine" or (tostring(W.State)),
									}
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return Y
			end

			local function D()
				local Q = tbl4.Steal
				return Q.Active == true or Q.Carrying == true
			end

			local function Q()
				return tbl4.Toggle(v4, false) == true
			end

			local function p()
				local S = false

				pcall(function()
					S = type(tbl4.MechFirst) == "function" and tbl4.MechFirst() == true or type(tbl4.InMechArena) == "function" and tbl4.InMechArena() == true
				end)

				return S
			end

			local function S(e)
				return n.Mode == l[e]
			end

			local function e(w, Y)
				n.Status = w
				n.Kind = Y or n.Kind

				if type(n.View) == "function" then
					n.View()
				end
			end

			local function w(Y)
				return Y == n.Generation and tbl4.Toggle(n.Handle, false) == true
			end

			local function Y(P)
				local W = tbl4.Steal

				if W.Carrying == true and W.CarryUid ~= nil then
					local R, V = tostring(W.CarryUid), n.LastCarry

					if not V or V.Uid ~= R then
						V = {
							Uid = R,
							Category = tostring(tbl4.SafeCarry.Category or ""),
							Matched = false,
						}

						n.LastCarry = V
					end

					if P.Matched[R] then
						V.Matched = true
					end

					if P.Best and P.Best.Uid == R then
						V.Category = P.Best.Category
					end

					V.At = os.clock()
				elseif n.LastCarry and os.clock() - (n.LastCarry.At or 0) > 15 then
					n.LastCarry = nil
				end
			end

			t = networking:FindFirstChild("RE/EggWorld/FieldEggRedeemVerdict")

			if t and (t:IsA("RemoteEvent")) then
				local P = t.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(W)
					local R, V = n.LastCarry, type(W) == "table" and (tostring(W.AssetCategory or "")) or ""

					if R and R.Matched and (V == "" or R.Category == "" or V == R.Category) then
						n.Delivered = true
					end

					n.LastCarry = nil
				end)

				fn4(function()
					pcall(function()
						P:Disconnect()
					end)
				end)
			end

			local function P(W)
				e("Checking the field one last time", "hop")
				local R = H(true)
				if not w(W) then
					return
				end

				if type(R) ~= "table" then
					e("Could not read the eggs, checking again", "retry")
					task.wait(1)
					return
				end

				local V = C(R)
				n.Survey = V
				if V.Free > 0 or V.Mine or V.Carried > 0 or (D()) then
					e("A filter egg showed up, hop cancelled", "found")
					return
				end

				if x() then
					return
				end
				n.Visited[tostring(game.JobId)] = m()
				u()
				e("Joining a less crowded server", "joining")
				R = "missing"

				if type(tbl4.ServerHop) == "function" then
					local u, V = pcall(tbl4.ServerHop, "Least Players")
					R = u and (tostring(V)) or "error"
				end

				if not w(W) then
					return
				end
				e((if R == "waiting" then "Teleport is slow, trying another server" else (if R == "empty" then "Every listed server is full, searching again" else (if R == "fetch" then "Server list unavailable, waiting a moment" else (if R == "denied" then "That server filled up on join, taking the next one" else "Hop did not land, trying again")))), "retry")
				task.wait(R == "fetch" and 5 or 1.5)
			end

			local function u(W)
				n.HopEnd = 0
				local R

				while w(W) do
					local V, z = 0.5, R

					if x() then
						n.HopEnd = 0
						n.Delivered = false
						F()

						if S(1) then
							e("Night, waiting for the egg reset", "night")
						else
							e("Night, today's hop run is over", "night")
						end

						task.wait(1)
						R = nil
						continue
					end

					local x = H(false)
					if not w(W) then
						return
					end

					if type(x) ~= "table" then
						n.HopEnd = 0
						e("Reading the eggs in this server", "scan")
						task.wait(1)
						R = nil
						continue
					end

					local F = C(x)
					n.Survey = F
					Y(F)

					if F.Rare and (S(3)) then
						j()
					end

					if n.Delivered and (S(2)) then
						j()
					end

					if F.Carried == 0 then
						n.CarriedSince = nil
					end

					local j, H
					local C, w = false, O()
					local O, Y = w and w - m() or math.huge, Q()

					if os.clock() - n.LoadedAt < 3 then
						j, H = "Scanning this server", "scan"
					elseif F.Mine or (D()) then
						j, H = "Auto Steal is taking an egg, hop waits", "steal"
					elseif Y and F.FreeSteal > 0 then
						x = F.Best
						w = x and (select(3, v(x.Category))) or "a filter egg"
						j, H = F.FreeSteal == 1 and "Filter egg here (" .. w .. "), stealing it first" or (string.format("%d filter eggs here, stealing them first", F.FreeSteal)), "found"
					elseif F.Free > 0 and (S(1) or not Y) then
						local m = F.Best
						j, H = "Found " .. (m and (select(3, v(m.Category))) or "a filter egg") .. ", staying here", "found"
					elseif F.Carried > 0 and (n.CarriedSince == nil or os.clock() - n.CarriedSince < 20) then
						n.CarriedSince = n.CarriedSince or (os.clock())
						j, H = "Someone carries a filter egg, waiting in case it drops", "steal"
					elseif p() then
						j, H = "Boss fight first, hop paused", "boss"
					elseif O < 12 then
						j, H = "Night is close, staying here", "night"
					elseif S(1) then
						C = true
					elseif S(2) then
						if K() > 0 then
							C = true
						elseif not Q() then
							j, H = "Turn on Auto Steal, hopping starts after it brings home a filter egg", "rare"
						else
							j, H = "Waiting for Auto Steal to bring home a filter egg", "rare"
						end
					elseif K() > 0 then
						C = true
					else
						j, H = "Waiting for a " .. n.RareLabel .. " egg to spawn here", "rare"
					end

					if j then
						n.HopEnd = 0
						e(j, H)
						R = nil
					elseif C then
						if not z then
							R = math.max(os.clock() + 1.5, n.LoadedAt + n.HopDelay)
							n.HopStart = os.clock()
							n.HopEnd = R
						else
							R = z
						end

						w = R - os.clock()

						if w > 0 then
							e(string.format("No filter egg here, hopping in %.1fs", w), "hop")
							V = (math.min(0.25, w))
						else
							n.HopEnd = 0
							P(W)
							V, R = 0, nil
						end
					else
						R = z
					end

					if V > 0 then
						task.wait(V)
					end
				end
			end

			local function m()
				n.Generation = n.Generation + 1
				local x = n.Generation
				e("Scanning this server", "scan")
				task.spawn(u, x)
			end

			local function u()
				if type(r.CreateCanvas) ~= "function" then
					local x = r:CreateText({ Name = "Finder Status", Text = "Idle" })

					function n.View()
						if x and type(x.Set) == "function" then
							pcall(x.Set, x, n.Status)
						end
					end

					return
				end

				local x, O, j, F, v, H = tbl.ChilliPresentation.Paint, tbl.ChilliPresentation.Bold, tbl.ChilliPresentation.Escape, {
					idle = { Title = "IDLE", Color = "#9AA3B5" },
					scan = { Title = "SCANNING", Color = "#7FD8FF" },
					found = { Title = "FILTER EGG HERE", Color = "#4DFF7A" },
					night = { Title = "NIGHT", Color = "#9C8CFF" },
					rare = { Title = "WAITING", Color = "#FF7AE0" },
					steal = { Title = "AUTO STEAL BUSY", Color = "#FFC24D" },
					hop = { Title = "HOPPING SOON", Color = "#FF9A3D" },
					joining = { Title = "JOINING SERVER", Color = "#FF9A3D" },
					retry = { Title = "RETRYING", Color = "#FF6B6B" },
					boss = { Title = "BOSS FIGHT", Color = "#FF5C8A" },
				}, {
					Slot = { Text = "ON NEST", Color = "#4DFF7A" },
					Dropped = { Text = "DROPPED", Color = "#FFC24D" },
					Carried = { Text = "BEING CARRIED", Color = "#FF8A5C" },
					Mine = { Text = "YOU CARRY", Color = "#7FD8FF" },
				}

				local D, Q, p, C, w, Y, P, W, R, V, z, i = {}, 0, 0, 0.06, -1, -1, -1, false, 0, true, 0
				local A, h, c = 0, false, false

				local function b(M)
					if not M or M.DiffWrapped then
						return M
					end
					local Z = M.Set
					M.DiffWrapped = true

					M.Set = function(o)
						if type(o) ~= "table" then
							return Z(o)
						end
						local a, X = M.Spec

						for f, I in pairs(o) do
							if a[f] ~= I then
								X = X or {}
								X[f] = I
							end
						end

						if X then
							Z(X)
						end

						return M
					end

					return M
				end

				local function M(Z)
					local o = tostring(p) .. "|" .. string.gsub(tostring(Z.Spec.Text or ""), "%d", "0")
					if Z.WidthKey == o then
						return Z.WidthUnits
					end
					local a = Z.Get()
					if not a or p <= 0 or a.Text ~= tostring(Z.Spec.Text or "") then
						return nil
					end
					local X, f = a.Size, a.TextWrapped
					a.TextWrapped = false
					a.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100000, math.max(1, X.Y.Offset))
					local I = a.TextBounds.X
					a.Size = X
					a.TextWrapped = f
					if I <= 0 then
						return nil
					end
					Z.WidthKey, Z.WidthUnits = o, I / p
					return Z.WidthUnits
				end

				local function Z()
					local o = n.Survey
					local a = o and o.Best or nil
					if not a or tbl4.Toggle(n.Handle, false) ~= true then
						i, A, R = nil, 0, 2
						return
					end
					local X = a.Record
					local f, I, U = tbl.ChilliPresentation.AssetInfo(X.AssetCategory), tonumber(X.AssetScale) or 1, type(X.Mutations) == "table" and X.Mutations or {}
					U = (if #U == 0 and type(X.BaseMutation) == "string" and X.BaseMutation ~= "" then { X.BaseMutation } else U)

					i = {
						Uid = a.Uid,
						Info = f,
						Scale = I,
						Mutations = U,
						Area = a.Area,
						State = v[a.State] and a.State or "Slot",
						Value = f.EarningRate * tbl.ChilliPresentation.ScaleFactor(I) * tbl.ChilliPresentation.MutationMultiplier(U),
					}

					A, R = o.Count, 2
				end

				local function o()
					if not D.Card then
						return
					end
					local a = tbl4.Toggle(n.Handle, false) == true
					local X = a and n.Kind or "idle"
					local f = F[X] or F.idle
					local I, U, N, q = Color3.fromHex(f.Color), a and n.Status or "Turn on Auto Hop to start hunting", false, 0

					if a and X == "hop" and n.HopEnd > n.HopStart then
						local T, s = n.HopEnd - n.HopStart, math.max(0, n.HopEnd - os.clock())
						q, N, U = (math.clamp(1 - s / T, 0, 1)), true, (string.format("No filter egg here, hopping in %.1fs", s))
					end

					if a and X ~= "night" and not S(1) then
						local S = K()
						U = (if S > 0 then U .. string.format("  |  hop run %s left", tbl.ChilliPresentation.FormatClock(S)) else U)
					end

					D.Accent.Set({ Background = f.Color })
					D.Title.Set({ Text = f.Title, Color = I })

					D.Server.Set({
						Text = x("#9AA3B5", "Players ") .. O(x("#FFFFFF", #Players:GetPlayers() .. "/" .. tostring(Players.MaxPlayers))),
					})

					D.Detail.Set({ Text = x("#E6ECF5", j(U)) })
					D.Bar.Set({ Visible = N, Alpha = q, FillColor = I })
					q = i
					f = q ~= nil

					if N ~= h or f ~= c then
						h, c, R = N, f, 2
					end

					D.Divider.Set({ Visible = f })
					D.Name.Set({ Visible = f })
					D.Chip.Set({ Visible = f })
					D.Info.Set({ Visible = f })
					if not f then
						D.Icon.Set({ Visible = false })
						return
					end
					f, I = q.Info, v[q.State] or v.Slot
					N, X, a = Color3.fromHex(I.Color), string.upper(tostring(f.Rarity)) == "SECRET", f.Icon
					a = (if a and (tonumber(a)) then "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(a) else a)
					local K, v = X and tbl.ChilliPresentation.SecretGradient or f.Gradient, X and tbl.ChilliPresentation.SecretRotation or typeof(f.Gradient) == "Instance" and (f.Gradient:IsA("UIGradient")) and f.Gradient.Rotation or 0
					D.Icon.Set({ Visible = a ~= nil, Image = a or "", StrokeColor = f.Color })

					D.Name.Set({
						Text = j(f.Name),
						Color = K ~= nil and (Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)) or f.Color,
						Gradient = K,
						GradientRotation = v,
					})

					D.Chip.Set({ StrokeColor = N })
					D.ChipText.Set({ Text = I.Text, Color = N })

					a, I = {
						O(x("#4DFF7A", "$" .. tbl.ChilliPresentation.FormatRate(q.Value))),
						O(x(X and "#D0D6E2" or f.Hex, j(string.upper(tostring(f.Rarity))))),
						x("#CDE7FF", j(q.Area)),
					}, tbl.ChilliPresentation.MutationText(q.Mutations)

					if I ~= "" then
						a[#a + 1] = I
					end

					if A > 1 then
						a[#a + 1] = x("#9FB8FF", A .. " matches")
					end

					D.Info.Set({ Text = table.concat(a, tbl.ChilliPresentation.Separator()) })
				end

				local function x()
					if not D.Card or Q <= 0 then
						return
					end
					W = false
					local O, K = math.max(1, Q - 0.7 - 0.5), M(D.Server)

					if K then
						D.ServerUnits = K + 0.1
					else
						W = true
					end

					K = math.min(D.ServerUnits or 4, O * 0.45)
					D.Title.Set({ X = 0.7, Y = 0.3, Width = math.max(1, O - K - 0.3), Height = 1.2 })
					D.Server.Set({ X = 0.7 + O - K, Y = 0.3, Width = math.max(0.5, K), Height = 1.2 })
					D.Detail.Set({ X = 0.7, Y = 1.5, Width = O, Height = 1 })
					K = 2.6

					if h then
						D.Bar.Set({ X = 0.7, Y = 2.5, Width = O, Height = 0.3 })
						K = 3.2
					end

					local j

					if c then
						local v = M(D.ChipText)

						if v then
							D.ChipUnits = v + 0.9
						else
							W = true
						end

						v = math.max(1, Q - 3.8 - 0.5)
						local S, i = math.min(D.ChipUnits or 4, v * 0.5), K + 0.3
						D.Divider.Set({ X = 0.7, Y = K, Width = O, Height = 0.06 })
						D.Icon.Set({ X = 0.7, Y = i, Width = 2.6, Height = 2.6 })
						D.Name.Set({ X = 3.8, Y = i, Width = math.max(1, v - S - 0.3), Height = 1.2 })
						D.Chip.Set({ X = 3.8 + v - S, Y = i + 0.125, Width = S, Height = 0.95 })
						D.ChipText.Set({ X = 0, Y = 0, Width = S, Height = 0.95 })
						D.Info.Set({ X = 3.8, Y = i + 1.2, Width = v, Height = 1 })
						j = K + 3.3
					else
						j = K
					end

					D.Card.Set({ X = 0, Y = 0, Width = Q, Height = j })
					D.Accent.Set({ X = 0, Y = 0, Width = 0.22, Height = j })

					if math.abs(j - P) > 0.01 then
						P = j
						H:SetContentLines(j)
					end
				end

						Parent = D.Chip,

		tbl6.Bold = function(arg)
			return "<b>" .. tostring(arg) .. "</b>"
		end

		tbl6.Escape = function(arg)
			return (string.gsub(tostring(arg), "[<>&]", { ["<"] = "&lt;", [">"] = "&gt;", ["&"] = "&amp;" }))
		end

		tbl6.Separator = function()
			return tbl6.Paint(tbl6.Color.Separator, "  " .. tbl6.Bullet .. "  ")
		end

		tbl6.FormatRate = function(arg)
			local n16 = tonumber(arg) or 0
			if n16 >= 1e12 then
				return string.format("%.2fT/s", n16 / 1e12)
			end

			if n16 >= 1e9 then
				return string.format("%.2fB/s", n16 / 1e9)
			end

			if n16 >= 1000000 then
				return string.format("%.2fM/s", n16 / 1000000)
			end

			if n16 >= 1000 then
				return string.format("%.1fK/s", n16 / 1000)
			end
			return string.format("%d/s", math.floor(n16))
		end

		tbl6.FormatWeight = function(arg)
			local n16 = tonumber(arg) or 0
			local str = n16 >= 1000 and string.format("%.0f", n16) or string.format("%.2f", n16)
			local v20, v21 = string.match(str, "^(%-?%d+)(%.%d+)$")
			v20 = v20 or str
			local v22

			while true do
				local v23
				v22, v23 = string.gsub(v20, "^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")

				if v23 ~= 0 then
					v20 = v22
				else
					break
				end
			end

			return v22 .. (v21 or "") .. " Kg"
		end

		tbl6.FormatClock = function(arg)
			local n16 = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(arg) or 0))
			return string.format("%02dh %02dm %02ds", math.floor(n16 / 3600), math.floor(n16 % 3600 / 60), n16 % 60)
		end

		tbl6.ScaleFactor = function(arg)
			if arg > 5 then
				return (arg / 5) ^ 1.2 * 19.637875755794113
			end
			return arg ^ 1.85
		end

		tbl6.MutationMultiplier = function(arg)
			arg = type(arg) == "table" and arg or {}
			local mutations = tbl.Mutations

			if type(mutations) == "table" and type(mutations.EarningsFor) == "function" then
				local ok, result = pcall(mutations.EarningsFor, arg)
				if ok and type(result) == "number" then
					return result
				end
			end

			return 1
		end

		tbl6.AssetInfo = function(arg)

			end
			local directory = tbl.Assets and tbl.Assets.Directory
			local flag8 = type(directory) == "table" and directory[category] or nil
			local v21

			if flag8 == nil and type(directory) == "table" then
				local v22 = string.gsub(string.lower(category), "[^%a%d]", "")

				for k, v23 in pairs(directory) do
					local v24

					if type(v23) == "table" then

						local v25 = tostring
						local displayName = v23.DisplayName or ""

						do

							table.move(values, 1, values.n, 3, tbl30)
						end

						local egg = type(v23.Egg) == "table" and v23.Egg or nil

						if egg ~= nil then
							tbl30[#tbl30 + 1] = tostring(egg.ModelName or "")
						end

						for _, v27 in ipairs(tbl30) do
							if v27 ~= "" and string.gsub(string.lower(v27), "[^%a%d]", "") == v22 then
								flag8 = v23
								break
							end
						end

						v24 = flag8
					else
						v24 = flag8
					end

					if v24 ~= nil then
						flag8 = v24
						break
					else

					end
				end

				v21 = flag8
			else
				v21 = flag8
			end

		local function isShown(arg)
			if typeof(arg) ~= "Instance" or not arg:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				return false
			end

			while arg do

					return false
				end

				if arg:IsA("LayerCollector") then
					return arg.Enabled
				end
				arg = arg.Parent
			end

			return false
		end

			return isShown(result) and result.AbsoluteSize.X > 0

	tbl18 = { Sort = tbl16[1], Spotlight = true }
	local id
	id = nil
	local n17
	n17 = 0.0909
	local v19
	v19 = nil
	local tbl19
	tbl19 = {}
	local tbl20
	tbl20 = {}
	local tbl21
	tbl21 = {}
	local tbl22
	tbl22 = {}
	local n18
	n18 = 0

	n19 = 0
	local n20
	n20 = 0.06
	local n21, n22, n23, flag8, n24, flag9, n25, flag10, v20, requestEggRefresh

	do
		local n26 = -1
		local n27 = -1
		n21 = -1

		flag8 = false
		n24 = 0
		flag9 = true
		n25 = 0
		flag10 = false
		v20 = nil

		requestEggRefresh = function()
			flag9 = true
		end

		local function fn24(arg)
			if not arg or arg.DiffWrapped then
				return arg
			end
			local set = arg.Set
			arg.DiffWrapped = true

			arg.Set = function(arg2)
				if type(arg2) ~= "table" then
					return set(arg2)
				end
				local spec = arg.Spec
				local tbl23 = nil

				for k, v21 in pairs(arg2) do
					if spec[k] ~= v21 then
						tbl23 = tbl23 or {}
						tbl23[k] = v21
					end
				end

				if tbl23 then
					set(tbl23)
				end

				return arg
			end

			return arg
		end

		local function fn25(arg, arg2)
			local v21 = string.gsub(tostring(arg.Spec.Text or ""), "%d", "0")
			return tostring(n19) .. "|" .. tostring(arg2) .. "|" .. v21
		end

		local function fn26(arg, arg2)
			local eggRecords = tbl.EggRecords
			if type(eggRecords) ~= "table" or type(eggRecords.GrowthSecondsRemaining) ~= "function" then
				return 0, 0
			end
			local n28 = 1

			if type(eggRecords.GrowthSpeedMultiplier) == "function" then
				local ok
				ok, n28 = pcall(eggRecords.GrowthSpeedMultiplier, arg)
				ok = ok and type(n28) == "number"
				local n29 = 1

				if not ok then
					n28 = n29
				end
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(eggRecords.GrowthSecondsRemaining, arg, arg2, n28)
			ok = ok and type(result) == "number"
			local n29 = 0

			if not ok then
				result = n29
			end

			local n30 = 0

			if type(eggRecords.GrowthDuration) == "function" then
				local ok2
				ok2, n30 = pcall(eggRecords.GrowthDuration, arg)
				ok2 = ok2 and type(n30) == "number"
				local n31 = 0

				if not ok2 then
					n30 = n31
				end
			end

			return result, n30
		end

		local function fn27(arg)
			local eggRecords = tbl.EggRecords

			if type(eggRecords) == "table" and type(eggRecords.WeightKg) == "function" then
				local ok, result = pcall(eggRecords.WeightKg, arg)
				if ok and type(result) == "number" then
					return result
				end
			end

			return 0
		end

		local function fn28()
			local eggState = tbl.EggState
			if type(eggState) ~= "table" or type(eggState.ReadOwnerEggs) ~= "function" then
				return nil
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(eggState.ReadOwnerEggs, localPlayer.UserId)
			if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end
			local serverTimeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			local tbl23 = {}

			for k, v21 in pairs(result) do
				if type(v21) == "table" then
					local v22 = tbl6.AssetInfo(v21.AssetCategory)
					local n28 = tonumber(v21.AssetScale) or 0
					local mutations = type(v21.Mutations) == "table" and v21.Mutations or {}

					local tbl24 = {
						Id = k,
						Info = v22,
						Scale = n28,
						Weight = fn27(v21),
						Mutations = mutations,
						Income = tbl6.Income(v22, n28, mutations),
						Status = "Inventory",
						Remaining = math.huge,
						Percent = 0,
					}

					if v21.Placement ~= nil then
						local ok2, result2 = pcall(eggState.IsReadyToHatch, k)

						if ok2 and result2 then
							tbl24.Status = "Ready"
							tbl24.Remaining = 0
							tbl24.Percent = 100
						else
							local v23, v24 = fn26(v21, serverTimeNow)
							tbl24.Status = "Growing"
							tbl24.Remaining = v23

							if v24 > 0 then
								tbl24.Percent = math.clamp(math.floor((1 - v23 / v24) * 100), 0, 100)
							end
						end
					end

					table.insert(tbl23, tbl24)
				end
			end

			return tbl23
		end

		local function fn29(arg)
			local sort = tbl18.Sort

			table.sort(arg, function(arg2, arg3)
				if sort == tbl16[2] and arg2.Info.RarityNumber ~= arg3.Info.RarityNumber then
					return arg2.Info.RarityNumber > arg3.Info.RarityNumber
				end

				if sort == tbl16[3] and arg2.Remaining ~= arg3.Remaining then
					return arg2.Remaining < arg3.Remaining
				end
				return arg2.Income > arg3.Income
			end)
		end

		local function fn30(arg)
			if arg.Status == "Ready" then
				return bold(paint(color3.Ready, "Ready to hatch"))
			end

			if arg.Status == "Growing" then
				return bold(paint(color3.Clock, tbl6.FormatClock(arg.Remaining))) .. tbl6.Separator() .. paint(color3.Growing, arg.Percent .. "%")
			end
			return paint(color3.Inventory, "In inventory")
		end

		local function fn31(arg)
			local tbl23 = {}
			local v21 = tbl6.MutationText(arg.Mutations)
			table.insert(tbl23, bold(paint(color3.Income, tbl6.FormatRate(arg.Income))))
			table.insert(tbl23, paint(color3.Scale, string.format("%.2fx", arg.Scale)))
			table.insert(tbl23, paint(color3.Weight, tbl6.FormatWeight(arg.Weight)))

			if v21 ~= "" then
				table.insert(tbl23, v21)
			end

			return table.concat(tbl23, tbl6.Separator())
		end

		local n28 = 5
		local n29 = n28 + 0.8

		local function fn32(arg)
			if string.upper(tostring(arg.Rarity)) == "SECRET" then
				return tbl6.SecretGradient
			end
			return arg.Gradient
		end

		local function fn33(arg)
			return fn32(arg) ~= nil and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or arg.Color
		end

		local function fn34(arg)
			if string.upper(tostring(arg.Rarity)) == "SECRET" then
				return tbl6.SecretRotation
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function fn35(arg)
			local v21 = arg and arg.Get()
			if not v21 or n19 <= 0 then
				return nil
			end

			if v21.Text ~= tostring(arg.Spec.Text or "") then
				return nil
			end
			return v21
		end

		local function fn36(arg)
			local v21 = fn25(arg, "w")
			if arg.WidthKey == v21 then
				return arg.WidthUnits
			end
			local v22 = fn35(arg)
			if not v22 then
				return nil
			end
			local size = v22.Size
			local textWrapped = v22.TextWrapped
			v22.TextWrapped = false
			v22.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100000, math.max(1, size.Y.Offset))
			local x = v22.TextBounds.X
			v22.Size = size
			v22.TextWrapped = textWrapped
			if x <= 0 then
				return nil
			end
			local widthUnits = x / n19
			arg.WidthKey = v21
			arg.WidthUnits = widthUnits
			return arg.WidthUnits
		end

		local function fn37(arg, arg2)
			local v21 = fn25(arg, math.floor(arg2 * 100 + 0.5))
			if arg.HeightKey == v21 then
				return arg.HeightUnits
			end
			local v22 = fn35(arg)
			if not v22 then
				return nil
			end
			local size = v22.Size
			v22.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, math.floor(arg2 * n19 + 0.5)), 100000)
			local y = v22.TextBounds.Y
			v22.Size = size
			if y <= 0 then
				return nil
			end
			local heightUnits = y / n19
			arg.HeightKey = v21
			arg.HeightUnits = heightUnits
			return arg.HeightUnits
		end

		local function fn38(arg)
			local rfEggWorldAskHatch = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskHatch")
			if not rfEggWorldAskHatch or not rfEggWorldAskHatch:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				return false
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(rfEggWorldAskHatch.InvokeServer, rfEggWorldAskHatch, arg)
			if not ok or result == false then
				return false
			end
			task.wait(0.35)
			local rfEggWorldAskFinishHatch = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskFinishHatch")

			if rfEggWorldAskFinishHatch and rfEggWorldAskFinishHatch:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
				pcall(rfEggWorldAskFinishHatch.InvokeServer, rfEggWorldAskFinishHatch, arg)
			end

			return true
		end

		tbl19.RunAction = function()
			local focus = tbl19.Focus
			if type(focus) ~= "table" or focus.Id == nil then
				return
			end
			local str = tostring(focus.Id)

			if focus.Status == "Inventory" then
				local eggState = tbl.EggState
				if type(eggState) == "table" and type(eggState.WearEggTool) == "function" and pcall(eggState.WearEggTool, str) then
					return
				end
				local rfEggWorldAskWearTool = networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskWearTool")

				if rfEggWorldAskWearTool and rfEggWorldAskWearTool:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
					pcall(rfEggWorldAskWearTool.InvokeServer, rfEggWorldAskWearTool, str)
				end

				return
			end

			if focus.Status == "Ready" then
				if not tbl19.Hatching then
					tbl19.Hatching = true
					pcall(fn38, str)
					tbl19.Hatching = false
				end

				return
			end

			if tbl19.Flying or type(tbl4.FlyTo) ~= "function" then
				return
			end
			local placedEggRenders = workspace:FindFirstChild("PlacedEggRenders")
			local v21 = nil

			if placedEggRenders then
				for _, child in ipairs(placedEggRenders:GetChildren()) do
					if string.find(child.Name, str, 1, true) or child:GetAttribute("Uid") == str then
						v21 = child
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if not v21 then
				return
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return v21:IsA("Model") and v21:GetPivot() or v21.CFrame
			end)

			if not ok then
				return
			end
			local movement = tbl4.Movement
			if movement.Owner ~= nil and movement.Owner ~= "treadmill" or movement.PlaceWanted or tbl4.Steal.Active or tbl4.Steal.Wanted or tbl4.Steal.Carrying then
				return
			end
			tbl19.Flying = true

			if tbl4.ClaimMovement("predictor") then
				if tbl4.Treadmill.Riding or tbl4.OnBelt() then
					pcall(tbl4.ExitBelt)
				end

				pcall(tbl4.FlyTo, result.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), function()
					return false
				end, "fly")

				tbl4.ReleaseMovement("predictor")
			end

			tbl19.Flying = false
		end

			v19 = arg

			local v21 = arg:Dock()

			tbl19.Icon = arg:Image({

			tbl19.Rarity = arg:Text({

			tbl19.Info = arg:Text({ Parent = v21, X = n29, Y = n30, Height = n28 - n30, Wrap = false, ZIndex = 9 })

			tbl19.Action = arg:Button({
				Parent = v21,
				X = 0,
				Y = 0,
				Width = 5,
				Height = n30 - 0.1,
				Text = "",
				Scale = 1,
				Background = "#000000",
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
				HoverTransparency = 0.3,
				PressTransparency = 0.15,
				Corner = 0.35,
				StrokeColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				StrokeThickness = n17,
				StrokeTransparency = 0.6,
				Visible = false,
				ZIndex = 10,
				Callback = function()
					if type(tbl19.RunAction) == "function" then
						task.spawn(tbl19.RunAction)
					end
				end,
			})

			arg:OnResize(function(arg2, arg3, arg4)
				if arg3 == n26 and arg4 == n27 then
					return
				end
				n26 = arg3
				n27 = arg4
				n18 = arg3 / math.max(arg4, 1)
				n19 = arg4
				n24 = 2
				n20 = 0.9 / math.max(arg:TextSize(), 1)
				tbl19.Rarity.Set({ StrokeThickness = n20 })

				for _, v22 in ipairs(tbl20) do
					v22.Rarity.Set({ StrokeThickness = n20 })
				end
			end)

			for _, v22 in ipairs({ "Icon", "Name", "Rarity", "Info", "Action" }) do
				fn24(tbl19[v22])
			end
		end

		local function fn40(arg)
			local v21 = tbl21[arg]

			if not v21 then
				v21 = v19:Text({ Name = "Line", X = 0, Y = 0, Width = 1, Height = 1, Wrap = true, Visible = false })
				tbl21[arg] = fn24(v21)
			end

			return v21
		end

			})

			tbl23.Detail = v19:Text({
				Parent = tbl23.Frame,
				X = n34 + n36,
				Y = n30,
				Width = math.max(1, n18 - n36 - n34 * 2),
				Height = 1,
				Wrap = true,
			})

			tbl23.Status = v19:Text({ Parent = tbl23.Frame, X = 0, Y = 0, Width = 1, Height = n30, Wrap = false, Align = "Right" })

			for _, v22 in ipairs({ "Frame", "Icon", "Name", "Rarity", "Detail", "Status" }) do
				fn24(tbl23[v22])
			end

			tbl20[arg] = tbl23
			return tbl23
		end

		local function fn42(arg)
			local tbl23 = { Ready = 0, Growing = 0, Inventory = 0 }
			local n39 = 0
			local v21 = nil

			for _, v22 in ipairs(arg) do
				local status = v22.Status
				tbl23[status] = tbl23[status] + 1
				n39 += v22.Income

				if not v21 or v22.Income > v21.Income then
					v21 = v22
				end
			end

			return bold(paint(color3.Text, tostring(#arg) .. " eggs")) .. tbl6.Separator() .. bold(paint(color3.Ready, tbl23.Ready .. " ready")) .. tbl6.Separator() .. bold(paint(color3.Growing, tbl23.Growing .. " growing")) .. tbl6.Separator() .. bold(paint(color3.Inventory, tbl23.Inventory .. " in bag")) .. tbl6.Separator() .. paint(color3.Text, "Total") .. " " .. bold(paint(color3.Income, tbl6.FormatRate(n39))), v21
		end

		local function fn43(arg, arg2)
			if arg2 == "" then
				return true
			end
			local str = " " .. arg.Status
			local v21 = string.lower(tostring(arg.Info.Name) .. " " .. tostring(arg.Info.Rarity) .. str)

			for _, mutation in ipairs(arg.Mutations) do
				v21 ..= " " .. string.lower(tostring(mutation))
			end

			return string.find(v21, arg2, 1, true) ~= nil
		end

		local function fn44(arg)
			local tbl23 = {}
			local v21 = bold(paint(color3.Income, tbl6.FormatRate(arg.Income)))
			local str = paint(color3.Scale, string.format("%.2fx", arg.Scale)) .. tbl6.Separator() .. paint(color3.Weight, tbl6.FormatWeight(arg.Weight))
			tbl23[1] = v21
			tbl23[2] = str

			do
				local values = table.pack(fn30(arg))
				table.move(values, 1, values.n, 3, tbl23)
			end

			local v22 = tbl6.MutationText(arg.Mutations)
			table.insert(tbl23, v22 ~= "" and v22 or paint(color3.Hint, "Tap an egg below to preview it"))
			return table.concat(tbl23, "\n")
		end

		local function fn45(arg)
			local flag11 = tbl18.Spotlight and arg ~= nil

			if v20 ~= flag11 then
				v20 = flag11
				v19:SetDock(flag11 and 5 or 0, { Gap = n38 })
			end

			tbl19.Icon.Set({ Visible = flag11 })
			tbl19.Name.Set({ Visible = flag11 })
			tbl19.Rarity.Set({ Visible = flag11 })
			tbl19.Info.Set({ Visible = flag11 })
			tbl19.Action.Set({ Visible = flag11 })
			tbl19.Focus = flag11 and arg or nil
			if not flag11 then
				return
			end
			local info = arg.Info

			tbl19.Action.Set({
				Text = arg.Status == "Inventory" and bold(paint(color3.Inventory, "Hold egg")) or arg.Status == "Ready" and bold(paint(color3.Ready, "Hatch egg")) or bold(paint(color3.Growing, "Fly to egg")),
			})

			tbl19.Icon.Set({ Visible = info.Icon ~= nil, Image = info.Icon or "", StrokeColor = info.Color })
			tbl19.Name.Set({ Text = tbl6.Escape(info.Name) })

			tbl19.Rarity.Set({
				Text = string.upper(tostring(info.Rarity)),
				Color = fn33(info),
				Gradient = fn32(info),
				GradientRotation = fn34(info),
			})

			tbl19.Info.Set({ Text = fn44(arg) })
		end

		local function fn46(arg, arg2)
			local info = arg2.Info
			arg.Id = arg2.Id
			arg.Frame.Set({ Visible = true, BackgroundTransparency = arg2.Id == id and 0.12 or 0.74 })
			arg.Icon.Set({ Visible = info.Icon ~= nil, Image = info.Icon or "", StrokeColor = info.Color })
			arg.Name.Set({ Text = tbl6.Escape(info.Name) })

			arg.Rarity.Set({
				Text = string.upper(tostring(info.Rarity)),
				Color = fn33(info),
				Gradient = fn32(info),
				GradientRotation = fn34(info),
			})

			arg.Detail.Set({ Text = fn31(arg2) })
			arg.Status.Set({ Text = fn30(arg2) })
		end

		local function fn47()
			if n18 <= 0 then
				return
			end
			flag8 = false
			local n39 = math.max(1, n18 - n29)
			local v21 = fn36(tbl19.Action)

			if v21 then
				tbl19.ActionUnits = v21 + 1.4
			else
				flag8 = true
			end

			local n40 = math.min(tbl19.ActionUnits or 5, n39 * 0.45)
			local n41 = math.max(1, n39 - n40 - n37)
			tbl19.Action.Set({ X = n18 - n40, Y = 0.05, Width = n40, Height = n30 - 0.1 })
			local v22 = fn36(tbl19.Rarity)

			if v22 then
				n23 = v22 + 0.1
			else
				flag8 = true
			end

			local v23 = fn36(tbl19.Name)

			if v23 then
				n22 = math.min(v23 + 0.1, math.max(1, n41 - n23 - n37))
			else
				flag8 = true
			end

			tbl19.Name.Set({ X = n29, Y = 0, Width = n22, Height = n30 })

			tbl19.Rarity.Set({
				X = n29 + n22 + n37,
				Y = 0,
				Width = math.max(0.5, math.min(n23, n41 - n22 - n37)),
				Height = n30,
			})

			tbl19.Info.Set({ X = n29, Y = n30, Width = n39, Height = math.max(1, n28 - n30) })
			local n42 = math.max(1, n18 - n36 - n34 * 2)
			local n43 = 0

			for _, v24 in ipairs(tbl22) do
				if v24.Kind == "text" then
					local handle = v24.Handle
					local v25 = fn37(handle, n18)

					if v25 then
						v24.Height = v25
					else
						flag8 = true
					end

					local n44 = math.max(1, v24.Height or 1)
					handle.Set({ X = 0, Y = n43 + (v24.Gap and 0.5 or 0), Width = n18, Height = n44 })
