				if type(V) ~= "table" or type(V.Placement) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end

				if V.Placement.ReadyAt ~= nil then
					return "Ready"
				end
				local z, i = false

				task.spawn(function()
					z, i = pcall(function()
						local A = tbl.EggRecords
						local h = tbl.EggState
						local c = h and h.ReadOwnedEgg and (h.ReadOwnedEgg(localPlayer.UserId, R)) or nil
						local R, h, b = type(c) == "table" and c.Placement and c or V, type(c) == "table" and (tonumber(c.GrowthSpeedMultiplier)) or 1, workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
						c = A.CurrentNightCredit(R, b, h, localPlayer)
						return A.WallSecondsRemaining(R, b, h, c)
					end)
				end)

				if not z or type(i) ~= "number" then
					return nil
				end

				if i <= 0 then
					return "Ready"
				end
				i = math.floor(i)
				if i >= 3600 then
					return string.format("%dh %02dm", i // 3600, i % 3600 // 60)
				end
				return string.format("%dm %02ds", i // 60, i % 60)
			end

			local function R(V)
				local z, i = pcall(function()
					return tbl.EggRecords.EggIcon(V)
				end)

				if z and type(i) == "string" and i ~= "" then
					return i
				end
				z = Q(V and V.AssetCategory)
				return z and type(z.Egg) == "table" and z.Egg.Icon or z and z.Icon or ""
			end

			local V, z = false
			local i, A = { At = 0, TopPets = {}, TopEggs = {}, Key = "", ScrambleAsked = -100 }, { Pets = {}, Eggs = {}, ResetAt = 0 }

			local function h(c, b, M, Z, o, a, X)
				local f, I = type(a) == "table" and #a or 0, c[b]
				if I and I.Record == M and I.Category == Z and I.Scale == o and I.Mutations == a and I.MutationCount == f then
					return I
				end
				local U = Q(Z)
				local N, N = p(U)

				I = {
					Uid = b,
					Record = M,
					Entry = U,
					Rank = N,
					Category = Z,
					Scale = o,
					Mutations = a,
					MutationCount = f,
					Size = tonumber(o) or X,
					Rate = W(Z, o, a),
				}

				c[b] = I
				return I
			end

			local function W(c, b)
				if c.Rate ~= b.Rate then
					return c.Rate > b.Rate
				end
				return c.Uid < b.Uid
			end

			local function c(b, M)
				if b.Rank ~= M.Rank then
					return b.Rank > M.Rank
				end

				if b.Size ~= M.Size then
					return b.Size > M.Size
				end
				return b.Uid < M.Uid
			end

			local function b(M, Z, o)
				local a = #M
				if a >= 6 and not o(Z, M[a]) then
					return
				end
				local X = a + 1

				while X > 1 and (o(Z, M[X - 1])) do
					X -= 1
				end

				table.insert(M, X, Z)

				if #M > 6 then
					M[#M] = nil
				end
			end

			local function M()
				if os.clock() - i.At < 3 then
					return i
				end
				i.At = os.clock()
				local Z = H()
				if not Z then
					return i
				end

				if os.clock() >= A.ResetAt then
					A.ResetAt = os.clock() + 300
					table.clear(A.Pets)
					table.clear(A.Eggs)
				end

				local H = 0

				for o in pairs(type(Z.EquippedAssets) == "table" and Z.EquippedAssets or {}) do
					H += 1
				end

				local o, a = {}, 0

				for X, f in pairs(type(Z.Inventory) == "table" and Z.Inventory or {}) do
					if type(f) == "table" then
						a += 1
						b(o, h(A.Pets, X, f, f.Category, f.Scale, f.Mutations, 1), W)
					end
				end

				local W, X, f = {}, 0, 0

				for I, U in pairs(type(Z.EggInventory) == "table" and Z.EggInventory or {}) do
					if type(U) == "table" then
						X += 1
						f = (if U.Placement then f + 1 else f)
						b(W, h(A.Eggs, I, U, U.AssetCategory, U.AssetScale, U.Mutations, 0), c)
					end
				end

				i.Pets = a
				i.PlacedPets = H
				i.Eggs = X
				i.Growing = f
				i.TopPets = o
				i.TopEggs = W
				i.Mastery = type(Z.BossMastery) == "table" and (tonumber(Z.BossMastery.Mastery)) or 0
				i.Treadmill = nil

				pcall(function()
					local H, W = require(ReplicatedStorage.Data.Treadmills), tonumber(Z.TreadmillUpgradeLevel) or 0
					local A = H.GetByUpgradeLevel(W)
					if type(A) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					local h, c = pcall(H.GetByUpgradeLevel, W + 1)

					local function H(W)
						return (string.gsub(tostring(W.DisplayName or W._id or "Treadmill"), "%s*Treadmill$", ""))
					end

					i.Treadmill = {
						Name = H(A),
						Multiplier = tonumber(A.SpeedMultiplier) or 1,
						Icon = A.Icon and (tostring(A.Icon)) or nil,
						Note = (if h and type(c) == "table" then "next " .. H(c) .. " $" .. F(tonumber(c.Price) or 0) else "max treadmill"),
					}
				end)

				i.MasteryReady = 0
				i.MasteryNext = nil

				pcall(function()
					local H = tbl4.ScrambleSnapshot
					local W = type(H) == "function" and (H()) or nil

					if type(tbl4.ScrambleRead) == "function" and (type(W) ~= "table" or os.clock() - i.ScrambleAsked > 30) then
						i.ScrambleAsked = os.clock()
						task.spawn(pcall, tbl4.ScrambleRead, true)
					end

					H = type(W) == "table" and W.State or nil
					if type(H) ~= "table" then
						return
					end
					local A, h, c, b, o = require(ReplicatedStorage.Data.ScrambleMastery), tonumber(H.Mastery) or 0, type(H.ClaimedMilestoneIds) == "table" and H.ClaimedMilestoneIds or {}, 0

					for a, a in ipairs(A.Milestones) do
						W = tonumber(a.Kills) or math.huge

						if W <= h then
							b = (if not c[a.Id] then b + 1 else b)
						else
							o = (if not o or W < o then W else o)
						end
					end

					W = A.FinalMilestone()

					if W and c[W.Id] then
						b, o = b + math.max(0, tonumber(A.ClaimableInfiniteCount(H)) or 0), o or (tonumber(W.Kills) or 0) + ((tonumber(H.InfiniteRewardsClaimed) or 0) + 1) * (tonumber(A.InfiniteEveryKills) or 10)
					end

					i.Mastery = h
					i.Samples = tonumber(H.Samples)
					i.MasteryReady = b
					i.MasteryNext = o
				end)

				i.Tokens = tonumber(Z.BossTokens) or 0
				i.Fights = type(Z.ScrambleFinalHits) == "table" and Z.ScrambleFinalHits or {}
				i.Rift = type(Z.Rift) == "table" and Z.Rift or {}
				return i
			end

						H.Frame = i
						H.Label = A
					end
				end

					return tonumber(A.Text) or 0
				end
				return 0
			end

					return string.format("%dh ago", math.floor(A / 3600))
				end

				return string.format("%dd ago", math.floor(A / 86400))
			end

			end

							mm:Destroy()
						end)
					end

					table.clear(E.Gradients)
					table.insert(E.Gradients, f(E.Stroke, nm, 45))
					table.insert(E.Gradients, f(E.Glow, nm, nil))
					table.insert(E.Gradients, f(E.Rarity, nm, nil))

					E.Mutation.Text = C(y.Record)
					E.Name.Text = tostring(rm and rm.DisplayName or dm)
					E.Rarity.Text = string.upper(lm)
				end

				G, dm, tm = J.Detail(y)
				s(E.ValueChip, G)
				s(E.SizeChip, dm)
				s(E.HatchChip, tm)
			end

			local function J(y)
				local G = math.max(0, os.time() - (tonumber(y) or (os.time())))

				if G < 60 then
					return G .. "s ago"
				elseif G < 3600 then
					return G // 60 .. "m ago"
				elseif G < 86400 then
					return G // 3600 .. "h ago"
				end

				return G // 86400 .. "d ago"
			end

			local function O()
				if not E then
					return
				end
				E.Frame.Visible = l["Steal History"] == true
				local g, _ = e.History, false

				for k, G in ipairs(C) do
					local dm = g[k]

					if dm and k <= P + 1 then
						G.Frame.Visible = true
						local g = tostring(dm.At) .. "|" .. tostring(dm.Category) .. "|" .. tostring(V)

						if G.Key ~= g then
							G.Key = g
							local g = Q(dm.Category)
							local Q, Q, Q = p(g)

							for p, p in ipairs(G.Gradients) do
								pcall(function()
									p:Destroy()
								end)
							end

							table.clear(G.Gradients)
							table.insert(G.Gradients, f(G.Stroke, Q, 45))
							table.insert(G.Gradients, f(G.Rarity, Q, nil))

							if V and g and g.Icon then
								G.Image.Image = tostring(g.Icon)
							else
								G.Image.Image = g and type(g.Egg) == "table" and (tostring(g.Egg.Icon or "")) or g and (tostring(g.Icon or "")) or ""
							end

							G.Name.Text = tostring(dm.Name or dm.Category)
							G.Rarity.Text = string.upper(tostring(dm.Rarity or ""))
							s(G.ValueChip, tonumber(dm.Value) and "$" .. F(dm.Value) .. "/s" or "")
							s(G.SizeChip, tonumber(dm.Scale) and (string.format("x%.2f", tonumber(dm.Scale))) or "")
						end

						G.When.Text = J(dm.At)
						_ = true
					else
						G.Frame.Visible = false
					end
				end

				if E.Empty then
					E.Empty.Visible = not _
				end
			end

			local function F()
				for Q, p in ipairs(M) do
					Q = l[p.Showcase.Id] == true
					p.Panel.Frame.Visible = Q

					if Q then
						local Q = p.Showcase.List() or {}

						for f, s in ipairs(p.Cards) do
							local g = Q[f]

							if g and f <= P then
								B(s, p.Showcase, g, f)
							else
								s.Frame.Visible = false
							end
						end
					end
				end

				O()
			end

							Q = (if l[f.Id] then true else Q)
						end

						p.Frame.Visible = Q
					end
				end

				F()
			end

			local function p()
				if not R then
					return
				end
				local X, f, s, g = H(), U(), N(), 0

				for H, H in ipairs(c) do
					g = (if H.Column == "Center" and H.Frame.Visible then (math.max(g, H.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X)) else g)
				end

				local H, U, N = math.floor(g / 2 + 26 * f), { Left = 0, Right = 0, Center = 0 }, 0

				for _, _ in ipairs(c) do
					if _.Id == "Signature" then
						N = _.Frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
						_.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, s)
					end
				end

				g = s + N + math.floor(46 * f)
				U.Left = g
				U.Right = g
				U.Center = g

				for _, k in ipairs(c) do
					if k.Id ~= "Signature" then
						_, N = K(k.Id, f, s, X.Y), k.Column
						local K = U[N] or g

						if _ then
							k.Frame.Position = _
						elseif N == "Left" then
							k.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -H, 0, K)
						elseif N == "Right" then
							k.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, H, 0, K)
						else
							k.Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, K)
						end

						if k.Frame.Visible then
							U[N] = K + k.Frame.AbsoluteSize.Y + math.floor(42 * f)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local K = 0

			local function H()
				if not R then
					return
				end
				K += 1
				local X = K
				q()

				task.defer(function()
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					if X ~= K or not R then
						return
					end
					p()
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					if X ~= K or not R then
						return
					end

					for K, K in ipairs(c) do
						T(K.Frame, K.Padded)
					end
				end)
			end

			local function p()

					pcall(function()

				R, Z, o = nil, nil, nil
				table.clear(z)
				table.clear(c)
				table.clear(b)
				table.clear(M)
				table.clear(C)
				E = nil
			end

			local function z()
				p()

				R = a("ScreenGui", {
					Archivable = false,

					for Q, f in ipairs(X.Items) do

					end
				end

				for v, Q in ipairs(A) do

				end

				local v = j("Steal History", "Left", { Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 160) }, 2.5)
				a("UIListLayout", { SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6) }, v.Body)
				E = v
				table.clear(C)

				for j = 1, 7, 1 do
					C[j] = y(v.Body, j)
				end

				v.Empty = I(v.Body, true, 16, {

				local x = 0
				local j = 0

				W[#W + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(v)
					if not D or not Z then
						return
					end
					local Q = math.clamp(v, 0.001, 1)
					x = x <= 0 and 1 / Q or x + (1 / Q - x) * (1 - math.exp(-Q * 8))
					Q = os.clock()
					if Q < j then
						return
					end
					j = Q + 0.25
					v = math.floor(x + 0.5)
					Z.Text = tostring(v)
					Z.TextColor3 = v >= 100 and n or (v >= 50 and m or u)
					local x = 0

					pcall(function()
						x = r.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
					end)

					x = math.floor(x + 0.5)
					o.Text = tostring(x)
					o.TextColor3 = x <= 90 and n or (x <= 180 and m or u)
				end)

				local r, m = 0, 0

				W[#W + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					if not D then
						return
					end
					local u = os.clock()
					if u < r then
						return
					end
					r = u + 0.5

					for r, x in pairs(b) do
						if l[r] then
							local r, j, v, Q, C = pcall(x.Item.Read)

							if r then
								j, v = tostring(j or "-"), tostring(v or "")

								if j ~= x.LastValue then
									x.LastValue = j
									x.Value.Text = j
								end

								if v ~= x.LastRate then
									x.LastRate = v
									x.Caption.Text = x.Title .. (v ~= "" and "   <font color=\"#" .. n:ToHex() .. "\">" .. v .. "</font>" or "")
								end

								if x.Badge then
									C = tostring(C or "")

									if C ~= x.LastBadge then
										x.LastBadge = C
										x.Badge.Text = C
									end
								end

								local r = Q or x.Item.Icon

								if r ~= x.LastImage then
									x.LastImage = r
									x.Icon.Image = r
								end
							end
						end
					end

					if u >= m or e.Changed then
						m = u + 1
						e.Changed = false
						pcall(F)
					end
				end)
			end

			local r, n, m, u = true, {}, {}

			local function x(j)
				if not j:IsA("LayerCollector") or j == tbl4.RenderBackdrop then
					return

				end)
			end

					end)
				end

						v.Enabled = Q
					end)
				end

				table.clear(n)

				if u then
					for n, v in pairs(u) do
						pcall(function()
							t:SetCoreGuiEnabled(n, v)
						end)
					end

					u = nil
				end
			end

			local function n()
				j()
				if not (r and D) then
					return
				end
				local v = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")

				if v then
					for Q, Q in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do

					end

					m[#m + 1] = v.ChildAdded:Connect(function(m)

							x(m)
						end
					end)
				end

				u = {}

				for m, x in ipairs(Enum.CoreGuiType:GetEnumItems()) do
					if x ~= Enum.CoreGuiType.All then
						m, v = pcall(function()
							return t:GetCoreGuiEnabled(x)
						end)

						if m then
							u[x] = v
						end
					end
				end

				pcall(function()
					t:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.All, false)
				end)
			end

			w = v14:CreateToggle({
				Name = "Farm HUD",
				Note = "Drag any panel to place it where you like",

					if type(r) == "table" then

								n[m] = true
							elseif type(u) == "string" then
								n[u] = true
							end
						end
					end

					if next(n) == nil then

							n[r] = true
						end

					return

				if l.Samples then
					return
				end

					end

					t:Set(r)

			v14:CreateSlider({

	__chilliStage("starting render and HUD")

	local flag2 = false

	v14:CreateSlider({
		Name = "FPS Cap",
		Min = 30,
		Max = 1000,
		Default = 240,
		AllowDecimals = false,
		Increment = 1,
		Unit = " FPS",
		Callback = function(arg)
			local n19 = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(arg) or 240), 30, 1000)
			if type(setfpscap) == "function" and pcall(setfpscap, n19) then
				flag2 = false
				return
			end

			if not flag2 then
				flag2 = true
				fn8("FPS Cap Unavailable", "This environment does not support setfpscap.")
			end
		end,
	})

	do
		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
		local n19 = 0.003
		local flag3 = false
		local n20 = 0
		local thread = nil
		local tbl17 = {}
		local tbl18 = {}
		local obj = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		local tbl19 = {}
		local connection = nil

		local function fn13(arg, arg2, arg3)
			local ok, result = pcall(arg)
			if not ok then
				return
			end
			tbl18[#tbl18 + 1] = { Setter = arg2, Value = result }
			pcall(arg2, arg3)
		end

		local function fn14(arg, arg2, arg3)
			local v15 = obj[arg]

			if not v15 then
				local tbl20 = {}
				obj[arg] = tbl20
				v15 = tbl20
			end

			if v15[arg2] == nil then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return arg[arg2]
				end)

				if not ok then
					return
				end
				v15[arg2] = { Value = result }
			end

			pcall(function()
				arg[arg2] = arg3
			end)
		end

		local function fn15(arg)
			if not flag3 or not arg.Parent then
				return
			end

			if arg:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
				fn14(arg, "Enabled", false)
				fn14(arg, "Rate", 0)
			elseif arg:IsA("Trail") or arg:IsA("Beam") then
				fn14(arg, "Enabled", false)
			elseif arg:IsA("PointLight") or arg:IsA("SpotLight") or arg:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
				fn14(arg, "Enabled", false)
				fn14(arg, "Brightness", 0)
			elseif arg:IsA("Fire") or arg:IsA("Smoke") or arg:IsA("Sparkles") then
				fn14(arg, "Enabled", false)
			elseif arg:IsA("Explosion") then
				fn14(arg, "Visible", false)
			elseif arg:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
				fn14(arg, "TextureId", "")
			elseif arg:IsA("Decal") or arg:IsA("Texture") then
				if not (arg.Name == "face" and arg.Parent and arg.Parent.Name == "Head") then
					fn14(arg, "Transparency", 1)
				end
			elseif arg:IsA("MeshPart") then
				fn14(arg, "RenderFidelity", Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance)
				fn14(arg, "TextureID", "")
				fn14(arg, "CastShadow", false)
				fn14(arg, "Reflectance", 0)
				fn14(arg, "Material", Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
			elseif arg:IsA("BasePart") then
				fn14(arg, "CastShadow", false)
				fn14(arg, "Reflectance", 0)
				fn14(arg, "Material", Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
			elseif arg:IsA("PostEffect") then
				fn14(arg, "Enabled", false)
			elseif arg:IsA("Clouds") then
				fn14(arg, "Cover", 0)
				fn14(arg, "Density", 0)
			elseif arg:IsA("Atmosphere") then
				fn14(arg, "Density", 0)
				fn14(arg, "Haze", 0)
				fn14(arg, "Glare", 0)
			end
		end

		local function fn16()
			for _, v15 in ipairs(tbl17) do
				if v15.Connected then
					v15:Disconnect()
				end
			end

			table.clear(tbl17)

			if connection then
				pcall(function()
					connection:Disconnect()
				end)

				connection = nil
			end
		end

		local function fn17()
			local rendering = settings().Rendering
			local terrain = workspace.Terrain

			local function fn18(arg, arg2, arg3)
				fn13(function()
					return arg[arg2]
				end, function(arg4)
					arg[arg2] = arg4
				end, arg3)
			end

			fn18(rendering, "QualityLevel", Enum.QualityLevel.Level01)
			fn18(rendering, "MeshPartDetailLevel", Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level01)
			fn18(rendering, "EditQualityLevel", Enum.QualityLevel.Level01)

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")
			end)

			if ok and result then
				fn18(result, "SavedQualityLevel", Enum.SavedQualitySetting.QualityLevel1)
			end

			fn18(Lighting, "GlobalShadows", false)
			fn18(Lighting, "ShadowSoftness", 0)
			fn18(Lighting, "FogEnd", 9e9)
			fn18(Lighting, "Technology", Enum.Technology.Legacy)
			fn18(Lighting, "EnvironmentDiffuseScale", 0)
			fn18(Lighting, "EnvironmentSpecularScale", 0)
			fn18(terrain, "Decoration", false)
			fn18(terrain, "WaterWaveSize", 0)
			fn18(terrain, "WaterWaveSpeed", 0)
			fn18(terrain, "WaterReflectance", 0)
			fn18(terrain, "WaterTransparency", 1)
		end

		local function fn18(arg, arg2)
			local now = os.clock()

			for _, descendant in ipairs(arg:GetDescendants()) do
				if not flag3 or n20 ~= arg2 then
					return false
				end
				fn15(descendant)

				if n19 < os.clock() - now then
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					now = os.clock()
				end
			end

			return true
		end

		local function fn19()
			if not flag3 or #tbl19 == 0 then
				return
			end
			local now = os.clock()

			while #tbl19 > 0 do
				local v15 = table.remove(tbl19)
				fn15(v15)
				if not (n19 < os.clock() - now) then
					continue
				end
				break
			end
		end

		local function fn20()
			local now = os.clock()

			for k, v15 in pairs(obj) do
				if k.Parent then
					for k2, v16 in pairs(v15) do
						pcall(function()
							k[k2] = v16.Value
						end)
					end
				end

				obj[k] = nil

				if os.clock() - now > n19 then
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					now = os.clock()
				end
			end
		end

		local function fn21()
			if not flag3 then
				return
			end
			flag3 = false
			n20 += 1
			fn16()
			table.clear(tbl19)

			if thread then
				pcall(task.cancel, thread)
				thread = nil
			end

			fn20()

			for i = #tbl18, 1, -1 do
				local v15 = tbl18[i]
				pcall(v15.Setter, v15.Value)
			end

			table.clear(tbl18)
		end

		local function fn22()
			if flag3 then
				return
			end
			flag3 = true
			n20 += 1
			local v15 = n20
			fn17()

			local function fn23(arg)
				tbl17[#tbl17 + 1] = arg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
					if flag3 and n20 == v15 then
						tbl19[#tbl19 + 1] = descendant
					end
				end)
			end

			fn23(workspace)
			fn23(Lighting)

			connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if flag3 and n20 == v15 then
					fn19()
				end
			end)

			thread = task.spawn(function()
				if fn18(workspace, v15) then
					fn18(Lighting, v15)
				end
			end)
		end

		fn4(fn21)

		v14:CreateToggle({
			Name = "Optimizer",
			Note = "Strip shadows, textures and effects for the highest FPS",
			Default = false,
			Callback = function(arg)
				if arg then
					fn22()
				else
					task.spawn(fn21)
				end
			end,
		})
	end

	do
	local __startCurrentFeature = function()
			local t = game:GetService("Stats")
			local r = v2:CreateState({ Name = "FPS and Ping Position", Default = {} })

			local function l()
				local n = r:Get()
				if type(n) == "table" and type(n.XOffset) == "number" and type(n.YOffset) == "number" then
					return UDim2.new(tonumber(n.XScale) or 0, n.XOffset, tonumber(n.YScale) or 0, n.YOffset)
				end
				return UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
			end

			local function n(m)
				r:Set({
					XScale = m.X.Scale,
					XOffset = m.X.Offset,
					YScale = m.Y.Scale,
					YOffset = m.Y.Offset,
				})
			end

				w = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
			end)

			local function Y(P)
				if P >= 100 then
					return r
				elseif P >= 50 then
					return m
				end

				return u
			end

			local function P(W)
				if W <= 90 then
					return r
				elseif W <= 180 then
					return m
				end

				return u
			end

			local function m()
				if not v then
					return
				end
				local u = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local W = u and u.ViewportSize or (Vector2.new(1280, 720))
				u = math.clamp(((if W.X < 1 then (Vector2.new(1280, 720)) else W)).X * 0.085 / 132, 0.7, 1.4)
				v.Scale = u * Q
			end

			local function u()
				for W, W in ipairs(K) do
					pcall(function()
						W:Disconnect()
					end)
				end

				table.clear(K)

				if j then
					pcall(function()
						j:Destroy()
					end)
				end

				j, F, v, H, D, S, e, p = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, 0
			end

			local function W(R, V, z, i)
				local A = Instance.new("TextLabel")
				A.Name = fn3()
				A.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				A.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(V, 9)
				A.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(z, 16)

				A.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

				if w then
					A.FontFace = w
				else
					A.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
				end

				A.Parent = R
				return A
			end

			local function w()
				u()
				j = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
				j.Name = fn3()
				j.Archivable = false
				j.DisplayOrder = 58
				j.IgnoreGuiInset = true
				j.ResetOnSpawn = false

				F.Name = fn3()
				F.Active = true
				F.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 28)
				F.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
				F.BorderSizePixel = 0
				F.Position = l()
				F.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(132, 34)
				F.Parent = j
				local l = Instance.new("UICorner")
				l.Name = fn3()
				l.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
				l.Parent = F
				l = Instance.new("UIStroke")
				l.Name = fn3()
				l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				l.Thickness = 1
				l.Transparency = 0.9
				l.Parent = F
				v = Instance.new("UIScale")
				v.Name = fn3()
				v.Parent = F
				m()
				H = W(F, 12, 34, r)
				W(F, 48, 22, x).Text = "FPS"
				l = Instance.new("Frame")
				l.Name = fn3()
				l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				l.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				l.BackgroundTransparency = 0.85
				l.BorderSizePixel = 0
				l.Position = UDim2.new(0, 74, 0.5, 0)
				l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 14)

					if not W and not R then
						return
					end
					r = true
					l = R and v or nil
					x = Vector2.new(v.Position.X, v.Position.Y)
					j = F.Position
				end)

				K[#K + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(v)
					if not r or not F or not j then
						return
					end

					if not (l and v == l or not l and v.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
						return
					end
					local W = Vector2.new(v.Position.X, v.Position.Y) - x
					F.Position = UDim2.new(j.X.Scale, j.X.Offset + W.X, j.Y.Scale, j.Y.Offset + W.Y)
				end)

				K[#K + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(x)
					if not r then
						return
					end

					if l and x == l or not l and x.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
						r, l, j = false, nil, nil

						if F then
							n(F.Position)
						end
					end
				end)

					if not O or not H then
						return
					end

					p = (if p <= 0 then r else p + (r - p) * (1 - math.exp(-l * 8)))
					l = os.clock()
					if l < C then
						return
					end
					C = l + 0.2
					l = math.floor(p + 0.5)
					r = tostring(l)

						H.TextColor3 = Y(l)
					end

					pcall(function()
						n = t.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
					end)

					r = math.floor(n + 0.5)
					l = tostring(r)

					if l ~= e then
						e = l
						D.Text = l
						D.TextColor3 = P(r)
					end
				end)
			end

			local t = false

			tbl4.FpsPanelSuppress = function(r)
				t = r == true

				if t then
					u()
				elseif O then
					w()
				end
			end

				Max = 160,
				Default = 100,

				Increment = 1,

					Default = true,

							w()
						else
							u()
						end
					end,
				}),
				Callback = function(t)
					Q = math.clamp((tonumber(t) or 100) / 100, 0.6, 1.6)
					m()
				end,
			})

			fn4(u)
		end
	__chilliStage("starting FPS and ping")
	__startCurrentFeature()
	__chilliStage("finished FPS and ping")
end

end

do
	local v10 = v9:CreateSection({ Name = "Utility", Expanded = true })
	local tbl7 = { Enabled = true, Alive = true, Silenced = {} }

	local function fn9()
		if type(getconnections) ~= "function" then
			return {}
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(getconnections, localPlayer.Idled)
		return ok and type(result) == "table" and result or {}
	end

	local function fn10()
		for _, v11 in ipairs(fn9()) do
			if pcall(function()
				v11:Disable()
			end) then
				tbl7.Silenced[#tbl7.Silenced + 1] = v11
			end
		end
	end

	local function fn11()
		local silenced = tbl7.Silenced

		if #silenced == 0 then
			silenced = fn9()
		end

		for _, v11 in ipairs(silenced) do
			pcall(function()
				v11:Enable()
			end)
		end

		table.clear(tbl7.Silenced)
	end

	local obj = setmetatable({}, { __index = function()
		return function()
		end
	end })

	local tbl8 = {}

	local function fn12()
		local tbl9 = {}
		if type(getgc) ~= "function" or type(debug) ~= "table" or type(debug.getupvalues) ~= "function" then
			return tbl9
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(getgc, false)
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
			return tbl9
		end

		for _, v11 in ipairs(result) do
			if type(v11) == "function" and islclosure(v11) then
				local ok2, result2 = pcall(debug.info, v11, "s")

				if ok2 and type(result2) == "string" and string.find(result2, "AntiAFK", 1, true) then
					local ok3, result3 = pcall(debug.getupvalues, v11)

					if ok3 and type(result3) == "table" then
						for k, v12 in pairs(result3) do
							if typeof(v12) == "Instance" and v12.ClassName == "TeleportService" then
								tbl9[#tbl9 + 1] = { Fn = v11, Index = k, Original = v12 }
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return tbl9
	end

	local function fn13()
		for _, v11 in ipairs(fn12()) do
			local ok, result = pcall(debug.getupvalue, v11.Fn, v11.Index)

			if ok and typeof(result) == "Instance" then
				if pcall(debug.setupvalue, v11.Fn, v11.Index, obj) then
					tbl8[#tbl8 + 1] = v11
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function fn14()
		for _, v11 in ipairs(tbl8) do
			pcall(debug.setupvalue, v11.Fn, v11.Index, v11.Original)
		end

		table.clear(tbl8)
	end

	local function fn15()
		fn10()

		if #tbl8 == 0 then
			fn13()
		end
	end

	local connection = localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.delay(1, function()
			if tbl7.Alive and tbl7.Enabled then
				table.clear(tbl7.Silenced)
				pcall(fn15)
			end
		end)
	end)

	fn4(function()
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end)

	fn4(function()
		tbl7.Alive = false
		fn11()
		fn14()
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while tbl7.Alive do
			if tbl7.Enabled then
				fn15()
			end

			task.wait(600)
		end
	end)

	v10:CreateToggle({
		Name = "Anti AFK",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			tbl7.Enabled = arg ~= false

			if tbl7.Enabled then
				fn15()
			else
				fn11()
				fn14()
			end
		end,
	})
end

				end)

				F[#F + 1] = A.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					p(i, 0.15, { Size = R })
				end)
			end

			do
				local R, z, i, h, c, M = {
					Hotbar = true,
					HotBar = true,
					Toolbar = true,
					ToolBar = true,
					Backpack = true,
					Inventory = true,
				}, {}, math.huge, math.huge, 0

				local function Z(o)
					local a = o

					while a do
						if a:IsA("GuiObject") and not a.Visible then
							return false
						end

						if a:IsA("LayerCollector") then
							return a.Enabled
						end
						a = a.Parent
					end

					return false
				end

				local function o()
					local a, X = pcall(function()
						return r:GetGuiInset().Y
					end)

					return a and X or 0
				end

				local function r(a)
					local X

					for f, I in ipairs(a:GetDescendants()) do
						if I:IsA("GuiButton") and I.Visible and I.AbsoluteSize.Y > 8 and I.AbsoluteSize.X > 8 then
							f = I.AbsolutePosition.Y
							X = (if not X or f < X then f else X)
						end
					end

					return X or a.AbsolutePosition.Y
				end

				local function a()
					table.clear(z)
					local X = localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
					if not X then
						return
					end

					for f, f in ipairs(X:GetDescendants()) do
						if f:IsA("GuiObject") and R[f.Name] then
							z[#z + 1] = f
						end
					end
				end

				local function R()
					local X = {}

					pcall(function()
						if not l:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack) then
							return
						end

						for l, l in ipairs(CoreGui.RobloxGui.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
							if l:IsA("GuiObject") then
								X[#X + 1] = l
							end
						end
					end)

					for l, l in ipairs(z) do
						if l.Parent then
							X[#X + 1] = l
						end
					end

					return X
				end

				local function l()
					local z = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if not z then
						return
					end
					local X = z.ViewportSize
					if X.X < 10 or X.Y < 10 then
						return
					end
					local f, I = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled, math.min(X.X / 1280, X.Y / 720)
					z = f and math.clamp(I * 1.05, 0.6, 0.8) * 0.97 or (math.clamp(I, 0.8, 1.1))
					S.Scale = z
					I = f and 0.3 or 0

					if e.BackgroundTransparency ~= I then
						e.BackgroundTransparency = I
						W.BackgroundTransparency = I
					end

					local S, e = X.Y - 8 * z, false

					for W, U in ipairs(R()) do
						I, W = pcall(Z, U)

						if I and W then
							local W, R = U.AbsoluteSize, U.AbsolutePosition.Y

							if W.X > 20 and W.Y > 20 and W.Y < X.Y * 0.4 and R + W.Y / 2 > X.Y * 0.5 then
								local W, Z = pcall(r, U)
								local r = (W and Z or R) + o(U)
								S, e = (math.min(S, r)), true
							end
						end
					end

					if e then
						M = X.Y - S
					else
						S = (if M then X.Y - M else S)
					end

					e = S - (f and 4 or 6) * z - 52 * z / 2
					e = math.max(e, 52 * z / 2 + 8)
					C.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, e)
				end

				F[#F + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(r)
					V()
					i += r
					h += r

					if i >= 3 then
						i = 0
						pcall(a)
					end

					if h >= 0.2 then
						h = 0
						pcall(l)
					end

					if n.Enabled then
						c = (c + r * (v.Active and 360 or 90)) % 360
						P.Rotation = c
					end
				end)
			end

			b(true)

			n.ShowPanel = function(r)
				t.Enabled = r == true and tbl4.FarmHudOn ~= true
			end

			t.Enabled = n.PanelShown == true and tbl4.FarmHudOn ~= true
			t.Parent = D
			p(w, 0.45, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)

			local function r()
				local l = tbl4.Root()
				if not l then
					return nil
				end

				for D, D in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if D:IsA("Model") and (D:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")) then
						for p, p in ipairs(D:GetDescendants()) do
							if p:IsA("JointInstance") or (p:IsA("WeldConstraint")) or (p:IsA("RigidConstraint")) then
								local C, S, e = pcall(function()
									return p.Part0, p.Part1
								end)

								if C and (S == l or e == l) then
									return D
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			local function l(D, p)
				local C = {}

				for S, S in ipairs(D:GetDescendants()) do
					C[S] = S.Archivable

					pcall(function()
						S.Archivable = true
					end)
				end

				local S = D.Archivable
				D.Archivable = true

				local e, P = pcall(function()
					return D:Clone()
				end)

				D.Archivable = S

				for D, S in pairs(C) do
					pcall(function()
						D.Archivable = S
					end)
				end

				if not e or not P then
					return nil
				end
				P.Name = H()

				for D, D in ipairs(P:GetDescendants()) do
					if D:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or (D:IsA("Sound")) or (D:IsA("ForceField")) or (D:IsA("JointInstance")) or (D:IsA("Constraint")) or (D:IsA("WeldConstraint")) or (D:IsA("BodyMover")) or (D:IsA("ProximityPrompt")) or (D:IsA("BillboardGui")) then
						pcall(function()
							D:Destroy()
						end)
					elseif D:IsA("BasePart") then
						D.Anchored = true
						D.CanCollide = false
						D.CanQuery = false
						D.CanTouch = false
					elseif D:IsA("Humanoid") then
						D.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
						D.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
					end
				end

				P.Parent = p
				return P
			end

			local function D(p, C)
				local S = workspace.CurrentCamera
				if not p or not S or v.Disguise then
					return
				end
				C = C or Vector3.zero

				local e = {
					Camera = S,
					CameraType = S.CameraType,
					CameraCFrame = S.CFrame,
					Copies = {},
					Hidden = {},
				}

				v.Disguise = e
				local P, W, R = { p }, pcall(r)

				if W and R then
					P[#P + 1] = R
				end

				for p, p in ipairs(P) do
					for V, V in ipairs(p:GetDescendants()) do
						if V:IsA("BasePart") or (V:IsA("Decal")) or (V:IsA("Texture")) then
							e.Hidden[#e.Hidden + 1] = V
						end
					end
				end

				local function p()
					for V, V in ipairs(e.Hidden) do
						pcall(function()
							V.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
						end)
					end

					pcall(function()
						if S.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
							S.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
						end

						S.CFrame = e.CameraCFrame
					end)
				end

				p()
				e.BindName = H()

				if not pcall(function()
					RunService:BindToRenderStep(e.BindName, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, p)
				end) then
					e.BindName = nil
					e.Link = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(p)
				end

				e.Beat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(p)

				for H, H in ipairs(P) do
					R, W = pcall(l, H, S)

					if R and W then
						if C.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							for l, l in ipairs(W:GetDescendants()) do
								if l:IsA("BasePart") then
									pcall(function()
										l.CFrame = l.CFrame + C
									end)
								end
							end
						end

						e.Copies[#e.Copies + 1] = W
					end
				end
			end

			local function l()
				local H = v.Disguise
				if not H then
					return
				end
				v.Disguise = nil

				if H.BindName then
					pcall(function()
						RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(H.BindName)
					end)
				end

				if H.Link then
					pcall(function()
						H.Link:Disconnect()
					end)
				end

				if H.Beat then
					pcall(function()
						H.Beat:Disconnect()
					end)
				end

				for p, p in ipairs(H.Hidden) do
					pcall(function()
						p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
					end)
				end

				pcall(function()
					H.Camera.CameraType = H.CameraType
				end)

				for p, p in ipairs(H.Copies) do
					pcall(function()
						p:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end

			local function H()
				for p, C in ipairs(O) do
					p = workspace

					for O, O in ipairs(C.Path) do
						p = p and (p:FindFirstChild(O)) or nil
					end

					if p and (p:IsA("BasePart")) then
						return p.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(C.Offset)
					end
				end

				return K
			end

			local function O(K, p, C, S, e)
				local P = CFrame.new(C) * S

				pcall(function()
					K:PivotTo(P)
				end)

				if (p.Position - C).Magnitude > 3 then
					pcall(function()
						p.CFrame = P
					end)
				end

				if e == false then
					return
				end

				for p, p in ipairs(K:GetDescendants()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") then
						pcall(function()
							p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
							p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			local function K()
				local p = v.AreaId
				p = (if type(p) ~= "string" or p == "" then type(tbl4.Steal) == "table" and tbl4.Steal.CarryAreaId or nil else p)

				if type(p) ~= "string" or p == "" then
					local C = localPlayer:GetAttribute("AreaId")
					p = type(C) == "string" and C or nil
				end

				return p
			end

			local p = { lightdark = "LightDark" }

			local function C(S)
				if type(S) ~= "string" then
					return "Default"
				end
				return p[string.lower((string.gsub(S, "[^%a]", "")))] or "Default"
			end

			local function p()
				local S, e = pcall(function()
					return getgenv().ChilliAntiGuard
				end)

				if S and type(e) == "table" then
					if type(e.Steps) == "table" then
						return e
					end
					local S = e[C(K())] or e.Default
					if type(S) == "table" then
						return S
					end
				end

				return u[C(K())] or m
			end

			local function u()
				local K, C = p(), n.Options
				if type(C) ~= "table" or C.Destination == "Safe Zone" and not C.Stay then
					return K
				end
				local p = {}

				for S, e in pairs(K) do
					p[S] = e
				end

				if C.Destination == "Next To Line" then
					p.Target = "edge"
					p.LineOffset = 6
					p.Height = 0
					p.OffsetX = 0
					p.OffsetZ = 0
				elseif C.Destination == "Saved Spot" and typeof(C.Spot) == "Vector3" then
					p.Target = "point"
					p.Point = C.Spot
					p.Height = 0
					p.OffsetX = 0
					p.OffsetZ = 0
				end

				if C.Stay and type(K.Steps) == "table" then
					local C = {}

					for S, S in ipairs(K.Steps) do
						if type(S) == "table" and S.To ~= "start" then
							C[#C + 1] = S
						end
					end

					p.Steps = C
				end

				return p
			end

			local function K(p, C)
				local S = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or (workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS"))
				local e = S and (S:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
				S = e and (e:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine"))

				if S and (S:IsA("BasePart")) then
					e = S.CFrame
					local P = S.Size.X >= S.Size.Z and e.RightVector or e.LookVector
					local S = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0):Cross(P)
					S = Vector3.new(S.X, 0, S.Z)

					if S.Magnitude > 0.001 then
						S = S.Unit
						P = (C - e.Position):Dot(S) >= 0 and -S or S
						local S = e.Position + P * (tonumber(p.LineOffset) or 8)
						return Vector3.new(S.X, C.Y + 0.5, S.Z)
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

			local function p(C, S)
				local e = tostring(C.Target or "home")
				if e == "sky" then
					return S
				end

				if e == "point" then
					if typeof(C.Point) == "Vector3" then
						return C.Point
					end
					return S
				end

				if e == "line" then
					local P = K(C, S)
					if P then
						return P
					end
				end

				if e == "edge" then
					local K = workspace:FindFirstChild("World") or (workspace:FindFirstChild("__OBJECTS"))
					local e = K and (K:FindFirstChild("Areas"))
					K = e and (e:FindFirstChild("SeparationLine"))

					if K and (K:IsA("BasePart")) then
						e = K.CFrame
						local P = K.Size.X >= K.Size.Z and e.RightVector or e.LookVector
						P = Vector3.new(P.X, 0, P.Z)
						local W = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0):Cross(P)
						W = Vector3.new(W.X, 0, W.Z)

						if W.Magnitude > 0.001 and P.Magnitude > 0.001 then
							P, W = P.Unit, W.Unit
							local R = S - e.Position
							local V, z = math.clamp(R:Dot(P), -K.Size.Magnitude / 2, K.Size.Magnitude / 2), R:Dot(W) >= 0 and W or -W
							local K, W = e.Position + P * V + z * (tonumber(C.LineOffset) or 6), H()
							return Vector3.new(K.X, (W and W.Y or S.Y) + 3, K.Z)
						end
					end
				end

				return H()
			end

			local function K(H, C)
				return p(H, C) + Vector3.new(tonumber(H.OffsetX) or 0, tonumber(H.Height) or 0, tonumber(H.OffsetZ) or 0)
			end

			local function H()
				v.Active = false
				n.Busy = false
			end

			local function p(C)
				local S = math.max(tonumber(C) or 0, 0)
				if S <= 0 then
					return 0
				end
				return (math.random() * 2 - 1) * S
			end

			local function C(S)
				local e, P, W, R, V, z = type(S.Steps) == "table" and S.Steps or {}, tonumber(S.ReleaseAt) or 0, math.max(tonumber(S.StartAt) or 0, 0), math.max(tonumber(S.StartRandom) or 0, 0), math.max(tonumber(S.HopRandom) or 0, 0), math.max(tonumber(S.HoldRandom) or 0, 0)
				if R <= 0 and V <= 0 and z <= 0 then
					return e, P, W
				end
				local i, h, c, b = math.max(W + p(R), 0), {}, 0, 0

				for M, Z in ipairs(e) do
					if type(Z) ~= "table" then
						break
					end
					W = math.max(tonumber(Z.At) or 0, 0)
					S, R = math.max(W - c, 0), Z.To == "start" and z or V
					b = math.max(b + S + p(R), i)
					h[M] = { At = b, To = Z.To, Glide = Z.Glide }
					c = W
				end

				return h, b + math.max(P - c, 0), i
			end

			local function p(S)
				local e, P = localPlayer.Character, tbl4.Root()
				local W = e and (e:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

				if not P or not W or W.Health <= 0 then
					H()
					Y(x.Bad, 1.6)
					return
				end

				local function R()
					return j and P.Parent ~= nil and W.Parent ~= nil and W.Health > 0
				end

				local V, z = W.PlatformStand, P.CFrame
				local i, h = z.Position, u()
				local c, b, M = C(h)
				local C, Z, o = h.Freeze ~= false, tostring(h.Facing or "Keep"), math.max(tonumber(h.Jitter) or 0, 0)
				local a = Z == "Zero" and (CFrame.new()) or z.Rotation

				local function X()
					if Z == "Spin" then
						return CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(0, 359)), 0)
					end
					return a
				end

				local function Z(a)
					if o <= 0 then
						return a
					end
					return a + Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * o, 0, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * o)
				end

				z = K(h, i)

				local function K(o)
					while R() and os.clock() - S < o do
						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

						if C then
							pcall(function()
								P.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
								P.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
							end)
						end
					end

					return R()
				end

				local function S(o, a)
					O(e, P, o, a, C)
					RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()

					if R() and (P.Position - o).Magnitude > 3 then
						O(e, P, o, a, C)
					end
				end

				pcall(function()
					W.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
				end)

				if h.Disguise ~= false then
					pcall(D, e, Vector3.zero)
				end

				Y(x.Work)

				if K(M) and h.Limp ~= false then
					W.PlatformStand = true
				end

				h = i

				for D, o in ipairs(c) do
					if type(o) ~= "table" or not K(tonumber(o.At) or 0) then
						break
					end
					M, D = o.To == "start" and i or (Z(z)), X()

					if type(o.Glide) == "table" and #o.Glide > 0 then
						for z, z in ipairs(o.Glide) do
							if not R() then
								break
							end
							O(e, P, h:Lerp(M, (math.clamp(tonumber(z) or 1, 0, 1))), D, C)
							RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
						end
					else
						S(M, D)
					end

					h = M
				end

				K(b)

				pcall(function()
					W.PlatformStand = V
				end)

				l()
				H()

				if R() and v.Carrying then
					Y(x.Good, 1.6)
				else
					Y(x.Bad, 1.6)
				end
			end

			local function O(K)
				if not pcall(p, K) then
					pcall(function()
						local K = localPlayer.Character
						local D = K and (K:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

						if D then
							D.PlatformStand = false
						end
					end)

					l()
					H()
					Y(x.Bad, 1.6)
				end
			end

			local function x()
				if n.HitArms <= 0 then
					return false
				end

				if os.clock() - (n.HitArmedAt or 0) > 25 then
					n.HitArms = 0
					return false
				end
				return true
			end

			local function K()
				local D = v.Carrying
				v.Carrying = v.SignalCarrying or v.WeldCarrying

				if v.Carrying and not D and j and n.Enabled and not (tbl4.SafeCarry.LineDrop and tbl4.Steal.Active) and not (tbl4.Steal.Active and (tbl4.BossPortalUp())) and not v.Active and not x() then
					v.Active = true
					n.Busy = true
					n.BusySince = os.clock()
					task.spawn(O, os.clock())
				end
			end

			A = tbl.EggState
			Q = type(A) == "table" and A.CarryChanged or nil

			if type(Q) == "table" and type(Q.Connect) == "function" then
				w, A = pcall(Q.Connect, Q, function(O)
					local D = type(O) == "table" and O.IsCarrying == true
					D = (if D and O.GuardDisabled == true then false else D)

					if D and type(O.AreaId) == "string" then
						v.AreaId = O.AreaId
					end

					if not D then
						v.AreaId = nil
					end

					v.SignalCarrying = D
					K()
				end)

				if w and A then
					F[#F + 1] = A
				end
			end

			do
				local O = 0

				F[#F + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(D)
					if (n.Busy or v.Active) and os.clock() - n.BusySince > math.max(tonumber(u().BusyLimit) or m.BusyLimit, (tonumber(u().ReleaseAt) or 0) + 1) then
						l()
						local u = localPlayer.Character and (localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))

						if u and u.PlatformStand then
							pcall(function()
								u.PlatformStand = false
							end)
						end

						H()
					end

					x()
					O += D
					if O < m.WeldScanGap then
						return
					end
					O = 0
					D = r() ~= nil

					if D ~= v.WeldCarrying then
						v.WeldCarrying = D
						K()
					end
				end)
			end

			fn4(function()
				j = false

				for d, d in ipairs(F) do
					pcall(function()
						d:Disconnect()
					end)
				end

				table.clear(F)
				l()
				H()
				n.Render = nil
				n.ShowPanel = nil

				pcall(function()
					t:Destroy()
				end)
			end)
		end
	__startCurrentFeature()
end

-- Read the persisted control after the floating panel exists; initial callbacks may be deferred.
local function __syncGuardPanel()
 local guard = tbl4.AntiGuard
 guard.PanelShown = tbl4.Toggle(guard.PanelHandle, true) == true
 if guard.ShowPanel then guard.ShowPanel(guard.PanelShown) end
 if guard.Render then guard.Render(false) end
end
__syncGuardPanel()
task.defer(__syncGuardPanel)

__chilliStage("finalizing window and loading configuration")

v:Finalize({ Window = v2, MainTab = defaultTab, ShowMainTab = true })

task.defer(function()
	if #tbl2 == 0 or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

	local function fn12(arg)
		if type(isfile) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(isfile, arg)
			if ok and not result then
				return nil
			end
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(readfile, arg)
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local ok2, result2 = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, result)
		return ok2 and type(result2) == "table" and result2 or nil
	end

	local json = fn12("ChilliLibrary/config_state.json") or {}
	if json.AutoLoad == false then
		return
	end
	local v10 = fn12("ChilliLibrary/configs/" .. (type(json.StartupConfig) == "string" and json.StartupConfig ~= "" and json.StartupConfig or type(json.SelectedConfig) == "string" and json.SelectedConfig ~= "" and json.SelectedConfig or "Default") .. ".json")
	if type(v10) ~= "table" or type(v10.Values) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local tbl12 = { ["K/s"] = 1000, ["M/s"] = 1000000, ["B/s"] = 1e9 }
	local tbl13 = {}

	for _, v11 in ipairs(tbl2) do
		local flag2 = false
		local v12 = nil

		for _, value in pairs(v10.Values) do
			local flag3 = type(value) == "table" and value[v11.Section] or nil

			if type(flag3) == "table" then
				if flag3[v11.Name] ~= nil then
					flag2 = true
				end

				local v13 = flag3[v11.Legacy]

				if type(v13) == "table" and tonumber(v13.Value) then
					v12 = v13
				end
			end
		end

		if v12 and not flag2 then
			local n4 = math.max(0, tonumber(v12.Value)) * (tbl12[tostring(v12.Unit)] or 1000000)

			if n4 > 0 then
				table.insert(tbl13, { Handle = v11.Handle, Step = v11.StepOf(n4) })
			end
		end
	end

	for _, v11 in ipairs({ 0.1, 1, 2 }) do
		if #tbl13 == 0 then
			return
		end
		task.wait(v11)

		for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl13) do
			local ok, result = pcall(v12.Handle.Get, v12.Handle)

			if ok then
				ok = (tonumber(result) or 0) <= 0
			end

			if ok then
				pcall(v12.Handle.Set, v12.Handle, v12.Step)
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.defer(function()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end

	if type(tbl4.RestoreStealPanel) == "function" then
		pcall(tbl4.RestoreStealPanel)
	end
end)

__chilliStage("window finalized")
